Third, a semi-supervised Riemannian fuzzy C-means (SSFCM) framework robustly resists hierarchical clutter and steers the trajectory toward the true target. Experiments show that ST-SRDT outperforms WSLCM ( 158 ) and PSTNN ( 159 ) while running in real time at 24 frames per second.
blocks.zh: 里曼语多面体 集群:红外小目标探测在无监督的集群中呈现出中心漂移的挑战,这种集群在平坦的欧几利得空地被重尾背景杂乱所误导. 为解决这一局限性,Zhu等人(157人)设计了一个Spatio-Temperor的前准导半导体Riemannian多管梯特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克 第二,用Log-Euclidean 度量衡(LEM)将曲线矩阵投射到平坦的Lie代数正切空间上。 第三,一个半监督的Riemannian fuzzy C-means(SSFCM)框架强有力地抵抗了等级杂乱并引导轨迹向真正的目标走去. 实验显示,ST-SRDT在实时运行时以每秒24帧的速度超过WSLCM(158分)和PSTNN(159分).

blocks.en:
Hyperbolic Density Clustering: All the detection algorithms typically map hierarchical background clutter into a flat Euclidean space and results in a “feature crowding effect” because of the geometric mismatch between spatial capacity and data structure. In 2026, Zhu et al. ( 160 ) propose a hyperbolic density clustering method based on a training-free detection paradigm which integrates non-Euclidean geometric reconstruction with optical mechanism verification. In a further work, Zhu et al. ( 161 ) design a Physics-Aware Adaptive Hyperbolic Density Peak Clustering (PA-AHDPC 9 9 9 https://github.com/llx-xupt/PA-AHDPC ) to address this theoretical point. PA-AHDPC is a training-free detection paradigm that employs non-Euclidean geometric reconstruction with optical mechanism verification. First, PA-AHDPC employs dual-prior probabilistic screening to rapidly anchor high-confidence candidate regions. Second, PA-AHDPC exploits the exponential expansion property of the hyperbolic Poincaré ball relative to its radius
to address the local feature distribution. PA-AHDPC isolates weak targets from strongly structured clutter at the topological level on a negatively curved manifold. Third, a strict Local Gradient Difference (Strict-LGD) soft-decision mechanism incorporating energy spillover tolerance filters out pseudo-targets lacking continuous energy diffusion characteristics, such as high-brightness sensor dead pixels. Experiments show that PA-AHDPC outperforms the second-best SOTA algorithms by achieving an approximate 5 to 10 dB improvement in signal-to-clutter ratio gain (SCRG). To address the feature crowding effect where heavy-tailed background clutter overlaps with weak targets within flat Euclidean spaces, Zhu et al. ( 162 ) propose a Hyperbolic Wasserstein Manifold Detector (HWM-Det 10 10 10 https://github.com/llx-xupt/hyperbolic-Wasserstein-manifold-detector ). First, a spatial
topological offset physically isolates target radiation. A cascade screening reduces
computational complexity to linear time. Second, local patches guided by Hessian structural tensors are mapped onto a Symmetric Positive Definite (SPD) manifold to keep the target’s optical point spread function (PSF) prior. Third, the high-dimensional features are embedded into a Poincaré ball. An extreme value theory (EVT)-driven Bayesian framework generates a maximum a posteriori (MAP) recovery bound. Experiment. shows that HWM-Det outperforms RLCM, TLLCM and PSTNN ( 159 ) .
blocks.zh:
双曲密度 分组 : 所有探测算法一般都将等级背景拼接成一个平坦的欧几里得空间,并由于空间能力和数据结构之间的几何不匹配而产生"地貌拥挤效应". 2026年,朱等编. (160)在无训练检测范式的基础上提出双曲密度集群法,将非欧几里得几何重建与光学机制核查相融合. 在进一步的工作中,Zhu等人(161人)设计了一种物理-智能适应超曲面密度峰群(PA-AHDPC 9 9 9 9 https://github.com/llx-xupt/PA-AHDPC),以解决这一理论问题。 PA-AHDPC是一种无培训检测范式,采用非欧几里得几何重建并进行光学机制核查. 首先,巴勒斯坦权力机构 -- -- AHDPC采用双重优先概率筛查,以迅速锁定高自信候选地区。 第二,PA-AHDPC利用双曲波因卡雷球相对于半径的指数扩张特性
解决本地特征分布问题。 PA-AHDPC将薄弱目标与地形层次结构严密的多曲线相隔离。 第三,采用严格的局部渐变(Strict-LGD)软决定机制,将能量外溢耐受性过滤出缺乏连续能扩散特性的伪目标,如高亮感应活像素等. 实验显示,PA-AHDPC通过在信号到整流器比例增益(SCRG)方面实现约5到10分贝的改进,超过了第二佳的SOTA算法. 为解决高尾背景与平地欧几利得空间内弱目标相重叠的特征拥挤效应,Zhu等人(162人)提议采用超曲线瓦瑟斯坦曼尼佛探测器(HWM-Det 10 10 s://github.com/llx-xupt/hyperbolic-Wasserstein-manifold-detector)。
地形抵消了物理隔离目标辐射。 级联筛选减少
计算复杂到线性时间。 第二,由黑森结构伸缩器引导的局部补丁被映射到对称正断面(SPD)多面上,以保持目标光学点散射功能(PSF)的先行性. 第三,高维度特征被嵌入到一粒Poincaré球中. 一个由极值理论(EVT)驱动的贝叶斯框架产生一个最大后期(MAP)恢复约束. 实验 显示HWM-Det优于RLCM,TLLCM和PSTNN(159).

blocks.en: In summary, clustering methods present several interesting abilities for infrared small target detection especially with recent approaches based on density Peak clustering and hyperbolic density clustering published in 2025 and 2026, respectively.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,集群方法为红外小目标探测提供了几种有趣的能力,特别是最近分别于2025年和2026年公布的基于密度高峰集群和双曲密度集群的方法。

blocks.en: 5.2.2 Discriminative Methods
blocks.zh: 5.2.2 歧视性方法

blocks.en: In 2025, Luo et al. ( 163 ) propose an small target detection method based on frequency data sphering (FDS) and independent component analysis (FICA-TD) in order to capture the characteristics of different components. First, a spatial-temporal tensor with its adjacent frames is constructed from the videos. Second, the low-frequency information is suppressed with a frequency high-pass filtering operator and a FDS operator. Third, an Independent Component Analysis (ICA) method allows to determine the number of signal sources and the basis of independent component space followed by projecting the frequency data-sphered tensor into the independent component space. A Sparsity Information Filter (SIF) is then employed to filter out the residual low-response information of the middle frontal slice. Finally, the target detection result sequence are obtained. Experiments conducted on five real IR sequences show that FICA-TD is superior to seven state-of-the-art competitive methods in terms of target detectability, background suppressibility, and overall performance.
blocks.zh: 2025年,罗等. (163)提出基于频率数据分层(FDS)和独立组件分析(FICA-TD)的小型目标检测方法,以捕捉不同组件的特性. 首先,从视频中构建了带有相邻帧的空间-时空变压器. 二是用频率高通滤波操作器和FDS操作器压制低频信息. 第三,一种独立元件分析(ICA)方法可以确定信号源的数量和独立元件空间的基础,然后将频率数据所覆盖的拉伸线投射到独立元件空间. 然后使用一个平面信息过滤器(SIF)来过滤中前切片的剩余低响应信息. 最后,获得目标检测结果序列. 在5个真实的IR序列上进行的实验表明,FICA-TD在目标可探测性,背景可抑制性,以及总体性能方面优于7个最先进的竞争方法.

blocks.en: 5.3 Consistency of Backgrounds
blocks.zh: 5.3 背景的一致性

blocks.en:
Methods based on the background spatial consistency assume that the unknown background can be predicted based on the correlation between pixels while the occurrence of the target breaks the correlation and makes the prediction fail. In this way, the target and background separation is achieved by subtracting the predicted image from the original one.
These filter based methods can be classified as follows: Wavelet/Contourlet filters ( 69 ; 164 ; 165 ; 166 ) ,Top-Hat filters ( 167 ; 168 ; 169 ; 170 ; 171 ; 68 ; 172 ) , Least Mean Square filters ( 173 ; 174 ; 175 ; 176 ; 177 ) and Max-Min filters ( 178 ) .
blocks.zh:
基于背景空间一致性的方法假设,未知背景可以根据像素之间的关联性来预测,而目标的发生会打破相关关系并导致预测失败. 这样,通过从原来的图像中减去所预测的图像来实现目标和背景的分离.
这些以过滤为基础的方法可分类如下: 相接/相接滤波器(69;164;165;166),Top-Hat滤波器(167;168;169;170;171;68;172),最小平方滤波器(173;174;175;176;177)和Max-Min滤波器(178).

blocks.en: 5.3.1 Wavelet/Contourlet based Methods
blocks.zh: 5.3.1 以波幅/图幅为基础的 方法

blocks.en: In 1994, Gregoris et al. ( 69 ) propose a multi-scale wavelet transform algorithm in forward looking infrared (FLIR). In 2012, Zhao et al. ( 165 ) design a detection algorithm based on wavelet transform and image fusion. The original image is decomposed and reconstructed by wavelet and it is separated into a low frequency image and some high frequency images. Then, the low frequency image is removed and the high frequency images are fused into a new image. The fused image is segmented with a threshold to obtain the target. In an other work, Zhao et al. ( 166 ) develop a detection method based on the nonsubsampled contourlet transform. The nonsubsampled contourlet transform allows to decompose the source image. Considering the different energy distribution characteristics of the target, background and noise, the energy image is obtained by energy cross correlation operation. Then, a few of candidate targets were segmented through adaptive threshold. Finally, the target was confirmed by using the continuity and consistency of target energy intensity and target movement in image sequence.
blocks.zh: 1994年,Gregoris等(69.)在前瞻红外线(FLIR)中提出了多尺度波浪变换算法. 2012年,赵等(165人)设计了基于波浪变换和图像融合的检测算法. 原始图像由波列分解并重建而来,被分离成低频图像和一些高频图像. 然后去掉低频图像,将高频图像接入新图像. 被引信的图像被分出一个阈值来得到目标. 在另一作中,赵等. (166)以无子样相轮回变换为基础开发出一种检测方法. 非子样本的轮廓转换可以分解出源图像. 考虑到目标的不同能量分布特征,背景和噪声,能量图像通过能量交叉相通操作得到. 随后,少数候选目标通过适应性阈值被分割. 最后,通过使用目标能量强度的连续性和一致性以及目标移动在图像序列中得到确认.

blocks.en: 5.3.2 Top-Hat Filters
blocks.zh: 5.3.2 上部过滤器

blocks.en: Morphological detection is the first method employed infrared small target detection. Along with the development of morphological research, morphological image processing has gradually become a new trend in image processing field and a suitable tool in small target detection. The final performance of the morphological filter strongly depends on the selection of the structuring element including the shape and value of it once given the morphological operation regulation. There will be different geometric structure information to analyze and process in the operation according to different structuring element being selected. In this context, most of the researchers have adopted the Top-Hat operations for infrared small target detection. More specifically, the morphological Top-Hat operation ( 179 ) is a high-pass filtering operation which includes opening Top-Hat operation and closing one. The opening Top-Hat operation can detect wave crest of an image and the closing Top-Hat operation can detect wave hollow. In 2002, Bin and Peng ( 180 ) indicate that the Top-Hat operation is similar to a non-spread operation and the opening Top-Hat operation is always positive. Therefore, Top-Hat filters provide good results only in some corresponding image model. However, usually the image signals are extremely complicated and change all the time, so the selected structuring element should be adaptive for realizing optimization. But, classical top-hat transformation employs two same structuring elements in the operations of opening or closing, and does not use this difference information in the structuring element appropriately. This fact decreases the efficiency of classical top-hat transformation to differentiate the real target region and noise or clutter regions. Moreover, the noise or clutter may affect the performance of classical top-hat transformation as follows: 1) The noises may lead to target losing or increase the number of false alarms, and 2) the classical top-hat transformation cannot differentiate the heavy clutter and real target region. In literature, two methods for optimizing structuring elements have emerged ( 167 ) : morphological neural networks and morphological genetic algorithm. In 2006, Zeng et al. ( 167 ) propose two methods to optimize Top-Hat morphological filtering parameters. The first is based on neural network. Its structuring element is a two-layer feed-forward network which is trained by a mass of sample nets. This method considers Top-Hat operation as a whole and one layer, and defines the node of the output layer as the maximum gray-scale image vector after Top-Hat operation. The second method is based on genetic algorithm. This method adopts the interval discretization code and primary and secondary mood crossover and mutation. In 2010, Bai and Zhou ( 169 ) propose the definition, properties, multi-scale operations of top-hat transformation. The definition of this top-hat transformation employs two different but correlated structuring elements to reorganize the classical top-hat transformation, and takes into account of the difference information between the target and surrounding regions. Experiments show that this top-hat transformation can detect infrared small target more efficiently than the previous top-hat transformations. In further work, Bai and Zhou ( 170 ) propose an other modified top-hat transformation improving the contrast between bright and dark regions and using an iterative thresholding method to automatically detect the target region. Nevertheless, these methods have problem in suppressing the fixed position sharp noise and poor real-time performance. To solve this problem, Wang et al. ( 181 ) design a three-dimensional dynamic queue pipeline and employs a space-domain algorithm based on morphology Top-Hat operator in order to ensure the continuity of the target and the pipeline. However, the structure elements are desired to be adjusted adaptively. To this end, Deng et al. ( 168 ) propose an adaptive structure elements optimization method based on Quantum Genetic Algorithm (QGA). Experiments show that QGA achieve more stable performance compared with the traditional top-hat filter.
blocks.zh: 肿瘤检测是第一种采用红外小目标检测的方法. 随着形态学研究的发展,形态学图像处理逐渐成为了图像处理领域的新趋势并成为了小目标探测的合适工具. 形态滤波器的最终性能强烈地取决于结构元素的选择,包括它曾经由于形态操作调节而得到的形状和价值. 会有不同的几何结构信息来根据所选择的不同结构元素在操作中进行分析和处理. 在这方面,大多数研究人员采用了Top-Hat操作,用于红外小目标探测. 更具体地说,形态式Top-Hat操作(179)是一种高通滤波操作,包括打开Top-Hat操作和关闭一. 开口Top-Hat操作可以探测一幅图像的波峰,而收尾Top-Hat操作可以探测出波空. 2002年,"斌和彭"(180.)表示"Top-Hat"操作与"非散开"操作类似,"开通""Top-Hat"操作总是正面的. 因此,Top-Hat过滤器只在一些相应的图像模型中提供良好的效果. 然而,通常图像信号极为复杂并会不断改变,因此所选的结构元素应该能适应实现优化. 但是,古典的上层帽子转换在开口或收尾的操作中采用了两个相同的结构元素,在结构元素中并没有适当地使用这种不同的信息. 这一事实降低了古典上层帽子改造的效率,以区别真正的目标区域以及噪音或杂乱无章的区域. 此外,噪声或杂音可能影响古典上层帽子变奏的性能如下: 1)噪声可能导致目标丢失或增加虚假警报的数量;2)古典的上层帽子改造无法区分重杂乱和真实的目标区域. 在文献中,出现了两种优化结构元素的方法(167):形态神经网络和形态遗传算法. 2006年,曾等(167人)提出了两种方法来优化Top-Hat形态过滤参数. 第一个基于神经网络. 其结构要素是一个双层的饲料推进网络,由一大批样品网培训。 这种方法将Top-Hat操作作为一个整体和一层进行考虑,并将输出层的节点定义为Top-Hat操作后的最大灰度图像向量. 第二种方法基于遗传算法. 这种方法采用间隔盘状码并采用一级和二级情绪交叉和突变. 2010年,白和周(169人)提出了"上帽子"转型的定义,属性,多尺度操作. 这种顶帽转型的定义使用了两个不同但相互关联的结构要素来重组古典顶帽转型,并考虑到目标与周边地区之间的不同信息. 实验显示,这种顶帽变换可以比之前的顶帽变换更有效地探测出红外小目标. 在进一步的工作上,白和周(170人)提出另一种修改后上帽变换,改善亮相和暗相之间的对比,并使用迭接阈值方法自动检测目标区域. 尽管如此,这些方法在压制固定位置的尖锐噪声和不良的实时性能方面存在问题. 为了解决这个问题,王等. (181)设计出三维动态队列管道,并采用基于形态Top-Hat操作器的空间域算法,以确保目标和管道的连续性. 然而,结构要素需要根据具体情况进行调整。 为此,邓等(168人)提出了以量子遗传算法(QGA)为基础的适应性结构元素优化方法. 实验显示,QGA与传统的上帽滤波器相比,实现了更稳定的性能.

blocks.en: Despite its simplicity and the rise of LRSD models and deep neural networks, several researchers still develop improvements. In 2022, Yang et al. ( 2 ) propose a multi-structural element top-hat operator to obtain the suspected target area through adaptive threshold segmentation. This method employs image feature algorithms, such as central pixel contrast, regional gradient, and directional gradient, to extract the feature information of the suspected target at multiple scales, and the fuzzy decision method is employed for multi-feature fusion to achieve the final target detection. In 2023, Yavari et al. ( 182 ) propose a multi-stage morphological operator. The algorithm consists . of three stages. First, the noise is eliminated by means of Gaussian filtering to improve the SNR. Second, the morphological-based operation is applied but unlike the NTHF which uses the largest value of the neighborhood of a point, the average of n n -largest values are employed. This strategy addresses the shortcoming of the NTHF when clutter is close to target. The residual noise and clutter is then reduced in the final stage using another morphological operation. In 2024, Li et al. ( 68 ) propose a Weighted Adaptive Ring Top-Hat transformation (WARTH). First, an adaptive ring-shaped structural element and a target awareness indicator are employed to measure local and global feature information to detect small targets while minimizing false alarms. Second, a Difference-of-Structure Tensors (DoST) is proposed and the positive smallest eigenvalue of DoST (PSEDoST) is computed to obtain the adaptive ring-shaped that captures local feature information. Third, the image is converted into the Fourier phase spectrum, and a two-stage sliding window filtering technique is applied to obtain the target awareness indicator that perceives global feature information. At the last stage, WARTH is defined by fusing the above two measurements which eliminate false alarms and improve the robustness of target detection.
blocks.zh: 尽管其简洁而LRSD模型和深神经网络的兴起,但有几位研究人员仍然在开发改进. 2022年,杨等. (2)提出多结构元件上帽操作员,通过适应性阈值分解获得被怀疑的目标区域. 这种方法采用图像特征算法,如中心像素对比,区域梯度,方向梯度等,在多尺度取出被怀疑目标特征信息,并采用模糊决定法来进行多地聚变以达到最终目标检测. 2023年,Yavari等(182)提出多相形态操作. 该算法由三个阶段组成. 首先通过高斯滤波来消除噪音来改进SNR. 第二,采用了以形态学为基础的操作,但与使用一个点附近最大值的NTHF不同,采用了n-最大值的平均值。 这项战略解决了NTHF在接近目标时的缺点。 然后利用另一种形态操作在最后阶段减少残留噪音和杂音. 2024年,李等(68人)提出"重心回放"(Wighted adaptive Ring Top-Hat)变身(WARTH). 首先,采用了一个适应性环状结构要素和一个目标意识指标来测量当地和全球特征信息,以探测出小目标,同时将假警报降到最低。 其次,建议采用不同结构的天线(DOST),并计算出DoST(PSEDoST)的正极值最小值,以获得捕捉出当地地物信息的可适应环形. 第三,将图像转换为Fourier相相频谱,并应用了双相滑动窗口过滤技术来获得能感知到全球地物信息的目标认知指标. 在最后阶段,WARTH的定义是用引信来安装上述两项测量,消除了假警报并增强了目标探测的强度.

blocks.en: 5.3.3 Least Mean Square Filters
blocks.zh: 5.3.3 最小平方滤镜

blocks.en: In 1989, Hadhoud and Thomas ( 173 ) propose a two-dimensional adaptive filter which is an extension of the one-dimensional Least Mean Square (LMS) filter. This method attempts to minimize the mean square error between the predicted response and the output signal. Thus, the TDLMS filter predicts the pixel intensity based on the weighted intensity of nearby pixels. The prediction error is large near the target and is close to zero in the background. This is because the intensity of the pixels near the target changes rapidly and is hard to predict accurately. In the opposite, the intensity of the background pixels is homogeneous and easy to predict. Thus, the TDLMS filter enhance small targets and suppress backgrounds. In 1994, Azimi et al. ( 70 ) propose the two-dimensional BDLMS (Block Diagonal Least Mean Square) method. The weight matrix is updated once per block rather than once per pixel. The diagonal scanning is choosen to avoid the problems inherent in the one-dimensional (1D) standard scanning schemes. In 2009, Bae et al. ( 183 ) develop a mask-weighted TDLMS method that places the predicted pixel in the center of the masked prediction matrix. The method can obtain more neighborhood information than the conventional TDLMS. Nevertheless, the methods present problems related to the step-size adjustment of TDLMS ( 184 ; 185 ; 186 ) . First, Cao et al. ( 175 ) employ five prediction matrices to obtain the neighborhood information in order to compute the step size. The step size is a function of the variance of the four prediction values in the four directions. The step size is long near the changeable area such as the cloud edges and short in the homogeneous backgrounds. In the same idea, Bae et al. ( 176 ) employ a eight prediction matrices to obtain the neighborhood information improving the TDLMS algorithms by fully using the neighborhood information. This allow to determine whether the pixel is near the edge of the cloud or near the target. Thus, the step size near the edge of the cloud is increased and the step size near the target is reduced according to the neighborhood information. In a further work, Bae et al. ( 177 ) employ an edge directional 2D LMS filter to take advantage of edge information of prediction pixels corresponding to surrounding blocks around current filter window. To adjust adaptively the step size in the background and small target region, the adaptive region-dependent nonlinear step size is obtained with the variance of the prediction pixels of the surrounding blocks. This prediction structure and adaptive step size is then applied to the background region including objects such as cloud edge and small target region differently. Nevertheless, these above TDLMS filters can not detect small targets accurately. Moreover, their algorithms are time-consuming and do not perform well in real-time applications. To address these disadvantages, Zhao et al. ( 174 ) develop a bilateral filtering method. This method filters the images rightwards and leftwards and then fuses the prediction error images. Thus, the cloud edges and noise spots are eliminated sharply and the targets are significantly enhanced using the addition of the leftward filtering and fusing processes. Zhao et al. ( 174 ) also employ a selected, fixed step size and simplified filter structure to improve the computing speed. Experiments show that this algorithm provide better detection performance as well as competitive execution efficiency than the previous TDLMS algorithms.
blocks.zh: 1989年,Hadhoud和Thomas(173个)提出了二维适应性滤波器,这是一维最小平方(LMS)滤波器的延伸. 这种方法试图将预测响应和输出信号之间的平均平方误差最小化. 因此,TDLMS过滤器根据相邻像素的加权强度来预测像素强度. 预测出错在目标附近较大,而背景接近于零. 这是因为目标附近的像素的强度会迅速变化并难以准确预测. 相反,背景像素的强度是等同的,易于预测. 因此,TDLMS过滤器可以增强小目标并压制背景. 1994年,Azimi等(70人)提出了二维BDLMS(Block Diagonal Lind Mean Square)方法. 重量矩阵每块更新一次,而不是每像素更新一次. 选择对角扫描是为了避免一维(1D)标准扫描计划中固有的问题. 2009年,Bae等 (183)开发出口罩加权TDLMS方法,将所预测的像素置于口罩预测矩阵的中心. 该方法可以比传统的TDLMS获得更多的邻里信息. 然而,这些方法提出了与TDLMS(184;185;186)的分级调整有关的问题。 首先, 曹等编. (175)使用5个预测矩阵来获取邻里信息,以计算出台阶大小. 步长是四个方向上四个预测值相差的函数. 步相大小相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相去相相去相去相相去相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 在同一想法中,Bae等人(176人)使用8个预测矩阵来获取邻里信息,通过充分利用邻里信息来改进TDLMS算法. 这样可以确定像素是靠近云端还是接近目标. 因此,相邻相邻相邻的相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相相相相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相相邻相相邻相邻相邻相相邻相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 在进一步的工作中,Bae等人(177人)采用了边缘方向的2D LMS滤波器来利用预测像素的边缘信息来对应于当前滤波窗口周围的块. 为了适应地调整背景和小目标区域的相位大小,通过周围区块的预测像素相差得到相位区域依赖的相位非线性相位大小. 然后,这种预测结构和适应性步骤大小适用于背景区域,包括云边和小目标区域等物体。 尽管如此,上面这些TDLMS过滤器无法准确检测出小目标. 此外,他们的算法很耗时,在实时应用中表现不佳. 为解决这些缺点,赵等(174人)制定了双边过滤方法. 这种方法将图像向右和向左过滤,再将预测出的错误图像引信. 因此,云边和噪声斑被急剧地去除,并使用向左过滤和引信过程的加入来大大增强目标. Zhao等 (174) 也采用了有选择的固定步长和简化的滤波结构来提高计算速度. 实验表明,这种算法比之前的TDLMS算法提供了更好的检测性能和竞争性执行效率.

blocks.en: In summary, these methods are based on morphological filtering to detect targets by suppressing the background. These methods show good detection performance in the case of simple and uniform backgrounds.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,这些方法基于形态过滤来通过压制背景来检测目标. 这些方法在简单而统一的背景中显示出良好的检测性能.

blocks.en: 5.4 Saliency of Targets
blocks.zh: 5.4 目标的重要性

blocks.en: Human Visual System (HVS) methods assume that the target us the most salient object. These HVS based methods can be classified as follows: Local contrast methods ( 187 ; 188 ; 189 ; 190 ; 191 ; 192 ) and global contrast methods ( 193 ; 194 ; 195 ; 196 ; 197 ) . Their progress over time can be summarized as follows.
blocks.zh: 人类视觉系统(HVS)方法假设以我们为目标的最显著物体. 这些基于HVS的方法可以分类如下: 本地对比方法(187;188;189;190;191;192)和全球对比方法(193;194;195;196;197). 它们随着时间的推移所取得的进展可归纳如下。

blocks.en: 5.4.1 Local Contrast Methods
blocks.zh: 5.4.1 当地对比方法

blocks.en: Conventional HVS algorithms commonly employ the ratio of gray values between the target and the surrounding background to define the local contrast, as a means to obtain enhancement of the target and suppression of the background. In this idea, Chen et al. ( 190 ) propose in 2014 the Local Contrast Measure (LCM). In a further work, Han et al. ( 191 ) propose an Improved LCM (ICLM) detection algorithm based on HVS to achieve good performance in detection rate, and to reduce false alarm rate and speed simultaneously. First, an HVS size-adaptation process is employed, and the IR image after pre-processing is divided into sub-blocks to improve detection speed. Based on HVS contrast mechanism, the improved local contrast measure is employed to obtain the saliency map. Finally, a threshold operation along with a traversal mechanism based on HVS attention shift mechanism is employed to get the target sub-blocks. This algorithm based on HVS (i.e difference of Gaussians (DoG) filters) is sensitive to not only real small targets but also background edges, which results in a high false alarm rate. To address this problem, Han et al. ( 198 ) propose an improved DOG (IDoGb) filter. IDoGb is an extension of DoG but is sensitive to orientations and can better suppress the complex background edges. IDoGb achieves a lower false alarm rate and multi-scale detection can be also achieved. Experiments show that the IDoGb filter produces less false alarms than ICLM at the same detection rate, while consuming only about 0.1 0.1 s for a single frame. However, these methods use the absolute local contrast, which may not be effective in eliminating noise and high-brightness clutter. To address this issue, Han et al. ( 199 ) propose a Relative Local Contrast Measure (RLCM) to handle small targets of different sizes offering better effectiveness and robustness in complex background. In an other work, Wei et al. ( 200 ) incorporate the biological vision mechanism and design an algorithm called Multiscale Patch-based Contrast Measure (MPCM). The algorithm allows the simultaneous detection of bright and dark targets in infrared images. However, it exhibits relatively poor robustness in complex backgrounds with strong noise. In 2016, Deng et al. ( 201 ) design a Weighted Local Difference Measure (WLDM)-based scheme for the detection of small targets in various complex cloudy-sky backgrounds. First, a WLDM map allows to simultaneously enhance targets and suppress background clutters and noise. Thus, the true targets can be easily separated from jamming objects. Second, a simple adaptive threshold is used to segment the targets. In 2018, Gao et al. ( 202 ) employ multiscale gray and variance difference measures. A multiscale adaptive gray difference measure is first computed to enhance small targets and improve detection accuracy. Second, a multiscale variance difference measure allows to alleviate the impact of background fluctuation. By integrating these two approaches, targets can be extracted more accurately using a threshold-adaptive segmentation. In 2019, Qin et al. ( 202 ) propose a method based on Facet Kernel and Random Walker. First, local order-statistic and mean filtering are applied to remove the pixel-sized noises with high brightness and smooth the infrared images. The infrared image is filtered by the Facet kernel to enhance the target pixels. Candidate target pixels are then extracted by an adaptive threshold. Then, Qin et al. ( 203 ) define a Novel Local Contrast Descriptor (NLCD) to achieve clutter suppression and target enhancement. The candidate target pixels are selected as central pixels o obtain the local regions. The NLCD map of all local regions is weighted by the filtered map of Facet kernel to further enhance target. Finally, the target is detected by a thresholding operation on the weighted map.
blocks.zh: 常规 HVS算法通常采用目标与周围背景相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相 在这个想法中,Chen等人(190人)于2014年提出了地方对比度量衡(LCM). 在进一步的工作上,Han等 (191)提出了基于HVS的改进LCM(ICLM)检测算法,以在检测率上实现良好的性能,并同时降低假警报率和速度. 首先,采用了HVS大小适应过程,预处理后的IR图像被分出子块来提高检测速度. 基于HVS对比机制,采用了改进后的地方对比度量法来得到显要地图. 最后,采用了以HVS注意力转移机制为基础的阈值操作和转动机制来得到目标子块. 这种基于HVS(即高斯人(DoG)过滤器的相差)的算法不仅对真正的小目标敏感,而且对背景边缘也敏感,这导致了高假警报率. 为了解决这个问题,Han等人(198人)建议改进DOG(IDoGb)过滤器。 IDoGb是DOG的外延,但对取向敏感,能更好地压制复杂的背景边缘. IDoGb实现更低的假警报速率,也可以实现多尺度检测. 实验显示,IDoGb滤波器以相同的检测率产生比ICLM更少的假警报,而单帧只消耗了约0.1 s. 然而,这些方法使用绝对的局部对比,这在消除噪声和高亮相上可能并不有效. 为解决这一问题,韩等. (199)提出相对局部对比度量(RLCM),以处理不同规模的小型目标,在复杂的背景中提高效力和稳健性. 在另一作中出自"魏书"等. (200) 纳入生物视觉机制并设计一种算法,称为多尺度补丁对比度量法(MPCM)。 该算法允许在红外线图像中同时检测出明暗目标. 然而,它在复杂背景中表现出相对较差的坚韧性,有强烈的噪音. 2016年,邓等(201人)设计了以"加权局部差异度量衡"(WLDM)为主,用于检测各种复杂云层-天空背景的小目标. 首先,WLDM地图允许同时增强目标并抑制背景杂乱和噪音. 因此,真正的目标可以很容易地从干扰对象中分离出来. 第二,使用一个简单的适应阈值来划分目标。 2018年,高克等(202人)采用多比例的灰色和相差分量. 首先计算一个多尺度的适应性灰色差分量,以加强小目标并改进探测精度。 第二,采用多尺度差异计量法可以减轻背景波动的影响。 通过将这两种方法结合起来,可以更准确地利用阈值适应分解方法提取出目标. 2019年,秦等(202年)提出了基于Facet Kernel和Random Walker的方法. 首先,采用局部顺序-统计和平均滤波法来去除像素大小的有高亮度并平滑的红外线图像噪声. 红外线图像被Facet内核过滤来增强目标像素. 候选目标像素再由适应性阈值取出. 后出为秦等. (203)定义了"小说局部对比描述符"(NLCD),以达到拼接压制并增强目标. 候选目标像素被选为中心像素 o获得局部区域. 所有地區的NLCD地圖被Facet内核的滤波地圖加权以进一步提高目标. 最后,通过加权图上的阈值操作来检测出目标.

blocks.en: All these local contrast based methods adopt a sliding window with a two-layer structure, which restricts the computation of contrast features to a single scale at a time. However, several algorithms use multiscale windows to calculate the local contrast at various scales. The maximum value obtained from these calculations is selected as the final local contrast. For example, to achieve the best detection effect for targets of different sizes, the LCM algorithm uses four scales of sliding windows to traverse the image, and the sizes of the sub- windows are set to 3 × 3 3\times 3 , 5 × 5 5\times 5 , 7 × 7 7\times 7 and 9 × 9 9\times 9 , respectively. However, this increases the computational complexity and processing time. Furthermore, recent works published in 2026 are based on ring local contrast measure either with spatial–temporal prior ( 204 ) , with edge suppression ( 205 ) , with structure-aware weighted information ( 206 ) , or feature-guided discriminative mechanisms ( 207 ) .
blocks.zh: 所有这些以本地对比为基础的方法都采用了有双层结构的滑动窗口,这限制了一次对对比特征的计算,只局限于一个比分. 然而,有几种算法使用多尺度窗口来计算不同尺度的局部对比. 从这些计算中获得的最大值被选为本地的最终对比. 例如,为达到不同大小的目标的最佳检测效果,LCM算法使用四个滑动的窗口来翻转图像,子窗口的大小分别被设定为3×3 3相3相3相3相3相3相3相3相5相5相5相5相5相5相5相5相5相5相5相5相5相5相5相7相7相7相7相7相9相9相9相9相9相9相9相9相9相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 然而,这增加了计算的复杂性和处理时间. 此外,最近于2026年出版的作品采用环地对比测量法,有的采用空间-时序先(204个),有边缘压制(205个),有结构意识加权信息(206个),有的采用地貌引导的区别机制(207个)。

blocks.en: 5.4.2 Global Contrast Methods
blocks.zh: 5.4.2 全球对照方法

blocks.en:
A local contrast method can work well only when the target is locally prominent, which is not always the case when the background is very complex. In 2023, Tang et al. ( 193 ) design a fast infrared small target detection algorithm based on global contrast with a low computational time consumption. First, the original image is processed by dilate operation with a ring structuring element. Second the detection result is obtained with a Global Contrast Measure (GCM) between the original image and the processed image according to the ratio form and the difference form. But this method presents
limitations in background suppression and multi-target detection capabilities. To address these limitations, Tang et al. ( 194 ) develop a Multiscale Global Contrast Measure (MSGCM). Experiments show that MSGCM provides better performance than GCM with an average increase of 2.95 2.95 times in background suppression factor, 6.17 6.17 times in signal-to-clutter ratio gain for single-target detection, and 10.49 10.49 times for multi-target detection. To improve the multi-target detection capabilities, Tang et al. ( 195 ) employ a method based on Facet Global Contrast Measure (FGCM). In an other work, Xie et al. ( 196 ) propose an Improved Global Contrast Measure (IGCM). The original image is processed by dilate operation with a ring structuring element and mean operator with a square structuring element, respectively. Second, the improved global contrast measure is obtained by the two results above. IGCM provides an higher signal-to-clutter ratio and background suppression factor than the previous global contrast methods. In 2025, Han et al. ( 197 ) develop a True Global Contrast Measure (TGCM) in which its baseline is obtained by global decomposition. This method can handle situations where the target is not locally salient. A Gaussian filtering operation is employed to suppress noises, and a local max dilation is used on the separated baseline to maintain as much edge/corner information as possible. The residual information during decomposition are employed as a weighting function to further suppress clutters. In a further work, Han et al. ( 208 ) design a contrast method framework named Hybrid Contrast Measure (HCM). This framework consists of two main modules: a Relative Global Contrast Measure (RGCM), and a small patch local contrast weighting function. First, the sparse and low rank decomposition method is adopted to get the global background of a raw image as benchmark, and a Local Max Dilation (LMD) operation is applied on the global background to recover edge/corner information. Then, a Gaussian matched filtering operation is applied on the raw image to suppress noise. The RGCM is computed between the filtered image and the benchmark to enhance true small dim target and suppress flat background area simultaneously. Second, the Difference of Gaussians (DoG) filtering is employed and improved as the weighting function. Experiments show that RGCM presents robustness in presence of interference of high brightness background, complex edges/corners and random noises.
blocks.zh:
本地对比法只有在目标在当地突出时才能很好地发挥作用,背景非常复杂时并不总是如此. 2023年,唐等编. (193)基于全球对比和低计算时间消耗设计出快红外小目标探测算法. 首先,原始图像通过有环结构元素的拓扑操作处理. 其次,检测结果是根据比例表和差异表在原始图像和处理后图像之间采用全球对比度量(GCM)得到的。 但这种方法呈现
限制背景压制和多目标检测能力。 为解决这些局限性,Tang等. (194)制定多尺度全球对照措施。 实验显示,MSGCM的性能优于GCM,背景抑制因子平均增长2.95 2.95倍,单目标检测的信号-整数比增益为6.17 6.17倍,多目标检测为10.49 10.49倍. 为了提高多目标检测能力,Tang等人(195人)采用了基于Facet Global Contractors(FGCM)的方法。 在另一作中,谢等. (196)提议改进全球对照措施。 原始图像分别由带环状结构元件和有正方形结构元件的均匀操作处理. 第二,上述两项结果使全球对比度得到改进。 IGCM提供了比之前的全球对比法更高的信号相比和背景压制系数. 2025年,Han等人(197人)制定了真正的全球对照度量衡(TGCM),其基准通过全球分解得到. 这种方法可以处理目标在当地不突出的情况. 使用高斯滤波操作来抑制噪声,在分离基线上使用局部最大放大来尽可能地保持边缘/角信息. 分解过程中的残留信息被作为分量功能来进一步抑制杂质. 在后一作中,韩等. (208)设计一个对比法框架,命名为Hybrid Contractors (HCM). 这个框架由两个主要模块组成:相对全球对比度量衡(RGCM)和小补丁局部对比加权函数. 首先,采用稀疏和低等分解方法,以获得原始图像作为基准的全球背景,并在全球背景上应用"本地最大分解(LMD)"操作来回收边缘/角信息. 然后,在原始图像上应用高斯匹配过滤操作来抑制噪音. RGCM在被过滤的图像和基准之间进行计算,以加强真正的小暗目标并同时压制平坦的背景区域. 其次,高斯人(DoG)滤波法(Disition of Gaussians (DoG))被采用并被改进为权重功能. 实验显示,RGCM呈现出强力,存在高亮背景,复杂边缘/角和随机噪声等干扰.

blocks.en: 5.4.3 Transform Domain Methods
blocks.zh: 5.4.3 变相域方法

blocks.en: Transform domain methods often use a special transform such as Wavelet transform, Fourier transform, phase spectrum of quaternion Fourier transform (PQFT) and so on. Detection in complex backgrounds performs better in transform domain than in the spatial domain in spite of higher computation complexity ( 209 ) . These transform domain methods define a frequency difference between the background and the target in the transform domain, and obtain the detection by magnifying the measured difference. Because more details in an image imply higher phase information values in the transform domain, better detection results can be obtained by employing the phase information ( 209 ) . First, Qi et al. ( 210 ) employ Phase spectrum of Fourier transform (PFT) to enhance targets. Then, Qi et al. ( 211 ) present a method using a phase spectrum of quaternion Fourier transform (PQFT). In this model, the facet model allow to get four directional features which are employed to perform PQFT. The amplitude spectrum values are set to a constant value for each PQFT feature so that the saliency map consists of the inverse transform of the phase spectrum. Nevertheless, these two methods only employ the phase spectrum to recover signals, which will cause some information loss. It also lead to missed detection in the results. In an other approach, Yang et al. ( 212 ) design a method based on another direction feature. The filter is obtained by Gauss kernel function. Comparing with Fourier transform, cosine transform only performs on real even function and contains only real cosine terms. It is a real number of domain transformation. The actual signals are mostly in the real number domain, which conducts the Fourier transform very redundant. Moreover cosine transform allow to reduce computational complexity. According to these facts, Zhang et al. ( 209 ) develop a method based on spatial-temporal enhancement using quaternion Discrete Cosine Transform (QDCT). This method can support four channels, offering more information for DCT, whereas traditional DCT can only use gray information. Based on the fact that a small target often makes HVS have a higher response, the infrared small target detection is then formulated as a salient region detection problem in the transform domain.
blocks.zh: 变形域法经常会使用相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 复杂背景中的检测在转换域中比在空间域中做得更好,尽管计算复杂度较高(209)。 这些变相域法定义了变相域中背景与目标之间的频率差异,并通过放大所测出的差异来得到检测. 因为图像中的更多细节意味着变相域中更高的相相信息值,所以可以通过使用相相信息(209)来获得更好的检测结果. 首先, Qi等人(210人) Fourier变换(PFT)相位谱来增强目标. 后出为齐等. (211 )呈现出一种使用相相谱的四角管傅里叶变换(PQFT)的方法. 在这个模型中,面相模型允许获得四个方向特性,用于执行PQFT. 振幅频谱值被设定为每个PQFT特性的常数,使相位图由相相谱的反向变相组成. 尽管如此,这两种方法只使用相相谱来恢复信号,这会造成一些信息损失. 这也导致检测结果漏出. 在另一种方法中,杨等(212)根据另一个方向特征设计出一种方法. 过滤器由高斯内核函数获得. 与傅里叶变换相比,余弦变换只表现在真实的偶数函数上,只包含真实的余弦值. 这是真正的域变换。 实际信号大多位于实数域中,进行傅里叶变换非常冗余. 此外,余弦变换可以减少计算的复杂性。 根据这些事实,张等(209人)开发出一种基于空间-时态增强的方法,使用四分位分位离心变换(QDCT). 这种方法可以支持四个频道,为DCT提供更多信息,而传统的DCT只能使用灰色信息. 基于一个小目标常常使HVS有更高的响应,红外小目标探测随后被制定为变形域中突出的区域探测问题.

blocks.en: In summary, HVS methods in the spatial or frequency domain achieve better detection performance in complex scenes than filters-based methods. It is because they address the contrast between the background and the targets.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,空间或频率域中的HVS方法在复杂的场景中比以滤波器为基础的方法实现更好的检测性能. 这是因为它们涉及背景和目标之间的对比。

blocks.en: 5.5 Multi-Frame Detection
blocks.zh: 5.5 多引信探测

blocks.en: 5.6 Multi-Frame Cumulation Algorithms
blocks.zh: 5.6 多纤维聚变算法

blocks.en: In 2007, Yu ( 213 ) design a method based on higher-order cumulant. In 2016, Tang et al. ( 214 ) propose a similar approach based on morphology and high-order statistics. In 2017, Fan et al. ( 215 ) employ a self-adaptive caliber temporal-spatial filtering. The accumulated image obtained by these three algorithms ( 213 ; 214 ; 215 ) increases the number of accumulated frames. The target signal is enhanced but the streak noise is also enhanced. Because these three algorithms did not use the non-uniformity correction algorithm in the early stage, the background image still has more streak noise. The algorithm ( 213 ) only use employs the information of pixel points in time domain to estimate the background generating more noise in the difference image. The algorithm ( 215 ) only employs the information of the pixel points in the spatial domain for background estimation. Thus, it generates a difference map with partial noise. However, the algorithm ( 214 ) combines the spatial and temporal information of pixel points to estimate the background. It makes full use of the spatial and temporal information of the pixel and makes the target signal in the difference image preserved.
blocks.zh: 2007年,于(213人)以高阶积分为基础设计出一种方法. 2016年,唐等编著. (214)基于形态学和高序统计提出了类似的方法. 2017年,范等 (215人)采用自适应性口径的时空空间过滤. 这三种算法(213;214;215)得到的累积图像会增加累积帧的数量. 目标信号得到增强,但螺旋噪声也得到增强。 由于这三种算法在早期没有使用不相容的校正算法,背景图像仍然有较多的螺纹噪声. 算法 (213) 只使用时间域中像素点的信息来估计背景在相差图像中产生更多的噪音. 该算法 (215) 仅使用空间域中像素点的信息进行背景估计. 因此,它以部分噪声产生出不同的地图. 然而,算法(214)结合了像素点的时空信息来估计背景. 它充分利用了像素的空间和时间信息,并使得不同图像中的目标信号得以保存.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, Fan et al. ( 216 ) design in 2019 a non-uniform correction method of ring perturbation in sequence images. This method removes the non-uniformity of images. Then, a multi-frame cumulation technique enhances the dim targets. A Poisson distribution is employed to obtain candidate target images and a high-order cumulant allows to extract effective targets. Thus, the motion estimation is achieved on the dim target to make accumulation along the estimated direction. Experiments demonstrate that this ring perturbation correction method enhances the local signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of dim small targets and provides better detection results than other algorithms ( 213 ; 214 ; 215 ) , and can effectively detect dim small targets in strong clutter background
blocks.zh: 为解决这些局限性,Fan等. (216 ) 2019年设计出环向扰动序列图像的非统一校正方法. 这种方法可以去除图像的不相容性. 然后,一种多帧的累积技术可以增强阴暗的目标. 使用Poisson配发软件获取候选目标图像,高序积分可提取出有效目标。 因此,运动估计是在暗目标上实现的,以便沿着估计的方向积累。 实验证明,这种环扰校正方法能增强暗小目标局部信号-噪声比(SNR),比起其他算法(213;214;215)提供更好的检测结果,并能在强烈的杂交背景下有效检测暗小目标.

blocks.en: In 2017, Fan et al. ( 217 ) employs an Improved Anisotropy for Background Prediction (IABP) with a target enhancement based on High-Order Cumulates (HOC). A sequential image energy center detection algorithm integrates the neighborhood, continuity, area, and energy and other motion characteristics of the target. Experiments demonstrate that IABP provides a superior overall performance compared to previous background prediction methods increasing the signal-noise ratio of images.
blocks.zh: 2017年,范等编. (217) 采用了一种改进后的背景预测异同位素(IABP),其目标增强基于高号积分(HOC). 相继的图像能中心检测算法将目标周围,连续性,面积,能和其他运动特性相融合. 实验表明,IABP与先前的背景预测方法相比,提供了优异的整体性能,提高了图像的信号-噪声比.

blocks.en: 5.7 Miscellaneous Algorithms
blocks.zh: 5.7 杂项 算法

blocks.en: In 2004, Peng et al. ( 218 ) design a strategy based on various nonlinear features that are representative of dim targets. An information fusion algorithm by Karhunen-Loeve (KL) transform is employed to obtain an integrated feature. In 2014, in the context of maritime scenes, Wang et al. ( 219 ) propose a pipeline-filtering algorithm with self-adaptive anti-vibration abilities. First, the inter-frame vibration of sequence images is acquired in real time within the block matching method that combines the normalized cross-correlations coefficient with the normalized mutual information. Second, it is used to correct coordinates at the single-frame level Third, the corrected detection results allows to complete the pipeline-filtering. Experiments show that the algorithm can handle the challenge of inter-frame vibration of sequence images achieving accurate detection of small maritime targets.
blocks.zh: 2004年,彭等编著. (218)基于各种非线性特征设计出一种代表暗目标的战略. 采用了由Karhunen-Loeve (KL)变换而来的信息聚变算法,以获得一个综合特性. 2014年,以出海场景为背景,王等(219人)提出有自适应抗振能力的管道滤波算法. 首先,序列图像的帧间振动是在组合比对方法内实时获得的,该比对方法结合了已归正的相交系数和已归正的相通信息. 第二,它用于更正单帧三级坐标,经过校正的检测结果可以完成管道过滤. 实验显示,该算法能够处理序列图像的帧间振动所带来的挑战,从而实现对小型海上目标的精确检测.

blocks.en: In 2018, Liu et al. ( 220 ) develop a method based on flux density and direction diversity in gradient vector field. First, the infrared image is transformed to the Infrared Gradient Vector Field (IGVF). Second, a multiscale flux density (MFD) quantifies the extent of sink point character. In the MFD map, the small targets are enhanced and background clutters are suppressed. Third, a Gradient Direction Diversity (GDD) is employed. The residual noise due to the heavy clutter is suppressed by GDD. Finally, an adaptive threshold allows to separate the targets. Experiments show that IGVF outperforms previous SOTA methods in complex background clutter.
blocks.zh: 2018年,刘等. (220)根据通量密度和梯度矢量领域的方向多样性,开发出一种方法. 首先,红外线图像被转换为红外梯度矢量场(IGVF). 第二,多尺度通量密度(MFD)可以将沉积点字符的范围量化. 在MFD地图中,小目标被增强并被压制了背景杂乱. 第三,采用渐进方向多样性。 由重杂交所引起残留噪音被GDD抑制. 最后,一个适应性阈值允许将目标分开。 实验显示,IGVF在复杂的背景杂乱中比之前的SOTA方法表现得更好.

blocks.en: 6 Low-rank and Sparse Decomposition Unsupervised Models
blocks.zh: 6 低等和分解无监督模式

blocks.en: Low-rank plus Sparse matrix Decomposition (LRSD) models is a dominant model-based approach in infrared small target detection. The LRSD model is also called Robust Principal Component Analysis (RPCA) introduced in 2009 by Candès et al ( 67 ) to handle robustly sparse outliers in observed data. The original decomposition was extended to three terms decomposition (i.e low-rank matrix, sparse matrix and noise matrix) in 2010 by Zhou et al. ( 316 ) . This version of RPCA is also known as stable RPCA in literature. Furthermore, the decomposition has been also extended in the tensor domain ( 317 ) to take into account explicitly the spatio-temporal constraints. However, the LRSD model has also proven this efficiency in the close field of moving objects detection for video-surveillance ( 318 ) by offering the possibility of spatio-temporal algorithms ( 319 ; 320 ; 321 ) , incremental algorithms ( 322 ; 323 ; 324 ) crucial for real-time applications, and deep unrolled RPCA methods ( 325 ; 326 ; 327 ) . The rise and success of the LRSD models for infrared small target detection are based on the fact that it offers a rigorous mathematical foundation by jointly optimizing the nuclear norm (background regularization) and l 1 l_{1} -norm in contrast to filtering methods for background suppression or human visual-inspired contrast enhancement techniques. Moreover, the convex optimization framework demonstrates robustness when handling complex dynamic infrared backgrounds, and variable-sized targets across heterogeneous environments. The progress of LRSD methods in infrared small target detection follows a similar scheme that the one developed in moving object detection but using designed algorithms for the challenges met in IRSTD. The reader can refer to surveys ( 328 ; 329 ; 330 ; 331 ) and the DLAM website 11 11 11 https://sites.google.com/site/robustdlam/ for a list of representative fundamental papers about RPCA.

Candès等人(67人)于2009年推出的LRSD模型也称为 " Robust主要组件分析 " (RPCA),目的是在观测到的数据中处理非常稀疏的外出点。 原分解由周来等(316)于2010年被扩展为分解为分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分解分分解分解分分分分分分分分分解分分解分分解分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分 这个版本的RPCA在文学中也被称为"稳定的RPCA". 此外,分解还被扩展到拉诺域(317 ),以明确考虑到斯皮提奥-时空的制约. 然而,LRSD模型也通过提供斯皮提奥-时态算法(319;320;321),对实时应用至关重要的增量算法(322;323;324),和深层无滚动的RPCA方法(325;326;327)的可能性,证明了移动物体探测视频监视(318)的近距离领域的效率. 红外小目标探测的 LRSD 模型的兴起和成功是基于这样一个事实,即它通过共同优化核规范(背景规范化)和l 1 l_{1}提供了严格的数学基础. - 与背景压制或人类视觉启发的对比度增强技术的过滤方法形成对比。 此外,对流优化框架在处理复杂的动态红外背景和不同环境的可变大小目标时显示出坚固性。 红外小目标探测中LRSD方法的进度遵循了一种类似的方案,即一种在移动物体探测中开发但使用所设计的算法处理IRSTD中遇到的挑战. 读者可参考调查(328;329;330;331)和DLAM网站 11 11 https://sites.google.com/site/robustdlam/,作为RPCA的代表性基本论文列表.

blocks.en: 6.1 Mathematical Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 6.1 数学基础

blocks.en:
Candès et al. ( 67 ) proposed a convex optimization to address the robust PCA problem also called LRSD. The observation matrix A A is assumed represented as: A = L + S A=L+S (1) where L L is a low-rank matrix and S S must be sparse matrix with a small fraction of nonzero entries. The straightforward formulation is to use l 0 l_{0} -norm to minimize the energy function: min L , S ​ r ​ a ​ n ​ k ​ ( L ) + λ ​ ‖ S ‖ l 0 ​ subj ​ A − L − S = 0 \underset{L,S}{\text{min}}~~rank(L)+\lambda||S||_{l_{0}}~~~\text{subj}~~~A-L-S=0 (2) where λ > 0 \lambda>0 is an arbitrary balanced parameter.
But this problem is N ​ P NP -hard, typical solution might involve a search with combinatorial complexity. This research seeks to solve for L L with the following optimization problem: min L , S ​ ‖ L ‖ ∗ + λ ​ ‖ S ‖ l 1 ​ subj ​ A − L − S = 0 \underset{L,S}{\text{min}}~~||L||_{*}+\lambda||S||_{l_{1}}~~~\text{subj}~~~A-L-S=0 (3) where | | . | | ∗ ||.||_{*} and | | . | | l 1 ||.||_{l_{1}} are the nuclear norm (which is the l 1 l_{1} -norm of singular value) and l 1 l_{1} -norm, respectively, and λ > 0 \lambda>0 is an arbitrary balanced parameter. Usually, λ = 1 m ​ a ​ x ​ ( m , n ) \lambda=\frac{1}{\sqrt{max(m,n)}} . Under these minimal assumptions, this approach called Principal Component Pursuit (PCP) solution perfectly recovers the low-rank and the sparse matrices.

blocks.en:
The low-rank minimization concerning L L offers a suitable framework for background due to the correlation between frames. So, minimizing L L and S S implies that the background is approximated by a low-rank subspace that can gradually change over time, while
the targets constitute the correlated sparse outliers which are contained in S S . To obtain the target mask, S S needs to be thresholded. The threshold is determined experimentally. r ​ a ​ n ​ k ​ ( L ) rank(L) influences the number of modes of the background that can be represented by L L : If r ​ a ​ n ​ k ​ ( L ) rank(L) is to high, the model will incorporate the targets in its representation; if the r ​ a ​ n ​ k ​ ( L ) rank(L) is to low, the model tends to be uni-modal and then the multi-modality which appears in complex backgrounds will be not captured. The quality of target detection is directly related to the assumption of the low-rank and sparsity of the background and targets, respectively.
In this case, the best separation is then obtained only when the optimization algorithm has converged. Essentially, the nuclear-norm term corresponds to low-frequency components along the temporal while the l 1 l_{1} norm describes the high-frequency components. 关于LL的低级别最小化为背景提供了一个合适的框架,因为框架之间相互关联。 因此,将LL和S最小化意味着背景被一个低等亚空间所相近,该空间可以随时间而逐渐变化,同时
这些目标构成了S.S.所载的相关稀有外源。 要获得目标口罩,S需要被阈值. 阈值通过实验确定. r a n k (L) 级(L) 影响可以用 L L 表示的背景模式数 : 如果r n k (L) 级(L) 至高,该模型将把目标纳入其代表;如果r n k (L) 级(L) 至 低,则该模型倾向于单模式,然后将不捕捉出现在复杂背景中的多模式。 目标检测的质量直接关系到对背景和目标的低等和收缩的假设.
在这种情况下,只有在优化算法已趋同时,才能得到最好的分离. 基本上,核规范术语与时间沿线的低频组件相对应,而l 1 l_{1}规范则描述了高频组件. 图4说明了观察到的矩阵AA被分解为低等矩阵L和稀有矩阵S。

blocks.en:
The key characteristics of the LRSD problem formulations are the following ones: 1. Decomposition: The form of the decomposition can be implicit or explicit. Furthermore, this decomposition can be made in two ( 67 ) or three ( 316 ) terms. Thus, all the decompositions can be written in a general formulation as follows: A = ∑ k = 1 K M k = M 1 + M 2 + M 3 = L + S + E A=\sum_{k=1}^{K}M_{k}=M_{1}+M_{2}+M_{3}=L+S+E (4) with K ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 } K\in\left\{1,2,3\right\} . The matrix A A can be corrupted by outliers where matrix M 1 = L M_{1}=L is a low-rank matrix, the second matrix M 2 M_{2} is an unconstrained (residual) matrix. M 2 M_{2} is a sparse matrix S S in explicit decomposition. The third matrix M 3 M_{3} is generally the noise matrix E E . The noise can be modeled by a Gaussian, a mixture of Gaussians (MoG) or a Laplacian distribution. 2. Minimization problem: The problem of the decomposition seeks to a minimization problem written in its original form or its Lagrangian form. Practically, the minimization problem is viewed as an optimization problem which can be convex or not. More specifically, the minimization problem seeks to the following optimization problem: F ⁡ ( X ) = f ⁡ ( x ) + g ⁡ ( x ) F(X)=f(x)+g(x) where we have: f ⁡ ( x ) = λ 0 2 ​ ‖ A − L − S − E ‖ n ​ o ​ r ​ m 0 p 0 f(x)=\frac{\lambda_{0}}{2}||A-L-S-E||_{norm_{0}}^{p_{0}} (5) g ⁡ ( x ) = λ 1 ​ | | L | | n ​ o ​ r ​ m 1 p 1 + λ 2 ​ ‖ S ‖ n ​ o ​ r ​ m 2 p 2 + λ 3 | ​ | E | | n ​ o ​ r ​ m 3 p 3 g(x)=\lambda_{1}||L||_{norm_{1}}^{p_{1}}+\lambda_{2}||S||_{norm_{2}}^{p_{2}}+\lambda_{3}||E||_{norm_{3}}^{p_{3}} (6) where we have: (a) f ⁡ ( x ) f(x) is smooth and convex function which has Lipschitz continuous gradients. f ⁡ ( x ) f(x) contains the loss function. (b) g ⁡ ( x ) g(x) can be a nonsmooth and nonconvex function. g ⁡ ( x ) g(x) contains the low-rank regularizer, the sparse regularizer and the noise regularizer. Equation 6 can be written as follows: min L , S ​ λ 1 ​ ‖ L ‖ n ​ o ​ r ​ m 1 p 1 + λ 2 ​ ‖ S ‖ n ​ o ​ r ​ m 2 p 2 + λ 3 ​ ‖ E ‖ n ​ o ​ r ​ m 3 p 3 ​ subj ​ C \underset{L,S}{\text{min}}~~\lambda_{1}||L||_{norm_{1}}^{p_{1}}+\lambda_{2}||S||_{norm_{2}}^{p_{2}}+\lambda_{3}||E||_{norm_{3}}^{p_{3}}~~~\text{subj}~~~C (7) where the λ i \lambda_{i} are the regularization parameters. C C is a constraint on A A , L L , S S and E E . 3. Regularization Terms/Loss Functions: Loss functions are used for the minimization term, and the regularized functions are used to enforce the low-rank, sparse and noise constraints on L L , S S and E E , respectively. They are needed to solve the minimization problem. In literature, most of the time, the authors do not distinguish "loss functions" and "regularized functions", and they use them indifferently. In this paper, the regularized functions are respectively noted f l ​ o ​ w ​ ( ) f_{low}() , f s ​ p ​ a ​ r ​ s ​ e ​ ( ) f_{sparse}() and f n ​ o ​ i ​ s ​ e ​ ( ) f_{noise}() , and we only use the term "loss functions". Thus, several loss functions can be used to enforce the constraints on each matrix which composes the decomposition. Most of the time, proxy loss functions are used as surrogate of the original loss functions (rank() and l 0 l_{0} -norm) to obtain a solvable problem. The surrogate lost functions present the main advantage that they allow to reach to a solvable convex problem but their use can present main advantages/disadvantages as follows: (a) The nuclear loss function is the surrogate proposed by Candès et al. values. Weighted ( 333 ) and partial-sum tensor ( 159 ) variants address this limitation. The Frobenius norm ( ∥ ⋅ ∥ F \|\cdot\|_{F} ) is defined as follows: ‖ 𝐋 ‖ F = ∑ i , j l i ​ j 2 , \|\mathbf{L}\|_{F}=\sqrt{\sum_{i,j}l_{ij}^{2}}, (9) where b i ​ j b_{ij} denotes the ( i , j ) (i,j) -th element of 𝐁 \mathbf{B} .
A valid proxy for the nuclear norm ( 332 ; 334 ) , but fails to recover the low-rank matrix without a rank estimate and exhibits poor suppression of strong background edges ( 335 ) . (c) The l 1 l_{1} -loss function also known as least absolute deviations (LAD) or least absolute errors (LAE) is robust to outliers but it is not stable and do not reach to a unique solution. In addition, it may be suboptimal, since the l 1 l_{1} -norm is a loose approximation of the l 0 l_{0} -norm and often leads to an over-penalized problem. Furthermore, l 1 l_{1} -loss function cannot handle collinearity. The ℓ 1 \ell_{1} -norm is defined as follows: ‖ 𝐒 ‖ 1 = ∑ i , j | s i ​ j | , \|\mathbf{S}\|_{1}=\sum_{i,j}|s_{ij}|, (10) where t i ​ j t_{ij} denotes the ( i , j ) (i,j) -th element of 𝐒 \mathbf{S} .

Errors (LAE), this norm is robust to outliers but unstable, yields
no unique solution, cannot handle collinearity, and over-penalises
sparse components as a loose approximation of ∥ ⋅ ∥ 0 \|\cdot\|_{0} ( 332 ) . A weighted variant better preserves
target energy ( 336 ) . (d) The l 2 l_{2} -loss function is sensitive to outliers and missing data but it is stable and reach always to one solution. More robust than ℓ 1 \ell_{1} to correlated background edges and
clutter residuals ( 336 ) . (e) The l p l_{p} -loss function is more general than the l 2 l_{2} -loss function. The ℓ p \ell_{p} -norm ( 0 < p < 1 0<p<1 ) is defined as follows. ‖ 𝐒 ‖ p = ( ∑ i , j | s i ​ j | p ) 1 / p . \|\mathbf{S}\|_{p}=\Bigl(\sum_{i,j}|s_{ij}|^{p}\Bigr)^{1/p}. The Least Squares (LS) is defined as follows: ℒ LS = ‖ 𝐀 − 𝐋 − 𝐒 ‖ F 2 , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{LS}}=\|\mathbf{A}-\mathbf{L}-\mathbf{S}\|_{F}^{2}, (13) where 𝐀 \mathbf{A} is the observed infrared image. yielding a unique closed-form solution, but highly sensitive to
outliers and missing data ( 332 ) . For the computational point of view, l 1 l_{1} -norm does not have an analytical solution, but l 2 l_{2} -norm does. Thus, l 2 l_{2} -norm problems can be solved computationally efficiently. l 1 l_{1} -norm solutions can take into account the sparsity properties which allows it to be used for sparse constraints, which makes the computation more efficient than the l 0 l_{0} -norm ( 338 ) . 4. Solvers: Algorithms which are called solvers are then used to solve the optimization problem. Furthermore, instead of directly solving the original convex optimizations, some authors use their strongly convex approximations in order to design efficient algorithms. The key challenges related to the solvers are the following ones: (a) Choice of the solver to make the iterations as few as possible. (b) Choice of the SVD algorithm to make the iterations as efficient as possible. The solvers can be broadly classified into two categories as follows: (a) Regularization based approaches: The decomposition is formulated as regularized fitting, where the
regularizers are convex surrogates for rank and sparsity. Examples of algorithms in this category include the following solvers: Singular Value Thresholding (SVT), the Accelerated Proximal Gradient (APG) , and the Augmented Lagrange Multiplier (ALM). (b) Statistical inference based approaches: Hierarchical statistical models are used to model the data generation process and prior distributions are selected to capture the low-rank and sparse properties of the respective terms. The joint distribution involving the observations, unknown variables and hyperparameters can be determined from the priors and conditional distributions. Posterior distributions of the unknown variables are approximated using Bayesian inference approaches.

blocks.en: Decomposition: The form of the decomposition can be implicit or explicit. Furthermore, this decomposition can be made in two ( 67 ) or three ( 316 ) terms. The matrix A A can be corrupted by outliers where matrix M 1 = L M_{1}=L is a low-rank matrix, the second matrix M 2 M_{2} is an unconstrained (residual) matrix. M 2 M_{2} is a sparse matrix S S in explicit decomposition. The third matrix M 3 M_{3} is generally the noise matrix E E . The noise can be modeled by a Gaussian, a mixture of Gaussians (MoG) or a Laplacian distribution.

blocks.en:
Solvers: Algorithms which are called solvers are then used to solve the optimization problem. Furthermore, instead of directly solving the original convex optimizations, some authors use their strongly convex approximations in order to design efficient algorithms. The key challenges related to the solvers are the following ones: (a) Choice of the solver to make the iterations as few as possible. (b) Choice of the SVD algorithm to make the iterations as efficient as possible. The solvers can be broadly classified into two categories as follows: (a) Regularization based approaches: The decomposition is formulated as regularized fitting, where the
regularizers are convex surrogates for rank and sparsity. Examples of algorithms in this category include the following solvers: Singular Value Thresholding (SVT), the Accelerated Proximal Gradient (APG) , and the Augmented Lagrange Multiplier (ALM). (b) Statistical inference based approaches: Hierarchical statistical models are used to model the data generation process and prior distributions are selected to capture the low-rank and sparse properties of the respective terms. The joint distribution involving the observations, unknown variables and hyperparameters can be determined from the priors and conditional distributions. Posterior distributions of the unknown variables are approximated using Bayesian inference approaches.

blocks.en: 6.1.1 Definition and Classifications of Outliers
blocks.zh: 6.1.1 外部的定义和分类

blocks.en:
The aim of RPCA is to be robust to outliers in the context of big data. Thus, the notion of outliers needs to be defined. Outliers can be defined as arbitrarily large valued measurements which do not characterize the true data samples. Practically, outliers can be viewed as observations or values that are considerably different from the majority of the data and usually follow heavy-tailed distribution by assuming that the unobservable noise have a fast-decaying Gaussian probability
distribution. As the observed examples are stacked as rows (or columns) in a data matrix, either some of the entries may be affected by 1) additive outliers (positive or negative values) or missing data, or 2) entire rows (or columns) are corrupted. Thus, outliers can be classified by considering their location in the observation matrix A A as follows: 1. Element-wise outliers/noise. 2. Row-wise or column-wise outliers/noise. 3. Missing data: They can be due to an acquisition problem. The shape of outliers varies according the observed data ( 339 ) . In infrared small target detection, the outliers are the values corresponding to the target and the values corresponding to the background are the inliers. The outliers corresponding to the targets are element-wise outliers because of their size.
blocks.zh:
RPCA的目的是在大数据中坚挺到外出. 因此,需要界定外部因素的概念。 外部值可以被定义为任意的大型价值计量,而这种计量并不是真实数据样本的特征。 实际上,外观者可被视作观测值或数值,它们与大多数数据相去甚远,通常通过假设无法观测到的噪声有快速衰减的高斯概率来跟随重尾分布.

blocks.en: 6.1.2 Application to Infrared Small Target Detection
blocks.zh: 6.1.2 红外小目标探测应用

blocks.en:
The adequacy of low-rank and sparse decomposition with the infrared small target detection relies on specific constraints not present in the basic assumptions of the first work published in 2011. These constraints are its robustness to noise, the spatial and temporal constraints, the need of real-time implementations, and the ability to deal with the challenges met in infrared imaging sequences. In practice, researchers have proposed adaptations low-rank and sparse decomposition which attempt to take into account these specific constraints by acting on its key characteristics (i.e decomposition, formulation of the minimization problem, loss functions solvers). blocks.en: Thus, the various LRSD based methods for infrared small target detection follow the same scheme and their changes are related to the decomposition, the minimization problem, the loss functions and the solvers. These changes have improved over time the suitability of the LRSD framework for infrared small target detection by addressing its challenges as possible. Table 6 , Table 7 and Table 8 provide an overview comparison of the diverse matrix decomposition methods according to these criteria while Table 10 and Table 11 gives an overview of various tensor decomposition methods.
blocks.zh: 因此,红外小目标探测的各种基于LRSD的方法都遵循同样的方案,它们的改变与分解,最小化问题,损失函数和解子有关. 这些变化随着时间的推移,通过尽可能应对其挑战,提高了LRSD框架对红外小目标探测的适宜性. 表6、表7和表8根据这些标准对不同的矩阵分解方法进行了总体比较,而表10和表11则概述了各种分解法。

blocks.en: Section 6.2 reviews the single-frame detection using matrix representations highlighting their progress over time. Section 6.3 reviews sparse representation models. Section 6.4 surveys the multiple-frame detection using tensor representations. Note that even if data are either stacked in a matrix or tensor manner, the spatial and temporal information are kept in both case. However, it is only how the data are used that determines if the method is a single-frame or multi-frame one. In addition, the matrix stockage conducts naturally to not exploit the spatial information and to exploit only the temporal information whilst the tensor format induces to exploit both the spatial and temporal information.
blocks.zh: 第6.2节利用矩阵说明来审查单帧探测,强调其随着时间的推移所取得的进展。 第6.3节审查了少数代表模式。 第6.4节利用拉伸表示法调查多帧探测。 请注意,即使数据以矩阵方式或高压方式堆放,在这两种情况下空间和时间信息都保留。 然而,只有如何使用数据才能确定该方法是单帧还是多帧。 此外,矩阵种群自然不会利用空间信息,只利用时间信息,而热量格式则诱导利用空间和时间信息。

blocks.en: 6.2 Single-Frame Detection
blocks.zh: 6.2 单纤维检测

blocks.en: Single-frame detection using LRSD method are the methods that employ the matrix representation. Each image is stocked as a column of the observed matrix A A . Even if A A contains multiple frames, the temporal aspects is not explicity exploited for the detection.
blocks.zh: 使用LRSD方法的单帧检测是使用矩阵表示的方法. 每个图像被储存在观测到的矩阵A A的一栏中。 即使A包含多帧,时间方面也没有被明确用于探测.

blocks.en: In 2012, Gao et al. ( 332 ) propose the Infrared Patch-Image (IPI) model using the local self-correlation property of the global background patches. First, patch-images are constructed by using a window sliding from left and top to right and bottom in an image. Second, the target-background separation problem is reformulated as an optimization problem of recovering low-rank and sparse matrices. The most advantage of the IPI model is that it fits the reality well. Indeed, the low-rank assumption for the background patch-image is also commonly valid because the property of nonlocal self-correlation exists universally in infrared background images. Moreover, since the target size is small enough comparing with the original image size, the sparse assumption for the target patch-image is valid for almost all scenes. In practice, the IPI model present several weaknesses addressed by further works regarding the decomposition, the loss functions, the solver and the computation time. These improvements can be categorized as done in the following sub-sections and Table 5 shows an overview classification of the diverse existing LRSD matrix methods applied to infrared small target detection.
blocks.zh: 2012年,高等(332人)提出红外补丁-图像(IPI)模式,使用全球背景补丁的自相通地产. 首先,补丁图像是通过一个窗口在图像中从左上上下滑动来构建的. 第二,目标背景分离问题被重新确定为恢复低等和稀有矩阵的优化问题。 IPI模型的最大优势在于它非常符合现实. 的确,对背景补丁-图像的低等假设也是通常有效的,因为非局部自相通的属性普遍存在于红外线背景图像中. 此外,由于目标大小与原始图像大小相比足够小,因此目标补丁-图像的稀有假设对几乎所有场景都有效. 在实践中,IPI模型提出了关于分解、损失函数、解决器和计算时间等进一步工作所处理的若干弱点。 这些改进可按以下分节中所做的分类,表5对红外小目标探测所采用的多种现有LRSD矩阵方法进行了总体分类.

blocks.en: 6.2.1 Computation Time
blocks.zh: 6.2.1 计算时间

blocks.en: The computation time limitation can be addressed by using surrogate loss function requiring less iteration in the optimization problem. In view of time-consuming problem in nuclear-norm minimization using singular value decomposition, Zheng and Li ( 380 ) employ the Sobolev norm instead of the nuclear-norm, and thus a small target detection method based on harmonic and sparse matrix decomposition was proposed reducing the computation time. In an other way, Li et al. ( 381 ) develop a compressive low-rank and sparse decomposition method in which the constant r r and K K denote the low-rank of background and sparse of target, respectively. Then, the Walsh Hadamard matrix was chosen as the measurement matrix.
blocks.zh: 计算时间限制可以通过使用在优化问题上需要较少重复的代位损失函数来解决. 鉴于使用单值分解来将核规范最小化需要耗费时间,郑和李(380人)采用索博列夫规范来代替核规范,因此建议采用以口琴和稀有矩阵分解为基础的小型目标检测方法来缩短计算时间. 另一种方式是,Li等(381人)发展出压缩低等分解和稀有分解方法,其中常数r和KK分别表示背景分级低和指标分级稀疏. 随后,Walsh Hadamard矩阵被选为测量矩阵.

blocks.en: 6.2.2 l1-norm Defects

Because of the defect of l 1 l_{1} -norm based sparsity measure, the IPI model falls in a dilemma where either over-shrinks the dim targets or preserves the strong edges in the target image. As the l 1 l_{1} -norm is applied on the sparse component related to the target, changing this norm and adding constraints can increase the accuracy of the target detection. To suppress the strong edges while preserving the dim targets, Dai et al. ( 348 ) propose a Weighted Infrared Patch-Image (WIPI) model, incorporating structural prior information into the separation process. The WIPI model is formulated as a Column-wise Weighted RPCA (CWRPCA) problem. In addition, a target unlikelihood coefficient is designed based on the steering kernel, serving as the adaptive weight for each column. To solve the CWPRCA problem, Dai et al. ( 348 ) design an Alternating Direction Method (ADM). Nevertheless, calculating the structural prior brings additional computing time.
blocks.zh: 由于l1 l_{1}-以平面为主的平面平面度量的缺陷,IPI模型陷入了两难境地,要么过度收缩暗地目标,要么保留了目标图像中的强边. 由于l 1 lQQQ 1} - 规范被应用于与目标相关的稀有组件上,改变这个规范并增加限制可以提高目标检测的准确性. 为了在保留阴暗目标的同时压制强边,戴等. (348)提出"重心红外补丁-图像"(WIPI)模式,将结构前置信息纳入分离过程. WIPI模型是作为一个列式加权RPCA(CWRPCA)问题制定的. 此外,基于方向内核设计出一个目标偏差系数,作为每个列的适应权重. 为解决CWPRCA问题,戴等. (348 ) 设计一种替代方向法(ADM). 尽管如此,计算结构前置会带来额外的计算时间.

blocks.en:
In 2019, Zhou et al. ( 342 ) propose a Graph-Regularized Laplace Low-rank Approximation model (GRLA) to reduce high false or missing alarm when encountering the background with intricate interferences. GRLA is extended to a generalized framework name G-GRLA by replacing different non-convex rank functions. Employing an ADMM algorithm, the solution is obtained by an iterative optimization scheme. But GLRA exploit only the spatial information and ignore the structural priors across feature space.
To address this limitation, Zhou et al. ( 343 ) propose a LRSD model combining the spatial-feature graph regularization and l 1 / 2 l_{1/2} -norm sparse constraint. The spatial and feature regularizations are imposed on the sparse component in the form of graph Laplacians where the sparse component is enforced as the eigenvectors of their graph Laplacian matrices. This method allows to take into account the geometric information in both data and feature space simultaneously. The l 1 / 2 l_{1/2} -norm acts as a surrogate of l 1 l_{1} -norm to constrain the sparse component reducing the false positive detection. Zhou et al. ( 343 ) employ a Linearized Alternating Direction Method with Adaptive Penalty (LADMAP) for optimization algorithm. This method based on Dual-Graph Regularization Low-rank Approximation (DGRLA) is more robust in the presence of complex scenes with cloudy clutter, sea glitter, and man-made interference than IPI ( 332 ) and GRLA ( 342 ) .

In 2022, Wan et al. ( 345 ) propose to use the interframe similarity of target appearance in order to impose
a temporal consistency constraint on the target matrix. A TV regularization term is also employed to alleviate the false
detection generated by noise. To solve the problem, an alternating optimization algorithm using singular value decomposition (SVD) and accelerated proximal gradient (APG) is employed. Experiments show that TV-IIPI outperforms IPI ( 332 ) , ECA-STT ( 402 ) and PSTNN ( 159 ) in the case of sea and ground scenes. In 2023, Shao et al. ( 338 ) employ the l 1 l_{1} and l 2 l_{2} ( l 1 l_{1} – l 2 l_{2} ) norm and total variation (TV) to constraint the sparse component. The l 1 l_{1} – l 2 l_{2} norm allows to separate the target from the complex backgrounds while the total variation norm allows to suppress the sparse clutters. Experiments show that the l 1 l_{1} – l 2 l_{2} norm-TV outperforms IPI ( 332 ) , NOLC ( 337 ) , NRAM ( 336 ) . Zhou et al. ( 344 ) propose a Learned Masked Robust Principal Component Analysis (LMRPCA) algorithm for single-frame infrared small target detection. First, the original images are constructed into patch images, which are separated into low-rank and sparse components corresponding to the backgrounds and foreground masks. The optimization function is solved by an DMM method which is mapped to trainable convolutional layers. More specifically, LMRPCA employs elements of convolutional sparse coding to improve representation learning for foreground masks and side information in the auxiliary transform domain. Thus, Zhou et al. ( 344 ) assign learnable weights to different feature maps with a reweighted l 1 − l 1 l_{1}-l_{1} minimization. Experiments show that LMRPCA outperforms PSTNN ( 159 ) and DNA-Net ( 148 ) .

Zhou等人(344人)提议采用 " 有学识的马斯克德机器人主要组件分析 " (LMRPCA)算法进行单帧红外小目标探测。 首先,原始图像被构建成补丁图像,这些图像被分隔成与背景相适应的低阶和稀有组件和前地口罩. 优化功能通过一种DMM方法解决,该方法被映射为可训练的分层. 更具体地说,LMRPCA采用了革命性稀有编码的元素来改进前置口罩和辅助变形域的侧面信息的代表性学习. 因此, 周来等. (344)将可学习的权重分配到不同的地物地图上,并用重取重取重取的l 1−l-l_{1}-l_{1}最小化. 实验表明,LMRPCA的绩效超过了PSTNN(159)和DNA-Net(148).

blocks.en: 6.2.3 Nuclear-norm Defects
blocks.zh: 6.2.3 核规范缺陷

blocks.en: As the nuclear norm is applied on the low rank component related to the background, changing this norm and adding constraints can increase the robustness in the presence complex and noisy backgrounds. In practice, the IPI model presents weaknesses when facing extremely complex backgrounds. This lies in the mismatching of model’s implicit assumption of a large number of observations with the reality of deficient observations of strong edge. To address this problem, Dai et al. ( 350 ) employ the partial sum of singular values instead of the nuclear norm to constrain the low-rank background patch-image. It provides a more accurate background estimation and almost eliminates all the salient residuals in the decomposed arget image. Second, considering the fact that the infrared small target is always brighter than its adjacent background, Dai et al. ( 350 ) use an additional non-negative constraint to the sparse target patch image. It reduces off more undesirable components but also accelerates the convergence rate. An inexact augmented Lagrange multiplier is designed for the formulation problem named Non-negative Infrared Patch-image Partial Sum (NIPPS). In 2017, Wang et al. ( 340 ) propose to use a total variation (TV) regularization term on the low-rank matrix to describe the inner smooth and crisp edges of background, which is of great importance in non-smooth and nonuniform background. The total variation is based on a local gradient operator which weights the low rank component to reduce clutters in detection results,as well as to provide a good estimation of background region. The proposed method named TV-PCP is solved using augmented Lagrangian function. TV-PCP outperforms the IPI model ( 332 ) .
blocks.zh: 由于核规范适用于与背景有关的低级部分,改变这一规范并增加限制可以提高存在复杂而吵闹的背景的稳健性. 在实践中,IPI模式在面对极其复杂的背景时呈现出弱点. 这是因为模型对大量观测的隐含假设与强边观测不足的现实不匹配。 为了解决这一问题,Dai等人(350人)采用了单数的部分和数,而不是核规范来限制低等背景补丁图像。 它提供了更准确的背景估计,并几乎消除了已分解的正弦图像中的所有显著残基. 二,考虑到红外小目标总比相邻背景更亮,戴等. (350 )对稀有的目标补丁图像使用额外的非负限制. 它减少了更不受欢迎的部件,但也加快了收缩速度。 设计了一个不准确的加长拉格兰克乘数,用于命名为"非负红外线补丁-成像部分和"(NIPPS)的配方问题. 2017年,王等(340人)提议在低等矩阵上使用总变相(TV)规范化名词来描述背景的内在平滑而脆的边缘,这在非平稳和不统一的背景中非常重要. 总体变化基于一个当地梯度操作器,该操作器对低等元件进行加权,以减少检测结果中的杂乱,并对背景区域作出良好的估计。 被命名为TV-PCP的拟议方法被用增强的拉格朗日函数来解决. TV-PCP优于IPI模式(332 ).

blocks.en: In 2018, Zhang et al. ( 336 ) design a non-convex, tighter rank surrogate and weighted l 1 l_{1} norm which can suppress the background better while preserving the target efficiently. More specifically, a structured l 2 , 1 l_{2,1} norm is employed to wipe out the strong residuals. To solve this non-convex model, Zhang et al. ( 336 ) design an non-convex optimization algorithm based on Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) plus Difference of Convex (DC) programming. This method is called Non-convex Rank Approximation Minimization Joint l 2 , 1 l_{2,1} norm (NRAM) method. In a further work, Zhang et al. ( 337 ) propose a LRSD method based on Non-convex Optimization with Schatten q q -norm and L p L_{p} -norm Constraint (NOLC) requiring a non-convex optimization algorithm. The NOLC model can detect more the targets but also suppress better the background area than IPI ( 332 ) , RIPT and NRAM ( 336 ) . In summary, the NRAM method is based on the structural noise and uses the l 2 , 1 l_{2,1} -norm constraint that emphasizes that the row of the block image is sparse. To reach this effect, the size of the structured noise must be smaller than the size of the sliding window to obtain the effect of row sparseness. However, for structured noise, its size often cannot meet the requirements (such as bridges and houses), which makes the NRAM using the l 2 , 1 l_{2,1} -norm constrained noise term sometimes less robust. The NOLC method is based on the difference between the target and the background sparsity from the perspective of the target, and directly employs the stricter L p L_{p} -norm to constrain the sparse item. This method allows to describe the target more directly and accurately than the IPI model and the NRAM method providing good detection effects under various complex backgrounds. Furthermore, NOLC always restores sparse targets in the noisy infrared small target image. The NOLC method improves the convergence strategy making the convergence speed better than IPI ( 332 ) and NRAM ( 336 ) methods.
blocks.zh: 2018年,张等(336人)设计出非曲折,更紧的分级代位和加权l1l_{1}的规范,可以更好地压制背景,同时有效维护目标. 更具体地说,采用了结构化的l 2, 1 l l-_{2, 1} 规范来消灭强烈的残余. 为了解决这个非凸起模型,张等. (336 ) 设计一种基于相乘器(ADMM)和相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 这种方法被称为"非康克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克 在进一步的工作上,张等(337人)提出了基于Non-convex优化的LRSD方法与Schatten q-norm和L p-_{p}-norm Constraint(NOLC)要求非convex优化算法. NOLC模型可以比IPI(332),RIPT和NRAM(336)更能探测到目标,但也更能压制背景区域. 简而言之,NRAM方法基于结构噪声,并使用l 2, 1 l_{2, 1} -norm 制约,强调块图像的行是稀有的. 要达到这种效果,结构噪声的大小必须小于滑动窗口的大小来得到行稀疏的效果. 然而,对于有结构的噪音,其大小往往不能满足要求(如桥梁和房屋),这使得NRAM使用l 2,1 l_{2,1} -Norm受限的噪音名词有时不太坚固. NOLC方法基于目标与从目标角度看背景相去甚远的相去相去甚远,直接使用更严格的L p-_{p}-norm来约束稀有项目. 这种方法可以比IPI模型和NRAM方法更直接更准确地描述目标,在各种复杂背景下提供良好的检测效果. 此外,NOLC总是恢复了高吵红外小目标图像中的稀有目标. NOLC方法改进了收缩策略,使得收缩速度比IPI(332)和NRAM(336)方法更好.

blocks.en: In 2019, Zhou et al. ( 351 ) propose the integration of Schatten 1/2 quasi-norm regularization and reweighted sparse enhancement in the LRSD framework. This method provides better approximation for the sparse-regularized low-rank function, exactly recovering the background patch-image. Second, an adaptive weight is applied to suppress the salient sparse outliers. A softening half-thresholding operator, instead of the original half-thresholding operator, is used to solve the Schatten 1/2 minimization subproblem. To deal with interference of heavy clutter and strong edge, Yan et al. ( 352 ) adopt a Kernel RPCA (KRPCA) method to estimate the background component. More specifically, a total variation regularization is employed to smooth the background while the l p l_{p} -norm is choosen to recover the sparse component and the graph Laplacian regularization is utilized as a sparse constraint to constrain the homogeneous target region. Experiments show that KRPCA outperforms IPI ( 332 ) , RIPT, TV-PCP and NRAM ( 336 ) .
blocks.zh: 2019年,周来等(351人)提出将Schatten 1/2准规范化和再加权稀有增强纳入LRSD框架. 这种方法为鲜有规律的低阶函数提供了更好的近似,准确恢复了背景补丁-图像. 第二,采用适应性分量来抑制显著的稀疏外源。 一个软化的半径接力操作员,而不是原来的半径接力操作员,用来解决Schatten 1/2最小化子问题. 为了处理重杂和强边的干扰,Yan等人(352人)采用了克内尔RPCA(KRPCA)方法来估计背景成分. 更具体地说,为了平息背景,采用了全面的变异正规化,而选择了 l p l_{p} - 规范来恢复稀有的成分,而图Laplacian正规化则被用来作为限制同质目标区域的稀有制约。 实验表明,KRPCA的绩效超过了IPI(332),RIPT,TV-PCP和NRAM(336).

blocks.en: In 2020, Zhu et al. ( 349 ) design a Target-aware method based on a Non-local Low-Rank model and Saliency (TNLRS) filter regularization enabling joint target saliency learning in a lower dimensional discriminative manifold. First, a non-local patch construction is employed for the target-aware low-rank model. By combining similar patches, Zhu et al. ( 349 ) reconstruct them together to obtain a better generalization of non-local spatial sparsity constraints. To improve target saliency learning, the saliency filtering regularization term based on entropy is restricted to lie between the background and foreground. Thus, the regularization of the saliency filtering locally takes into account the contexts from the target and surrounding areas and limits the deviated approximation of the low-rank matrix.
blocks.zh: 2020年,朱等编著. (349)基于非局部低角模型和Saliency(TNLRS)滤波器正规化设计出一种目标意识方法,使联合目标显著性学习能够在下维分辨多面中进行. 第一,采用非局部补丁建造,用于目标意识低等模型. 通过将相类似的补丁合并,朱等. (349) 将它们重建在一起,以更好地概括非局部空间相接性限制。 为了改进目标优势的学习,基于Entropy的优势过滤规范化术语被限制在背景和前景之间. 因此,对当地显著性过滤的规范化考虑到了来自目标和周边地区的背景,并限制了低等矩阵的偏差近似.

blocks.en:
In 2023, Liu et al. ( 357 ) design a High Local Variance LRSD (HiLV-LRSD) method. HiLV-LRSD allows to distinguish the sparse points with HLS, the non-low rank as the targets and the remaining regions as the background. First, a local variance allows
represent local salience. Thus, Liu et al. ( 357 ) employ an L ​ V ∗ LV^{*} norm to constrain the background’s low-rank and local variance. Second an adaptively reweighted ( l v l_{v} , l 1 l_{1} )-norm allows to constrain the
sparsity of the target and enhance the influence of local variance. Experiments show that HiLV-LRSD outperforms IPI ( 332 ) , ReWIPI, NIPPS ( 350 ) , NRAM ( 336 ) and PSTNN ( 159 ) . In 2023, Liu et al. ( 355 ) employ a total variational to constraint Representative Coefficient (RC) matrix instead of data matrix to describe local smooth prior to remove noise and to reduce computational complexity. Thus, Liu et al. ( 355 ) control the number of columns in the representative coefficient matrix
to maintain the low-rank characteristics of background to
avoid SVD calculation and to improve the detection efficiency.
The RCTV regularization simultaneously describe
local smooth prior and low-rank prior. Second, Liu et al. ( 355 ) employ a log-sum function to adaptively assign weights to targets in order to better increase the sparsity of targets and distinguish sparse non target points. Experiments show that RTCTW outperforms ASTTV ( 403 ) and NPSTT ( 404 ) .
blocks.zh:
2023年,刘等(357人)设计出"高局部差异LRSD"(HilV-LRSD)方法. HILV-LRSD允许以HLS区分出稀有的分数,以非低等为目标,以所剩区域为背景. 首先,允许本地差异
代表了当地的突出地位。 因此,Liu等人(357人)采用了LV * LVQQ规范来限制背景的低级别和当地差异。 其次,一个适应性重置(lvl_{v},l 1l_{1})-规范允许限制
目标平缓并增强局部差异的影响. 实验表明,HILV-LRSD的性能超过了IPI(332),ReWIPI,NIPPS(350),NRAM(336)和PSTNN(159). 2023年,刘等. (355 )使用一个总的可变性来约束代表Coecutive (RC)矩阵,而不是数据矩阵来描述局部平滑之前去除噪声并降低计算的复杂性. 因此, 刘等 (355) 控制代表性系数矩阵中的列数.
以保持背景的低等特征
避免 SVD 计算,提高检测效率.
RCTV规范化同时描述
