blocks.en: In 2024, Dan et al. ( 152 ) propose a Dynamic Weight-guided Smooth-Sparse decomposition (DW-SSD) method. First, a surface-fitting perspective allows to reconstruct the smooth vignetting using the B-spline as the basis. Second, Total Variation (TV) allows to regularize the coefficients of the B-spline basis. This term allows a flexible description for different background local regions with low computation cost dealing with the high brightness vignetting and improving the emergence of the target. Third, the dynamic weight based on spatial–temporal prior characteristic is employed for the target component, where the differences in spatial contrast and temporal profile are jointly used to guide the separation of the target from dense noise. Experiments show that DW-SSD outperforms PSTNN ( 159 ) .In 2024, Chen et al. ( 353 ) propose to use Weighted Nuclear Norm Minimization (WNNM) optimization with sparse representation based on the local IPI model. Experiments show that the proposed method outperforms IPI and ReWIPI.
blocks.zh: 2024年,由丹等主编. (152)提出动态重制导平滑-分解(DW-SSD)方法. 首先,地表整齐的视角允许以B-spline作为基础来重建平滑的花纹. 第二,总变化(TV)允许将B-spline基的系数规范化. 这个术语可以灵活地描述不同背景的局部地区,它们的计算成本低,可以处理高亮度的发光并改进目标的出现. 第三,目标部分采用了基于空间-时前特征的动态权重,其中空间对比和时间剖面的差异被共同用来指导目标与密集噪声的分离. 实验显示,DW-SSD的表现优于PSTNN(159). . 2024年,Chen等(353)提议使用Wighted Nuclear Norm Encentration(WNNM)优化,以当地IPI模型为基础,使用稀有代表. 实验显示,拟议方法的绩效超过了IPI和ReWIPI.

blocks.en: 6.2.4 Adaptivity

The adaptivity is generally addressed by a matrix that weighted either the low-rank component or the sparse component by using local prior or computed information. First, Wang and Qin ( 405 ) propose an adaptive weighting parameter LRSD method. More specifically, a multi-scale transform and patch transform are used to generate an image patch. Thus, the weighting parameter of RPCA no longer has global uniform value, but has an appropriate value according to the complexity of each patch. In addition, the image processing at the patch level allows parallel computing in multi-core systems to increase the speed of target-background separation even in real time.
blocks.zh: 适应性一般通过一个矩阵来解决,该矩阵通过使用本地的事先或计算的信息对低等成分或稀有成分进行加权。 一,王和秦(405)提出适应性加权参数LRSD方法. 更具体地说,一个多尺度的变换和补丁变换用来生成一个图像补丁. 因此,RPCA的加权参数不再具有全球统一值,而根据每个补丁的复杂程度具有适当的值. 此外,补丁级的图像处理允许多核心系统中的并行计算,即使实时地提高目标-后地分离的速度.

blocks.en:
In an other approach, Gao et al. ( 146 ) employ a weighting matrix W W to obtain the sparse matrix. The nonlinear weights are constructed based on a logistic sigmoid function, and offer more advantages than weights of singular values in suppressing background and keeping small targets. More specifically, the entry-wise weights are designed based on the local weighted entropy, and allow to extract the targets and to suppress background clutters. An Accelerated Proximal Gradient (APG) is used to solve the corresponding optimization problem. At the end, the location correlation of the dense and sparse reconstruction maps and tracklet association of the location correlation maps for successive frames are employed to suppress false alarms and confirm suspected targets. Experiments show the performance this co-detection model in the airbone case. In 2017, Wang et al ( 376 ) propose a weight nuclear norm minimization based IPI model. This model consider each singular value differently instead of equally in the IPI model offering more flexibly to describe complex background. In 2018, Yuan and Dong ( 406 ) design an adaptive scheme based on the ratio minimization of singular values. More specifically, a multi-scale fusion and parameter regulation are employed. They are both based on the non-negative target assumption and the ratio between partial and total sum of background singular values. The parameters are thus regulated adaptively using the image entropy and the standard deviation of image patches. This method shows robustness in extremely variant and complex backgrounds, and is more accurate with low false alarm rate than IPI ( 332 ) . In 2021, Bertrand et al. ( 346 ) employ an Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) method as a regularizer into the IPI model to take into account the temporal correlation
between frames.
blocks.zh:
在另一种方法中,Gao等人(146人)使用加权矩阵W W来获取稀有矩阵。 非线性权重是根据逻辑sigmoid函数构建的,在压制背景和保持小目标方面,其优势大于单数权重。 更具体地说,入门权重是根据本地加权的 en来设计的,可以提取出目标并压制背景杂乱. 加速相近梯度(APG)用于解决相应的优化问题. 归根结底,利用密集和稀疏的重建地图和相继帧位置关联图的轨迹关联来压制假警报并证实被怀疑的目标. 实验显示这种共探测模型在气骨箱中的性能. 2017年,王等(376人)提出以重量核规范最小化为基础的IPI模型. 这个模型对每个单值的考虑不同,而不是在IPI模型中平等,提供更灵活的描述复杂背景. 2018年,袁同通(406人)根据将单数最小化的比例设计出适应性方案. 更具体地说,采用了多尺度聚变和参数调控. 它们既基于非负目标假设,也基于背景单数部分和总和的比率。 因此,参数被适应性地使用图像 en和图像补丁的标准偏差来调节. 这种方法在极其多变和复杂的背景中表现出了坚固性,并且与IPI(332)相比,在低假警报率下更为准确. 2021年,Bertrand等人(346人)在IPI模型中采用了不平衡优化运输(UOT)方法作为常态剂来考虑时间相关性.
在帧之间。

blocks.en:
In an other work, Cao and Xue ( 373 ) study the influence of various blocking methods under different image backgrounds. Thus, a selection method based on the larger value of the minimum local entropy of image segmentation is employed. Experiments show that the best results are obtained by taking the larger
value of the minimum local entropy as the reference.
blocks.zh:
在另一作中,曹和薛(373人)研究了不同图像背景下各种阻塞方法的影响. 因此,采用了一种基于图像分解最小局部 en值较大的选择方法. 实验表明,最好的结果是通过取取更大的
作为参考的最小本地 en值。

blocks.en: 6.2.5 Heterogeneous Backgrounds
blocks.zh: 6.2.5 异质背景

blocks.en: To deal with the highly heterogeneous background, Li et al. ( 369 ) employs a Low-Rank Representation (LRR) to describe the background patch-image, assuming that all background subspace clusters. But, this LRR based method does not perform as well as the IPI model in suppressing the background clutter and noise.
blocks.zh: 为了处理高度多样化的背景问题,Li等人(369人)使用低RR(LRR)来描述背景补丁图像,假设所有背景子空间集群. 但是,这种基于LRR的方法在压制背景杂乱无章和噪音方面并不像IPI模型那样发挥作用.

blocks.en:
In 2020, Pang et al. ( 370 ) design a LRSD method based on greedy bilateral factorization inspired by by Zhou
and Tao ( 407 ) . First, the target is considered as an independent sparse motion structure by analyzing the complex structure information of the IR image sequences. Second, the greedy bilateral factorization (GreB) strategy is adopted to approximate the low-rank part of the algorithm by substituting L L by its bilateral factorization. This scheme also accelerates the efficiency of the algorithm. Experiments show that GreB outperforms IPI and NRAM ( 336 ) . In 2019, Li et al. ( 371 ) propose to exploit both local and nonlocal priors in a dual-window local contrast method (DW-LCM) and multiscale-window IR patch-image (MW-IPI).
blocks.zh:
2020年,庞等. (370)由周作人所启发,基于贪婪的双边要素化设计出LRSD方法.
和涛 (407). 首先,通过分析IR图像序列的复杂结构信息,目标被认为是一个独立的稀有运动结构. 其次,采用贪婪的双边保理化(GreB)策略,取而代之的是LL来取而代之的以其双边保理化,以此来取近于算法的低等部分. 这个方案也加速了算法的效率. 实验显示GreB的性能超过了IPI和NRAM(336. 2019年,李等(371人)提议以双窗本地对比法(DW-LCM)和多窗IR补丁映像法(MW-IPI)来开发本地和非本地前身.

blocks.en: In 2024, Li et al. ( 372 ) propose a customized Group low-rank regularized Principal Component Pursuit model (GPCP). Experiments on ground backgrounds, sea backgrounds and sky backgrounds show that GPCP outperforms IPI ( 332 ) and NRAM ( 336 ) . Instead of equalizing the background area as in the original IPI ( 332 ) , Li et al. ( 374 ) a Statistical Clustering Partitioning Low-rank Background Modeling Algorithm (SCPLBMA). It separates the image into areas according to their statistics so that each area is consistent statistical distribution. Thus, SCPLBMA can preserve the natural structure of the image.
blocks.zh: 2024年,Li等(372人)提出一个定制的集团低级正规化主要组件追求模式(GPCP). 关于地上背景,海上背景和天空背景的实验显示,GPCP的性能超过了IPI (332)和NRAM (336). 与原始的IPI(332)相比,Li等人(374)不是将背景区域等同,而是将低等背景建模算法(SCPLBMA)的统计分组分出. 它根据地区的统计数据将图像划分为地区,使每个地区统计分布一致. 因此,SCPLBMA可以保存图像的自然结构.

blocks.en: In 2026, Wu et al. ( 375 ) develop a Manifold Geometric Prior and Structural Rectification for Infrared Small Target Detection (MR-IRSTD) method. First, a spatiotemporal patch matrix is built. Second, a KD-tree-accelerated Local Linear Embedding (LLE) extracts local geometric correlations to form a data-driven Manifold Geometric Prior, providing an optimal linear prediction for complex backgrounds. By shifting the nuclear norm constraint from the raw background to the manifold residual, the structural rectification mechanism absorbs the ghosting artifacts into the low-rank component them to avoid the contaminatination by the sparse targets. Third, the sparse targets and the rectified background are separated through an adaptive Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) algorithm. Experiments show that MR-IRSTD method offers superior robustness in complex scenarios with strong edges and noise than ASTTV and PSTNN.
blocks.zh: 2026年,吴等. (375) 开发出红外小目标探测(MR-IRSTD)的多维几何前和结构校正方法。 首先,构建一个spatiotemporal补丁矩阵. 第二,一款由KD-tree加速本地线性嵌入(LLE)提取出本地几何相关性,形成由数据驱动的"多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维多维 通过将核规范约束从原始背景转移到多残留,结构矫正机制将幽灵出没的文物吸收到低等成分中来,以避免被稀少的目标所污染. 第三,通过适应性的倍增器改变方向法(ADMM)算法,将零散的目标和纠正后的背景分开。 实验显示,MR-IRSTD方法比ASTTV和PSTNN更能提供具有强烈边缘和噪音的复杂情景中的超强坚固性.

blocks.en: 6.2.6 Robustness to noise
blocks.zh: 6.2.6 对噪音的强力

blocks.en: In order to better separate the target from noise, He et al. ( 369 ) propose a Low-Rank and Sparse Representation (LRSR) model, employing sparse representation for the small target. In 2018, Gao et al. ( 372 ) address the sparse noise component by adopting a Mixture of Gaussians (MoG) with Markov random field (MRF). The MRF guided MoG noise model under the Bayesian framework model the small target detection problem. Using a variational Bayesian, the small target component is separated from complex background noise. A simple adaptive segmentation method is used to extract small target.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地将目标与噪音区分开来,He等. (369)提出"低亮"和"斯帕斯代表"(LRSR)模式,对"小目标"采用"少量代表". 2018年,Gao等(372人)通过采用"高斯人混音"(MoG)与"马尔可夫随机场"(MRF)的混合来解决稀有噪音成分. MRF在贝叶斯框架下指导MOG噪声模型小目标检测问题. 使用可变贝叶斯语,将小目标成分从复杂的背景噪声中分离出. 一种简单的适应分化方法用于取出小目标.

blocks.en: 6.2.7 Temporal Constraints
blocks.zh: 6.2.7 时间限制

blocks.en: The IPI model construct patches by traversing local images and ignore the correlations among different patches. Thus, some texture information of the target is ignored, and targets of arbitrary forms cannot be accurately identified. To address this limitation, Zhu et al. ( 369 ) propose a Target-aware method based on a Non-local Low-Rank model and Saliency filter regularization (TNLRS) solved as a non-convex optimization problem, therein enabling joint target saliency learning in a lower dimensional discriminative manifold. First, a non-local patch construction is employed. By combining similar patches, Zhu et al. ( 369 ) reconstruct them together to achieve a better generalization of non-local spatial sparsity constraints. To encourage target saliency learning, a saliency filtering regularization term based on entropy is employed. The regularization of the saliency filtering locally preserves the contexts from the target and surrounding areas and avoids the deviated approximation of the low-rank matrix. Finally, a unified optimization framework is solved with an ADMM algorithm.
blocks.zh: IPI模型通过翻转本地图像来构建补丁并忽略了不同补丁之间的关联. 因此,目标的一些纹理信息被忽略,任意形式的目标无法被准确识别. 为解决这一限制,朱等. (369)提出基于非局部低角模型的"目标意识"方法,而"Saliency"(TNLRS)规范化(TNLRS)作为"非对流优化"问题被解决,从而可以在下维分辨多维中进行联合目标显著学习. 一,采用非局部补丁建设. 通过将相类似的补丁合并,朱等. (369)共同重建它们,以更好地概括非局部空间相生的束缚. 为了鼓励目标优势学习,采用了以肽为主的优势过滤规范化术语. 将显性过滤本地化的规范化,能从目标区和周边地区保存上下文并避免低等矩阵的偏移近似. 最后用ADMM算法解决了统一的优化框架.

blocks.en: In summary, the IPI model is the original method, and its principle and solution method are directly inherited from the proposed LRSD scheme of Candes et al. ( 67 ) . The changes about the nuclear norm, the low-rank part and its adaptivity aim to improve the reconstruction of the background whilst the changes about the l 1 l_{1} -norm, the sparse part and its adaptivity aim to increase the accuracy of the target detection. The changes in the optimization algorithm concern both the solution of the problem formulation and the computation time.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,IPI模型是原始方法,其原理和溶液方法直接继承自Candes等人(67.)拟议的LRSD方案. 有关核规范、低等级部分及其适应性的变化旨在改进背景重建,而关于l1 l_{1} -Norm、稀有部分及其适应性的变化则旨在提高目标探测的准确性。 优化算法的变化既涉及问题表达的解决方案,也涉及计算时间.

blocks.en: 6.2.8 Deep Unfold LRSD Networks
blocks.zh: 6.2.8 深不重叠的LRSD网络

blocks.en: Since the rise of deep learning, several authors propose deep low-rank and sparse neural networks (also called deep unfold RPCA networks), namely Deep-LSP-Net ( 382 ) , RPCANet 12 12 12 https://github.com/fengyiwu98/RPCANet ( 383 ) , DUSRNet 13 13 13 https://github.com/Awais-k/DUSRNet ( 395 ) , LRRNet 14 14 14 https://github.com/HaLongbao/LRRNet/ ( 394 ) , DRPCA-Net 15 15 15 https://github.com/GrokCV/DRPCA-Net ( 397 ) , RPCANet++ 16 16 16 https://fengyiwu98.github.io/rpcanetx/ ( 385 ) , LSDSSMs ( 386 ) , L-RPCANet 17 17 17 https://github.com/xianchaoxiu/L-RPCANet ( 408 ) , LSNet ( 400 ) , DURD 18 18 18 https://github.com/haofan72/DURD ( 389 ) and ESTNet ( 399 ) .
blocks.zh: 自深度学习兴起后,多位作者提出了深度低等和稀有神经网络(也叫深出RPCA网络),即:Deep-LSP-Net(382),RPCANet 12 12 https://github.com/fengyiwu98/RPCANet(383),DUSRNet 13 13 https://github.com/Awais-k/DUSRNet(395),LRNet 14 14 14 https://github.com/Haongbao/LRRNet/(394),DRPCA-Net 15 15 https://github.com/GrokCV/DRPCA-Net(397),RPCANet 16 16 16 https://fengyiwu98.ghub.io/rpcnetx(385),LDSDSSSDSSM(386),L-17 https://github.com/L-NUT

blocks.en: More specifically, algorithmic unfolding has been introduced to map the iterative optimization process of conventional LRSD models into standard neural network architectures ( 409 ) . This technique allows for the integration of domain knowledge into the network design, providing more interpretable structures. RPCA-based unfolded networks (also called deep unfolding networks (DUNs)) have demonstrated superior detection performance with fewer training parameters compared to conventional residual neural networks in the field of moving object detection ( 410 ; 411 ) .
blocks.zh: 更具体地说,已经引入了算法演化来将常规LRSD模型的迭代优化过程映射入标准神经网络架构 (409). 这种技术可以将域知识融入网络设计,提供更可解释的结构. 基于RPCA的已展开网络(也叫深层正在展开的网络(DUNs))已经表现出了优异的检测性能,与移动物体检测领域的常规残留神经网络相比,培训参数较少(410;411).

blocks.en: First, in 2023, Zhou et al. ( 382 ) unroll the iterative optimization algorithm of ADMMs into deep neural networks, where a generalized sparsifying transform and a singular value thresholding (SVT) operator are learned by the Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to avoid tedious parameter tuning and improve the interpretability of the neural networks. In 2024, Wu et al. ( 383 ) formulates the infrared small target detection task as low-rank background estimation, sparse target extraction, and image reconstruction in a relaxed RPCA model. By unfolding the iterative optimization updating steps into a deep-learning framework, time-consuming and complex matrix calculations are replaced by theory-guided neural networks. This learnable deep network architecture derived from a relaxed RPCA model is named RPCANet. RPCANet detects targets with clear interpretability and preserves the intrinsic image feature, instead of directly transforming the detection task into a matrix decomposition problem.
blocks.zh: 一,2023年,周克等(382人)将ADMM的迭代优化算法放入深层神经网络,其中由革命神经网络(CNNs)学习了通俗的螺旋变换和单值阈值(SVT)操作器来避免乏味参数调和,提高神经网络的可解释性. 2024年,吴等(383人)将红外小目标探测任务制定为低等背景估计,零散取出目标,并用宽松的RPCA模型来进行图像重建. 通过将迭代优化更新步骤引入深层学习框架,耗时而复杂的矩阵计算被理论引导神经网络所取而代之. 这种从宽松的RPCA模型中衍生出来的可学习的深层网络架构被命名为RPCANet. RPCANet检测目标具有明确的可解释性并保留了内在的图像特征,而不是直接将检测任务转化为矩阵分解问题.

blocks.en: In a further work, Wu et al. ( 385 ) propose RPCANet++ as a sparse object segmentation framework that fuses the interpretability of RPCA with efficient deep architectures and incorporates a memory-augmented module to preserve background features during background extraction and a deep contrastive prior module to accelerate target extraction during target approximation. More specifically, RPCANet++ unfolds a relaxed RPCA model into a structured network comprising a Background Approximation Module (BAM), an Object Extraction Module (OEM), and an Image Restoration Module (IRM). To mitigate inter-stage transmission loss in the BAM, Wu et al. ( 385 ) employ a Memory-Augmented Module (MAM) to enhance background feature preservation, while a Deep Contrast Prior Module (DCPM) exploits saliency cues to achieve object extraction. Experiments show that RPCANet++ outperforms NRAM ( 336 ) and RPCANet ( 383 ) .
blocks.zh: 在进一步的工作中,Wu等 (385人)提议将RPCANet++作为稀疏的物体分解框架,将RPCA的可解释性与高效的深层架构相接,并纳入一个内存增强模块,以在背景取出时保留背景特征,以及一个深度对比的前模块,以在目标近似时加速目标取出. 更具体地说,RPCANet++将一个宽松的RPCA模型推出一个结构化的网络,包括一个背景近似模块(BAM),一个对象提取模块(OEM)和一个图像还原模块(IRM). 为了减轻BAM中的相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 (385 )使用内存增强模块(MAM)来增强背景特征保存,而深对比前模块(DCPM)则会利用显著的提示来取出对象. 实验显示RPCANet++优于NRAM(336)和RPCANet(383).

blocks.en:
single-frame methods suffer from semantic ambiguity leading to frequent false alarms, while long-sequence approaches impose prohibitive computational burdens and latency unsuitable for transient threats. This critical observation drives our exploration of the Minimum Effective Frame Threshold (MEFT), a pivotal parameter that balances semantic sufficiency and computational efficiency in spatiotemporal dependency modeling.
In practice, RPCANet ( 383 ) presents several weaknesses addressed by further works and these improvements can be categorized as follows. 1. Few-shot Learning: In 2026, Hu et al. ( 377 ) design a Few frame-guided spatio-temporal deep unfolding Network (FIRST-Net). It is a physics-driven architecture featuring hierarchical deep unfolding layers that explicitly encode target sparsity and background low-rank priors. Based on frame-level ablation studies, 5-frame configuration are selected as optimal achieving 74.6 % 74.6\% detection accuracy on high-velocity targets while maintaining real-time processing. Experiments demonstrate SOTA performance with 76.8 % 76.8\% IoU and 7.8 × 10 − 5 7.8\times 10^{-5} false alarm suppression. FIRST-Net bridges the gap between single-frame efficiency and multi-frame robustness. 2. Patch Limitation: RPCANet ( 383 ) attempts to unfold RPCA into a trainable network but imposes low-rank constraints on patch-images rather than on the entire image which results in suboptimal detection performance and significant computational overhead, especially on high-resolution infrared data. To address these limitations, Zhang et al. ( 394 ) design a patch-free Low-Rank Representation Network (LRRNet) that integrates low-rank constraints directly in the image domain avoiding the need for patch-image construction. This design is based on a key insight: the low-rank nature of infrared images implies an inherent compressibility—when the rank is sufficiently small, the image information can be sparsely encoded while being nearly “losslessly” preserved. 3. Global/Local Information: The global low-rank characteristic of infrared image is emphasized in LRSD decomposition and ignore local structural feature. To address this issue, Deng et al. ( 395 ) develop a Deep Unfolding Sparse Regularized Network (DUSRNet). DUSRNet combines the feature extraction capability of deep learning with the fine structure description capability of sparse regularization. To adaptively describe the low-rank and sparse characteristics, the sparse-regularized model is embedded into the deep neural network in a end-to-end manner. Deng et al. ( 395 ) design an adaptive background estimation module, sparse target extraction module and infrared image reconstruction module. Experiments show that DUSRNet outperforms RPCANet ( 383 ) on the NUDT-SIRST, SIRST and IRSTD-1k datasets in extremely high scene complexity and variability. 4. Dynamic Adaptivity: In 2025, Xiong et al. ( 397 ) propose a dynamic RPCA network (DRPCA-Net), a novel deep unfolding network (DUN) that integrates the sparsity-aware prior into a learnable architecture. Instead of conventional deep unfolding methods that rely on static, globally learned parameters, DRPCA-Net employs a dynamic unfolding mechanism via a lightweight hypernetwork. It enables the model to adaptively generate iteration-wise parameters conditioned on the input scene, thereby enhancing its robustness and generalization across diverse backgrounds. Moreover, Xiong et al. ( 397 ) employ a Dynamic Residual Group (DRG) module to better capture contextual variations within the background achieving more accurate low-rank estimation and improved separation of small targets. 5. Lightweight Algorithm: In 2025, Liu et al. ( 385 ) design a lightweight framework based on RPCA called L-RPCANet. A hierarchical bottleneck structure is provided to reduce and increase the channel dimension in the single-channel input infrared image to achieve channel-wise feature refinement, with bottleneck layers designed in each module to extract features. This strategy reduces the number of channels in feature extraction and improves the lightweightness of network parameters. In addition, a noise reduction module is embedded to improve the robustness against complex noise. Squeeze-andexcitation networks (SENets) are exploited as a channel attention mechanism to focus on the varying importance of different features across channels, thereby improving performance while maintaining both lightweightness and robustness. Experiments show L-RPCANet that outperforms or achieves similar results than RPCANet ( 383 ) , DRPCANet ( 397 ) and RPCANet++ ( 385 ) . In summary, L-RPCANet not only improves the detection performance and noise robustness, but also requires fewer parameters, achieves faster GPU inference time, and is more applicable to real-time detection. 6. Temporal Dimension: However, all these unfolding networks suffer from the challenges of slow inference and inability to learn temporal dimensional features. In addition, They focus solely on spatial structural features, neglecting the motion characteristics of small targets in the temporal dimension. To address these limitations, Zhu and Feng ( 399 ) design a bilevel-optimization RPCA guided spatio-temporal network (ESTNet). ESTNet is the first unfolding network that integrates CUR decomposition. More specifically, Zhu and Feng ( 399 ) formulate the infrared small target detection as a bilevel-optimized RPCA problem and solve it through algorithmic unfolding. To substantially increase the inference efficiency, ESTNet incorporates learnable CUR decompositions at each unfolding layer to replace the computationally intensive SVT operator. Moreover, Convolutional Long Short-Term Memory (CLSTM) modules are embedded within each unfolding layer to capture the multi-frame spatiotemporal motion characteristics of small targets. Experiments show that ESTNet outperforms IPI ( 336 ) and RPCANet ( 383 ) .
blocks.zh:
单帧方法有语义模糊,导致经常出现虚假警报,而长序方法则造成难以承受的计算负担和不适于瞬间威胁的延迟。 这一关键观察推动了我们对最低有效框架阈值(MEFT)的探索,这是一个关键参数,它平衡了语义上的充足性和计算效率,用于建立瞬间依赖性模型。
在实践中,RPCANet(383个)提出了进一步工作所处理的若干弱点,这些改进可分类如下。 1. 少许学习: 2026年,胡等(377年)设计了"几相框制导"斯皮提奥-时空深出网络(FIRST-Net). 这是一种由物理学驱动的建筑,其分层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层层 根据帧级减速研究,选取了5帧配置,作为在高速度目标上实现74.6%的74.6QX检测精度,同时保持实时处理. 实验显示SOTA的性能有76.8%的76.8\%IoU和7.8×10−5 7.8\tims 10^{-5}假警报压制. FIRST-Net弥补了单帧效率和多帧强度之间的差距. 2. 补丁限制:RPCANet(383个)试图将RPCA扩展为可训练网络,但对补丁图像而不是整个图像施加了低等限制,导致检测性能不理想和重大的计算上浮,特别是高分辨率红外数据。 为解决这些局限性,张等. (394)设计了无补丁Low-Rank代表网络(LRRNet),直接将低等限制整合到图像域,避免了补丁图像构建的需要. 这种设计基于一种关键的见解:红外线图像的低级性质意味着内在的可压缩性——当等级足够小时,图像信息可以被零星地编码,同时几乎被 " 无穷无尽地 " 保存。 3. 全球/地方信息: LRSD分解中强调了红外线图像的全球低级特征并忽略了局部结构特征. 为解决这一问题,邓等. (395)开发"深不相上下"的Sparse规范化网络(DUSRNet). DUSRNet将深度学习的地物提取能力与稀有正规化的精细结构描述能力结合起来. 为适应性地描述低等和稀有的特征,稀有的规范化模型以端到端的方式嵌入了深层神经网络. 邓等. (395)设计适应性背景估计模块,稀有的目标提取模块和红外图像重建模块. 实验显示,DUSRNet在NUDT-SIRST,SIRST和IRSTD-1k数据集上的RPCANet(383)在场景复杂度和可变性极高的情况下,表现优于此. 4. 动态适应性:在2025年,Xiong等(397人)提出了动态RPCA网络(DRPCA-Net),这是一款新颖的深层演进网络(DUN),它将先有觉悟的Sparsity-are整合到可学习的架构中. DRPCA-Net不采用依赖静态的全球知识参数的常规深入发展方法,而是通过轻量级超网络使用动态发展机制。 它使模型能够适应性地生成以输入场景为条件的迭代参数,从而加强其稳健性和不同背景的通俗性。 此外,Xiong等人(397人)采用了动态残余物组模块,以更好地捕捉背景内的背景变化,实现更准确的低级估计并改进小目标的分离。 5. 轻量级算法: 2025年,刘等. (385)以RPCA为基础设计出一个轻量级框架,称为L-RPCANet. 提供分级的瓶颈结构来减少和增加单通道输入红外图像中的通道尺寸,以达到信道的特性完善,每个模块都设计出瓶颈地层来提取特性. 这一策略会减少地物提取中的通道数量并改进网络参数的轻量. 此外,还嵌入了降噪模块来提高强度来对抗复杂的噪声. 挤压和激发网络(SENets)作为一种渠道关注机制被利用来关注不同渠道不同特征的不同重要性,从而在保持轻量和稳健的同时提高性能. 实验显示,L-RPCANet比RPCANet(383个),DRPCANet(397个)和RPCANet++(385个)都表现优于或取得相近的结果. 简言之,L-RPCANet不仅能提高检测性能和噪声稳健性,还需要较少的参数,能实现更快的GPU推断时间,更能适用于实时检测. 6. 时间方面: 然而,所有这些正在形成的网络都面临着缓慢推论和无法学习时间维度特征的挑战。 此外,它们只注重空间结构特征,忽略了时间维度上小目标的运动特征. 为解决这些局限性,朱和峰(399人)设计了双层优化的RPCA导流-时空网络(ESTNet). ESTNet是第一个整合CUR分解的正在展开的网络. 更具体地说,朱和峰(399人)将红外小目标探测定为双层优化的RPCA问题,并通过演算法来解决这个问题. 为了大幅度提高推论效率,ESTNet在每一层都纳入了可学习的CUR分解,以取代计算密集的SVT操作器。 此外,进取式长期内存(CLSTM)模块被嵌入到每个正在展开的地层中,以捕捉出小目标多帧瞬间运动特性. 实验显示,ESTNet的绩效超过了IPI(336)和RPCANet(383).

( 394 ) design a patch-free Low-Rank Representation Network (LRRNet) that integrates low-rank constraints directly in the image domain avoiding the need for patch-image construction. This design is based on a key insight: the low-rank nature of infrared images implies an inherent compressibility—when the rank is sufficiently small, the image information can be sparsely encoded while being nearly “losslessly” preserved.
blocks.zh: 补丁限制:RPCANet(383个)试图将RPCA扩展为可训练网络,但对补丁图像而不是整个图像施加了低等限制,导致检测性能不理想和重大的计算上浮,特别是在高分辨率红外数据上. 为解决这些局限性,张等. (394)设计了无补丁Low-Rank代表网络(LRRNet),直接将低等限制整合到图像域,避免了补丁图像构建的需要. 这种设计基于一种关键的见解:红外线图像的低级性质意味着内在的可压缩性——当等级足够小时,图像信息可以被零星地编码,同时几乎被 " 无穷无尽地 " 保存。

blocks.en: Global/Local Information: The global low-rank characteristic of infrared image is emphasized in LRSD decomposition and ignore local structural feature. To address this issue, Deng et al. ( 395 ) develop a Deep Unfolding Sparse Regularized Network (DUSRNet). DUSRNet combines the feature extraction capability of deep learning with the fine structure description capability of sparse regularization. To adaptively describe the low-rank and sparse characteristics, the sparse-regularized model is embedded into the deep neural network in a end-to-end manner. Deng et al. ( 395 ) design an adaptive background estimation module, sparse target extraction module and infrared image reconstruction module. Experiments show that DUSRNet outperforms RPCANet ( 383 ) on the NUDT-SIRST, SIRST and IRSTD-1k datasets in extremely high scene complexity and variability.
blocks.zh: 全球/地方信息: LRSD分解中强调了红外线图像的全球低级特征并忽略了局部结构特征. 为解决这一问题,邓等. (395)开发"深不相上下"的Sparse规范化网络(DUSRNet). DUSRNet将深度学习的地物提取能力与稀有正规化的精细结构描述能力结合起来. 为适应性地描述低等和稀有的特征,稀有的规范化模型以端到端的方式嵌入了深层神经网络. 邓等. (395)设计适应性背景估计模块,稀有的目标提取模块和红外图像重建模块. 实验表明,DUSRNet在NUDT-SIRST,SIRST和IRSTD-1k数据集上的RPCANet(383)在场景复杂度和可变性极高的情况下表现优于此.

blocks.en: Dynamic Adaptivity: In 2025, Xiong et al. ( 397 ) propose a dynamic RPCA network (DRPCA-Net), a novel deep unfolding network (DUN) that integrates the sparsity-aware prior into a learnable architecture. Instead of conventional deep unfolding methods that rely on static, globally learned parameters, DRPCA-Net employs a dynamic unfolding mechanism via a lightweight hypernetwork. It enables the model to adaptively generate iteration-wise parameters conditioned on the input scene, thereby enhancing its robustness and generalization across diverse backgrounds. Moreover, Xiong et al. ( 397 ) employ a Dynamic Residual Group (DRG) module to better capture contextual variations within the background achieving more accurate low-rank estimation and improved separation of small targets.
blocks.zh: 动态可适性:2025年,Xiong等(397人)提出动态RPCA网络(DRPCA-Net),这是一款新颖的深层正在展开的网络(DUN),在学习前将Sparsity-aware整合入可学习的架构. DRPCA-Net不采用依赖静态的全球知识参数的常规深入发展方法,而是通过轻量级超网络使用动态发展机制。 它使模型能够适应性地生成以输入场景为条件的迭代参数,从而加强其稳健性和不同背景的通俗性。 此外,Xiong等人(397人)采用了动态残余物组模块,以更好地捕捉背景内的背景变化,实现更准确的低级估计并改进小目标的分离。

blocks.en: Lightweight Algorithm: In 2025, Liu et al. ( 385 ) design a lightweight framework based on RPCA called L-RPCANet. A hierarchical bottleneck structure is provided to reduce and increase the channel dimension in the single-channel input infrared image to achieve channel-wise feature refinement, with bottleneck layers designed in each module to extract features. This strategy reduces the number of channels in feature extraction and improves the lightweightness of network parameters. In addition, a noise reduction module is embedded to improve the robustness against complex noise. Squeeze-andexcitation networks (SENets) are exploited as a channel attention mechanism to focus on the varying importance of different features across channels, thereby improving performance while maintaining both lightweightness and robustness. Experiments show L-RPCANet that outperforms or achieves similar results than RPCANet ( 383 ) , DRPCANet ( 397 ) and RPCANet++ ( 385 ) . In summary, L-RPCANet not only improves the detection performance and noise robustness, but also requires fewer parameters, achieves faster GPU inference time, and is more applicable to real-time detection.
blocks.zh: 轻量级算法 : 2025年,刘等. (385)以RPCA为基础设计出一个轻量级框架,称为L-RPCANet. 提供分级的瓶颈结构来减少和增加单通道输入红外图像中的通道尺寸,以达到信道的特性完善,每个模块都设计出瓶颈地层来提取特性. 这一策略会减少地物提取中的通道数量并改进网络参数的轻量. 此外,还嵌入了降噪模块来提高强度来对抗复杂的噪声. 挤压和激发网络(SENets)作为一种渠道关注机制被利用来关注不同渠道不同特征的不同重要性,从而在保持轻量和稳健的同时提高性能. 实验显示,L-RPCANet比RPCANet(383个),DRPCANet(397个)和RPCANet++(385个)都表现优于或取得相近的结果. 简言之,L-RPCANet不仅能提高检测性能和噪声稳健性,还需要较少的参数,能实现更快的GPU推断时间,更能适用于实时检测.

blocks.en: Temporal Dimension: However, all these unfolding networks suffer from the challenges of slow inference and inability to learn temporal dimensional features. In addition, They focus solely on spatial structural features, neglecting the motion characteristics of small targets in the temporal dimension. To address these limitations, Zhu and Feng ( 399 ) design a bilevel-optimization RPCA guided spatio-temporal network (ESTNet). ESTNet is the first unfolding network that integrates CUR decomposition. More specifically, Zhu and Feng ( 399 ) formulate the infrared small target detection as a bilevel-optimized RPCA problem and solve it through algorithmic unfolding. To substantially increase the inference efficiency, ESTNet incorporates learnable CUR decompositions at each unfolding layer to replace the computationally intensive SVT operator. Moreover, Convolutional Long Short-Term Memory (CLSTM) modules are embedded within each unfolding layer to capture the multi-frame spatiotemporal motion characteristics of small targets. Experiments show that ESTNet outperforms IPI ( 336 ) and RPCANet ( 383 ) .
blocks.zh: 时间尺寸 : 然而,所有这些正在形成的网络都面临着缓慢推论和无法学习时间维度特征的挑战。 此外,它们只注重空间结构特征,忽略了时间维度上小目标的运动特征. 为解决这些局限性,朱和峰(399人)设计了双层优化的RPCA导流-时空网络(ESTNet). ESTNet是第一个整合CUR分解的正在展开的网络. 更具体地说,朱和峰(399人)将红外小目标探测定为双层优化的RPCA问题,并通过演算法来解决这个问题. 为了大幅度提高推论效率,ESTNet在每一层都纳入了可学习的CUR分解,以取代计算密集的SVT操作器。 此外,进取式长期内存(CLSTM)模块被嵌入到每个正在展开的地层中,以捕捉出小目标多帧瞬间运动特性. 实验显示,ESTNet的绩效超过了IPI(336)和RPCANet(383).

blocks.en: Even if these methods balance interpretability and learning capability, they suffer from two main weaknesses: the cascading accumulation of background estimation errors and the insufficient adaptability of fixed handcrafted sparse priors. To address these limitations in holistice manner, Wang et al. ( 388 ) design a deep unfolding robust PCA with Learnable Sparse Transform (LST-RPCANet). First, a Multi-Channel Attention Supervised Transmission-Enhancement Module (MCASTM) block error diffusion and purify cross-stage background features through an attention selection mechanism. Second, a Learnable Sparse Transformation Target Extraction Module (LSTEM) adaptively learns optimal sparse representations in the transform domain for target separation. Third, a Dynamic Attention-Guided Feature Enhancement Module (DAGFEM) enhances the image reconstruction fidelity. Experiments on SIRST V1, NUDT-SIRST, and IRSTD-1K datasets show LST-RPCANet outperforms data-based methods (DNANet ( 148 ) , UIU-Net ( 412 ) , L2SKNet ( 413 ) , SCTransNet ( 414 ) , MLCL-Net ( 415 ) , MSDA-Net ( 416 ) ) and previous deep unfolding methods (RPCANet ( 383 ) , DRPCANet ( 397 ) ) with lightweight parameters.
blocks.zh: 即使这些方法平衡了可解释性和学习能力,它们也遭受了两个主要的弱点:背景估计错误的连锁积累和固定手动的稀有前科的适应性不足. 为了从整体上解决这些限制,Wang等人(388人)设计出一个深层的有活力五氯苯甲醚,并配有可学习的Sparse Transform (LST-RPCANet). 首先,通过注意选择机制,一个多通道注意力监督传输增强模块(MCASTM)阻断错误扩散并净化跨阶段背景特征. 其次,一个可学习的Sparse转换目标提取模块(LSTEM)在转换域中适应性地学习了最佳的稀有表示,用于目标分离. 第三,动态关注-定向特性增强模块(DAGFEM)可增强图像重建的忠诚度。 关于SIRST V1、NUDT-SIRST和IRSTD-1K数据集的实验显示,LST-RPCANet的成绩超过了基于数据的方法(DNANet(148),UIU-Net(412),L2SKNet(413),SCTransNet(414),MLCL-Net(415),MSDA-Net(416)),以及之前深层正在发展的方法(RPCANet(383),DRPCANet(397)),有轻量参数.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, each layer in an RPCA-unfolded network requires SVD of high-dimensional data, which significantly slows inference speed.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,一个RPCA-不重叠的网络中的每一层都需要高维度数据的SVD,这显著地减缓了推论速度.

blocks.en: 6.3 Sparse Representation
blocks.zh: 6.3 代表席位

blocks.en: In 2014, Li et al. ( 417 ) design a sparse representation on a discriminative over-complete dictionary. First, an adaptive morphological over-complete dictionary is trained and built online according to the content of infrared image by K-singular value decomposition (K-SVD) algorithm. Second, an adaptive morphological over-complete dictionary is divided into a target over-complete dictionary describing target signals, and a background over-complete dictionary. This discriminative over-complete dictionary captures significant features of background clutter and dim targets better than a structural over-complete dictionary and also enhances the sparse feature difference between background and target more efficiently than a discriminative over-complete dictionary learned offline and classified manually. Third, the target and background clutter are sparsely decomposed over their corresponding over-complete dictionaries.
blocks.zh: 2014年,李等编著. (417)设计了一种带有歧视性的过于完整的词典上的稀有表述. 首先,一个适应性形态学超完整词典根据红外线图像的内容由K-singular值分解(K-SVD)算法进行在线培训和构建. 其次,一个适应性形态学超完整词典被分为一个描述目标信号的目标超完整词典和一个背景超完整词典. 这种带有歧视性的过于完整的词典比结构上的过于完整的词典更能捕捉到背景杂乱和暗淡目标的重要特征,并且比离线和手工分类的具有歧视性的过度完整的词典提高了背景和目标之间的稀少特征差异。 第三,目标和背景杂乱无章地因相应的过于完整的词典而分解。

blocks.en: In 2016, Wan et al. ( 418 ) propose a non-negativity constraint-based sparse representation. First, a frequency saliency detection based pre-processing extracts candidate regions that possibly contain the target. Second, a target over-complete dictionary is built by a varietal two-dimensional Gaussian model with an extent feature constraint and a background term. Third, a sparse representation model with a non-negativity constraint is employed for the candidate regions to obtain the corresponding coefficient vectors. The detection problem is converted to an l 1 l_{1} -regularized optimization using an Accelerated Proximal Gradient (APG) method. Finally, an evaluation index named Sparse Rate (SR) is employed to extract the real target by an adaptive segmentation directly.
blocks.zh: 2016年,Wan等编. (418)提出以非消极制约为基础的稀有代表制. 首先,基于频率显要检测的预处理提取出可能包含目标的候选区域. 其次,一个目标超完整的词典由可变的二维高斯模型所构建,其范围特征约束和背景名词. 第三,为获得相应的系数矢量,对候选地区采用了一种具有非负性限制的稀有代表模式。 检测出的问题被转换为l 1 l_{1}- 使用加速近相梯度(APG)方法进行正态优化. 最后,采用名为Sparse rate(SR)的评价指数,直接通过适应性分解提取出实际目标.

blocks.en: In 2019, Lu et al. ( 419 ) propose a method based on sparse representation via an online-learned double sparse background dictionary. First, a double sparsity model is used to construct a background dictionary. The Kronecker product of two separable Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) matrices allow to form the base dictionary. It is the first work based on a double sparsity model in the infrared small target detection problems. Second, a modified online learning algorithm is employed to train the dictionary. Thus, the sparse representation based decomposition process relies on an online-learned dictionary. The sparse representation model decompose the target image into background component, target component and noise component. Finally, an edge clutter suppression strategy improves the robustness of detection. Experiments show that this sparse representation model outperforms Top-hat, ILCM ( 191 ) , RLCM ( 199 ) , LIGP ( 300 ) , DECM ( 274 ) and SRvDOCD ( 417 ) .
blocks.zh: 2019年,卢等(419人)通过在线学习双人稀有背景词典,提出以稀有代表性为基础的方法. 首先,用双螺旋模型来构建背景词典. 两个可分解的Cosine Transform(DCT)矩阵的克龙克产品允许形成基词典. 这是基于红外小目标探测问题中的双相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 第二,使用经过修改的在线学习算法来培训词典。 因此,以代表性为基础的分解过程很少依靠在线学习词典。 稀有的表示模型将目标图像分解为背景组件,目标组件和噪音组件. 最后,边缘相接的压制策略可以提高侦测的强度. 实验表明,这种稀有的表示模型的性能超过了Top-hat,ILCM(191),RLCM(199),LIGP(300),DECM(274)和SRvDOCD(417).

blocks.en: 6.4 Multi-Frame Detection
blocks.zh: 6.4 多引信探测

blocks.en: Even if single-frame methods are relatively efficient, they do not take into account the temporal information that are suitable to detect small target features. Different spatiotemporal detection methods have been developed in literature, with spatiotemporal tensor optimization models being particularly notable. The reader can refer to the DLAT website 21 21 21 https://sites.google.com/site/robustdlat/ for a list of representative fundamental papers about diverse robust tensor decompositions.
blocks.zh: 即使单帧方法相对有效,它们也不考虑适合检测出小目标特征的时间信息. 在文献中发展出不同的spatiental检测方法,spatientalalalor优化模型尤其显著. 读者可以参考DLAT网站21 21 21 https://sites.google.com/site/robustdlat/,以获取关于多种强抗拉强度分解的有代表性的基本论文列表.

blocks.en: 6.4.1 Mathematical Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 6.4.1 数学基础

blocks.en: The robust PCA problem formulated in a matrix manner ( 67 ) is expressed in a tensor manner as follows ( 424 ) : 𝒜 = ℒ + 𝒮 \mathcal{A}=\mathcal{L}+\mathcal{S} (15) where ℒ \mathcal{L} is a low-rank tensor and 𝒮 \mathcal{S} must be sparse tensor with a small fraction of nonzero entries. Note that the decomposition problem is more harder than in the matrix case are there are several ways to manage tensor as CP decomposition ( 425 ) , Tücker decomposition ( 426 ) , tubal decomposition ( 427 ) , CUR decomposition ( 428 ) , BM decomposition ( 429 ) and ring decomposition ( 430 ) . Otherwise, the characteristics are the same than in the matrix case in terms of decomposition in two or three tensors, loss functions and solvers. Figure 5 shows an illustration of the decomposition of an observed tensor 𝒜 \mathcal{A} into a low rank tensor ℒ \mathcal{L} and a sparse tensor 𝒮 \mathcal{S} .
blocks.zh: 以矩阵方式(67个)所形成的强力PCA问题以拉伸方式表示如下(424个): A = L + S\ mathcal{ A}=\mathcal{ L}+\mathcal{S} (15个),其中L\mathcal{L}是低等的拉伸式,而S\mathcal{S}必须是稀有的拉伸式,只有一小部分非零入项. 注意分解问题比矩阵情况更难,有几种方法可以管理收分解器:CP分解(425),Tücker分解(426),管分解(427),CUR分解(428),BM分解(429)和环分解(430)等. 否则,在分解出两到三个收分机,损失函数和解析器方面,其特性与矩阵情况相同. 图5显示了一个被观测到的变压器 A\ mathcal{A}分解为低等变压器 L\ mathcal{L}和稀有变压器 S\ mathcal{S}的图解.

blocks.en: 6.4.2 RPCA Tensor based Decomposition
blocks.zh: 6.4.2 《卢旺达刑法》 基于 Tensor 的分解

blocks.en: In 2019, Zhang et al. ( 431 ) propose an Image-Patch Tensor (IPT) model. Based on the structural relationship between pixels, the original single-frame image is stacked as a new image-patch tensor. Based on the correlation of the background image patch and the sparsity of the target image patch, the small target detection problem is formulated into an optimization problem of separating the low-rank part and the sparse part of the tensor. After post filtering, the target is separated adaptively. The IPT model is thus the transformation of the IPI model ( 332 ) published in 2012 from matrix up to tensor seven years later. In practice, the IPT model presents several weaknesses addressed by further works regarding the decomposition, the loss functions, the solver and the computation time. These improvements can be categorized as done in the following items and Table 9 shows an overview classification of the diverse existing LRSD tensor methods applied to infrared small target detection.
blocks.zh: 2019年,张等(431人)提出"影像-Patch Tensor"(IPT)模式. 基于像素之间的结构关系,原始的单帧图像被堆放为新的图像-patch 收音机. 根据背景图像补丁与目标图像补丁的相干性,小目标检测问题被分解出低等部分和低等部分的稀有部分的优化问题. 后过滤后,目标进行适应性分离. 因此,IPT模型是2012年出版的IPI模型(332)由矩阵到7年后的百分数的转变. 在实践中,IPT模型提出了关于分解、损失函数、解答器和计算时间等进一步工作所处理的若干弱点。 这些改进可按下列项目进行分类,表9对红外小目标探测所采用的多种现有LRSD测距法进行了总体分类。

blocks.en: Table 9 : Multi-Frame Detection Unsupervised Tensor Decomposition Methods: An Overview (89 papers).
blocks.zh: 表9:无监督的多光栅探测分解 方法:概述(89篇论文)。

blocks.en:
1. Nuclear-norm and l 1 l_{1} -norm Defects As the nuclear norm is applied on the low rank component related to the background, changing this norm and adding constraints can increase the robustness in the presence complex and noisy backgrounds. Weigthed Norm: In 2018, Sun et al. ( 451 ) propose to employ a weighted tensor nuclear norm. More specifically, a weight tensor is incorporated with tensor nuclear norm to preserve the background edges better. Then, the separation between target and background is formulated as a convex weighted tensor RPCA model. Experiments show that WNRIPT outperforms IPI and RIPT. In 2019, Sun et al. ( 435 ) propose a Spatial–Temporal Infrared Patch-Tensor (STIPT) structure. Considering the overshrinkage problem in low-rank component estimation field caused by vanilla nuclear norm and weighted nuclear norm, weighted Schatten p-norm is employed to improve the performance by considering the particular meaning of different singular values. An Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) is employed as solver and an adaptive threshold is used to separate the targets. Experiments show that STIPT-WNSM outperforms RIPT ( 333 ) , WNRIPT ( 451 ) , WSNMIPT and STIPT-WNNM. In 2019, Zhang and Peng ( 435 ) design a nonconvex low-rank constraint named Partial Sum of Tensor Nuclear Norm (PSTNN) joint weighted l 1 l_{1} -norm to suppress the background and preserve the target. An improved local prior map is also employed to simultaneously encode with target-related and background-related information into the model. A reweighted scheme for enhancing the sparsity and high-efficiency version of tensor singular value decomposition (t-SVD) allow to reduce the algorithm complexity and computation time. Experiments show that PSTNN provide better results than NRAM ( 336 ) , NIPPS, ReWIPI and RIPT. To avoid the problem of insufficient structural information extraction in PSTNN, Sun et al. ( 471 ) employ the local contrast difference between the target and the background designing a double-neighborhood local contrast based on direction residual weighting method (DNLCDRW). It improves the PSTNN’s ability to suppress bright and complex backgrounds by constraining the sparse terms through DNLCDRW, and better improves the ability of IR weak target detection. In 2020, Guan et al. ( 450 ) employ a non-convex tensor rank surrogate joint local contrast energy (NTRS). More specifically, a non-convex tensor rank surrogate merging Tensor Nuclear Norm (TNN) and the Laplace function are employed for low rank background patch-tensor constraint. It allows to adaptively allocate weight for every singular value and better approximate l 0 l_{0} -norm. Considering that the local prior map is equivalent to the saliency map, Guan et al. ( 450 ) design a local contrast energy feature into IPT detection framework to weight target tensor. To remove the structured edges, Guan et al. ( 450 ) employ an additional structured sparse regularization term using the l 1 , 1 , 2 l_{1,1,2} -norm of third-order tensor. Experiments show that NTRS outperforms IPI and RIPT. In 2024, Lu et al. ( 517 ) design a method based on a spatial–temporal feature fusion tensor model. The partial tubal nuclear norm is employed to constrain the low-rank background. Experiments show that STFFT provides better results than Tophat, LCM ( 190 ) , PSTNN and MSLSTIPT ( 518 ) . Total Variation Norm: Traditional Total Variation (TV) regularization based method only considers the spatial information of a single frame, and its efficiency cannot meet the real-time processing requirement. To address this limitation, Sun et al. ( 452 ) design an anisotropic spatial-temporal TV regularization to use both single-frame and inter-frame information. The spatial-temporal TV regularization and weighted IPT model (STTV-WNIPT) allows to separate the target and background. For the low-rank background component, the weighted tensor nuclear norm and spatial-temporal TV regularization are employed to describe the smoothness. For sparse target component and a noise component, the l 1 l_{1} -norm and Frobenius norm terms are used, respectively. Experiments show that STTV-WNIPT outperforms TopHat, IPI ( 332 ) , WNRIPT and TV-PCP. In 2023, Wang et al. ( 465 ) employ a 3D Total variation (3D-TV) to regularize the foreground to take into account the spatial-temporal continuity of the target and to suppress the interference caused by dynamic background and target movement on the foreground extraction. A solver allows he minimization of the non-convex spatial-temporal tensor low-rank approximation algorithm (MNSTLA). Experiments show that NSTLA provide most of the time better results than NARM, RIPT, and WSNMSTIPT. In 2023, Zhao and Xu ( 466 ) design a Tensor l 2 , 1 l_{2,1} -Norm Minimization via T-QR (TLNMTQR) method to isolate the noise and improve computational speed without compromising accuracy. By employing an Asymmetric Spatial-Temporal Total Variation regularization method (ASSTV), the flexibility and efficacy is improved to handle time series data. Experiments show that TLNMTQR outperforms PSTNN ( 159 ) , MTFRA and MSLSTIPT ( 518 ) . In 2025, Ge et al. ( 482 ) propose to use both spatial and temporal information. First, a multi-scale energy
movement saliency map (MESM) is employed for target motion characteristics. This map serves as a sparse prior and is incorporated into the spatio-temporal tensor model giving strong decomposition guidance even when thetarget contrast is weak or overlapped with strong edges. Second, a reweighted scheme integrating motion saliency is designed
based on the minimum temporal projection of the target component after each iteration to suppress background clutter and
enhancing target separation. Third, an overlapping group sparse total variation (OGSTV) regularization from 2D to 3D is used. Experiments show that 3D-OGSTV better distinguishes edges from flat regions than ASTTV-NTLA ( 403 ) , LogTFNN ( 458 ) , ECA-STT ( 402 ) and IMNN-LWEC ( 461 ) . In 2026, Chen et al. ( 476 ) design a structured regularization method named l p l_{p} -MCTV that integrates the l p l_{p} -norm and a Min-max-Concave Total Variation (MCTV) regularization to improve detection accuracy. To suppress the interference due to the complex backgrounds, Chen et al. ( 476 ) use a partial sum minimization of singular values strategy to estimate the background component. In addition, the l p l_{p} -norm regularization allows to extract the target. The MCTV regularization allows to model the noise component. Dynamic Backgrounds: To deal with dynamic backgrounds, Sun et al. ( 472 ) design an Adaptive Spatial-Temporal Infrared Tensor (ASTIT) and Weighted Tensor Average Rank Approximation (WPTAR) method. The ASTIT
construction method uses the structural similarity index measure (SSIM) to dynamically adjust the temporal step to obtain physically accurate representation of background changes and maintaining its low
rank property. Transpose errors are solved by using the weighted Schatten p p -norm and tensor average rank (WPTAR) norm to increase the
physical fidelity of the data representation. Sun et al. ( 472 ) approximate the l 0 l_{0} norm with the p p -norm reconstruction accuracy obtaining a more precise physical depiction of sparse targets. Experiments show that ASTIT-WPTAR outperforms RCTVW ( 355 ) , 4DST-BTMD, IMNN-LWEC ( 461 ) , ASTTV-NTLA ( 403 ) and ECASTT. In 2025, Luo et al. ( 473 ) propose a 5-D Spatial–Temporal Factor-based Completion model (5D-STFC). More specifically, a 5-D whitened spatial–temporal patch-tensor is built. Second, Luo et al. ( 473 ) employ a spatial–temporal factor-based low-rank background estimation norm and a Moreau envelope-derived sparsity estimation norm based on joint spatial–temporal knowledge. Experiments show that 5D-STFC provides better results than FAMSIS ( 234 ) , SSTTC ( 515 ) , 4D-TR ( 456 ) and AGPCNet ( 519 ) . Facet Model: In 2020, Dong et al. ( 436 ) combines a first-order directional derivative of facet model with structural tensor. Four directional derivatives of the
original infrared image are computed from the Facet model. Following the directional derivative feature of the target, the structure tensor eigenvalue matrix allows to enhance the target and to suppress the background clutter. Four salient maps are thus obtained and a final fusion map is obtained by multiplying the salient maps of all directions. Experiments show that Facet-LRSD outperforms Top-hat and LCM. In 2021, Pang et al. ( 437 ) combines a Facet Derivative-based Multidirectional Edge Awareness with Spatial–Temporal Tensor (FDMDEA-STT) The problem is formulated with the prior information of the target and
background in the spatial–temporal domain. Based on the Facet derivative, a multidirectional edge awareness mapping is employed. Pang et al. ( 437 ) fuse it into the model as sparse prior information. Experiments show that FDMDEA-STT provide better results than RIPT and ECA-SST. Graph Laplacian Regularization: In a further work, Luo et al. ( 474 ) propose an Hypergraph Laplacian regularization and Asymmetric Penalty function-based Regularization (HGLAPR). More specifically, a hypergraph structure is built and a hypergraph Laplacian regularization is designed as well as a Laplace-based tensor nuclear norm for low-rank background estimation. Moreover, an asymmetric penalty function-based sparsity regularization is employed for more accurate target estimation. Experiments show that HGLAPR outperforms MSLSTIPT ( 518 ) , 4D-TR ( 456 ) , AGPCNet ( 519 ) and RPCANet ( 383 ) . In 2025, Liu et al. ( 475 ) use also use a Fast Graph Laplacian Regularization (FGLR) instead of nuclear norm to avoid singular value decomposition computation and to reduce computational complexity. In addition, Liu et al. ( 475 ) employ Minimax Concave Penalty (MCP) function instead of l 1 l_{1} -norm to constrains the sparsity of targets. Experiments show that FGLR-MCP provides better results than Top-hat, SMSL, IMNN-LWEC ( 461 ) and 4D-TR ( 456 ) . In 2026, Ge et al. ( 478 ) propose a spectral residual method and design it as a convex regularizer significantly reducing computational costs. In addition, a bimodal slice-based graph Laplacian regularization is employed. Graphs are constructed with slices as vertices in both temporal and spatial dimensions in order to
capture local geometric features while suppressing the complexity of pixel-level graph construction. In addition, Ge et al. ( 478 ) combine single-frame priors and low-cost multi-frame motion posterior information to improve target extraction accuracy. Experiments show that GC outperforms NFTDGSTV ( 520 ) , MSLSTIPT ( 518 ) , ASTTV-NTLA ( 461 ) , 4DST-BTMD ( 469 ) and FGLR-MCP. 2. Heterogeneous Backgrounds When facing highly heterogeneous backgrounds, they would not perform very well because of the existence of strong edges and other interfering components and ignoring the priors fully. In 2017, Dai and Wu al. ( 333 ) propose a Reweighted Infrared Patch-Tensor (RIPT) model with both non-local and local priors. More specifically, Sun et al. ( 333 ) design an entry-wise local structure-adaptive and sparsity enhancing weight to replace the globally constant weighting parameter. The decomposition is then achieved via the element-wise reweighted higher-order RPCA with an additional convergence condition according to the practical situation of target detection. Experiments show that RIPT outperforms IPI ( 332 ) , WIPI, NIPPS, IPT and WIPT. In 2018, Sun et al. ( 451 ) . In 2023, Zhang et al. ( 495 ) design a self-adaptive low-rank sparse tensor decomposition model. The entropy of image block is employed for fast matching of non-local similar blocks to obtain a better sparse tensor for small targets. The adaptive strategy of low-rank sparse tensor decomposition is employed for different background environments, which adaptively compute the weight coefficients. Experiments show that ANLPT outperforms RIPT, PSTNN ( 159 ) and NTFRA ( 458 ) . 3. Computation Time In 2025, Li ( 499 ) propose a four-dimensional infrared tensor using a Bidirectional Tensor Ring (BTR) decomposition to separate weak spatial correlations from strong temporal-patch correlations while simultaneously capturing interactions between these two components. This model is solved with a Proximal Alternating Minimization (PAM) framework. Experiments demonstrate that BTR-ISTD outperforms IPI ( 332 ) , PSTNN ( 159 ) , RIPTT, ECA-SST in terms of detection accuracy, dynamic backgrounds suppression capability, and computational speed.

blocks.en: Nuclear-norm and l 1 l_{1} -norm Defects As the nuclear norm is applied on the low rank component related to the background, changing this norm and adding constraints can increase the robustness in the presence complex and noisy backgrounds.

blocks.en: Weigthed Norm: In 2018, Sun et al. ( 451 ) propose to employ a weighted tensor nuclear norm. More specifically, a weight tensor is incorporated with tensor nuclear norm to preserve the background edges better. Then, the separation between target and background is formulated as a convex weighted tensor RPCA model. Experiments show that WNRIPT outperforms IPI and RIPT. In 2019, Sun et al. ( 435 ) propose a Spatial–Temporal Infrared Patch-Tensor (STIPT) structure. Considering the overshrinkage problem in low-rank component estimation field caused by vanilla nuclear norm and weighted nuclear norm, weighted Schatten p-norm is employed to improve the performance by considering the particular meaning of different singular values. An Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) is employed as solver and an adaptive threshold is used to separate the targets. Experiments show that STIPT-WNSM outperforms RIPT ( 333 ) , WNRIPT ( 451 ) , WSNMIPT and STIPT-WNNM. In 2019, Zhang and Peng ( 435 ) design a nonconvex low-rank constraint named Partial Sum of Tensor Nuclear Norm (PSTNN) joint weighted l 1 l_{1} -norm to suppress the background and preserve the target. An improved local prior map is also employed to simultaneously encode with target-related and background-related information into the model. A reweighted scheme for enhancing the sparsity and high-efficiency version of tensor singular value decomposition (t-SVD) allow to reduce the algorithm complexity and computation time. Experiments show that PSTNN provide better results than NRAM ( 336 ) , NIPPS, ReWIPI and RIPT. To avoid the problem of insufficient structural information extraction in PSTNN, Sun et al. ( 471 ) employ the local contrast difference between the target and the background designing a double-neighborhood local contrast based on direction residual weighting method (DNLCDRW). It improves the PSTNN’s ability to suppress bright and complex backgrounds by constraining the sparse terms through DNLCDRW, and better improves the ability of IR weak target detection. In 2020, Guan et al. ( 450 ) employ a non-convex tensor rank surrogate joint local contrast energy (NTRS). More specifically, a non-convex tensor rank surrogate merging Tensor Nuclear Norm (TNN) and the Laplace function are employed for low rank background patch-tensor constraint. It allows to adaptively allocate weight for every singular value and better approximate l 0 l_{0} -norm. Considering that the local prior map is equivalent to the saliency map, Guan et al. ( 450 ) design a local contrast energy feature into IPT detection framework to weight target tensor. To remove the structured edges, Guan et al. ( 450 ) employ an additional structured sparse regularization term using the l 1 , 1 , 2 l_{1,1,2} -norm of third-order tensor. Experiments show that NTRS outperforms IPI and RIPT. In 2024, Lu et al. ( 517 ) design a method based on a spatial–temporal feature fusion tensor model. The partial tubal nuclear norm is employed to constrain the low-rank background. Experiments show that STFFT provides better results than Tophat, LCM ( 190 ) , PSTNN and MSLSTIPT ( 518 ) .
blocks.zh: 韦克特·诺姆:2018年,孙等. (451) 提议采用加权高压核规范。 更具体地说,一个分量计与分量核规范相结合,以更好地保护背景边缘。 然后,目标与背景的分离被制定为对流加权拉伸式RPCA模型. 实验显示WNRIPT的性能超过了IPI和RIPT. 2019年,孙等. (435)提出空间-时红外补丁-传感器结构. 考虑到香草核规范和加权核规范造成的低等成分估计领域的过度收缩问题,采用了加权的Schatten p-norm,通过考虑不同单值的特殊含义来提高性能. 采用倍数的替代方向方法作为解析器,并使用适应性阈值来分离目标. 实验表明,STIPT-WNSM的成绩超过了RIPT(333),WNRIPT(451),WSNMIPT和STIPT-WNNM. 2019年,由张同鹏(435人)设计出一种非Convex低等约束,命名为"特森核诺姆(PSTNN)部分总分"(Part Sum of Tensor Nuclear Norm (PSTNN)) 联合加权l 1 l_{1}-Norm来压制背景并保留目标. 还使用经过改进的本地先行地图将目标相关信息和背景信息同步编码入模型。 用于增强拉诺单值分解(t-SVD)的相片分解和高效版本的再加权方案可以降低算法的复杂性和计算时间. 实验显示,PSTNN提供了比NRAM(336),NIPPS,ReWIPI和RIPT更好的结果. 为了避免在PSTNN中结构信息提取不足的问题,Sun等人(471人)采用了目标与背景之间的局部对比差,根据方向残留权重法(DNLCDRW)设计出双邻局部对比. 它提高了PSTNN通过DNLCDRW来限制稀有名词来抑制亮而复杂的背景的能力,并更好地提高了IR弱目标检测的能力. 2020年,Guan等(450人)采用非Convex lator级代位法来联合本地对比能(NTRS). 更具体地说,一个非Convex lator级代词将Tensor Nuclear Norm(TNN)和Laplace函数合并,用于低等背景补丁-收缩限制. 它允许适应性地分配每个单值的权重, 并且更接近于l 0. - 规范。 考虑到本地先行地圖等同相關地圖,Cuan等 (450) 在IPT检测框架中设计出局部对比能特征来重取目标收分. 为了去除结构化边缘, Cuan等. (450) 使用l 1, 1, 2 l 1, 1, 1, 2} - 三等抗拉器的规范, 使用另一个结构化的稀有规范化术语。 实验显示NTRS的性能超过了IPI和RIPT. 2024年,Lu等 (517)根据空间-时态特征聚变拉伸模型设计出一种方法. 部分管状核规范被用来限制低级背景。 实验显示,STFT提供的结果优于Tophat,LCM (190),PSTNN和MSLSTIPT (518).

blocks.en:
Total Variation Norm: Traditional Total Variation (TV) regularization based method only considers the spatial information of a single frame, and its efficiency cannot meet the real-time processing requirement. To address this limitation, Sun et al. ( 452 ) design an anisotropic spatial-temporal TV regularization to use both single-frame and inter-frame information. The spatial-temporal TV regularization and weighted IPT model (STTV-WNIPT) allows to separate the target and background. For the low-rank background component, the weighted tensor nuclear norm and spatial-temporal TV regularization are employed to describe the smoothness. For sparse target component and a noise component, the l 1 l_{1} -norm and Frobenius norm terms are used, respectively. Experiments show that STTV-WNIPT outperforms TopHat, IPI ( 332 ) , WNRIPT and TV-PCP. In 2023, Wang et al. ( 465 ) employ a 3D Total variation (3D-TV) to regularize the foreground to take into account the spatial-temporal continuity of the target and to suppress the interference caused by dynamic background and target movement on the foreground extraction. A solver allows he minimization of the non-convex spatial-temporal tensor low-rank approximation algorithm (MNSTLA). Experiments show that NSTLA provide most of the time better results than NARM, RIPT, and WSNMSTIPT. In 2023, Zhao and Xu ( 466 ) design a Tensor l 2 , 1 l_{2,1} -Norm Minimization via T-QR (TLNMTQR) method to isolate the noise and improve computational speed without compromising accuracy. By employing an Asymmetric Spatial-Temporal Total Variation regularization method (ASSTV), the flexibility and efficacy is improved to handle time series data. Experiments show that TLNMTQR outperforms PSTNN ( 159 ) , MTFRA and MSLSTIPT ( 518 ) . In 2025, Ge et al. ( 482 ) propose to use both spatial and temporal information. First, a multi-scale energy
movement saliency map (MESM) is employed for target motion characteristics. This map serves as a sparse prior and is incorporated into the spatio-temporal tensor model giving strong decomposition guidance even when thetarget contrast is weak or overlapped with strong edges. Second, a reweighted scheme integrating motion saliency is designed
based on the minimum temporal projection of the target component after each iteration to suppress background clutter and
enhancing target separation. Third, an overlapping group sparse total variation (OGSTV) regularization from 2D to 3D is used. Experiments show that 3D-OGSTV better distinguishes edges from flat regions than ASTTV-NTLA ( 403 ) , LogTFNN ( 458 ) , ECA-STT ( 402 ) and IMNN-LWEC ( 461 ) . In 2026, Chen et al. ( 476 ) design a structured regularization method named l p l_{p} -MCTV that integrates the l p l_{p} -norm and a Min-max-Concave Total Variation (MCTV) regularization to improve detection accuracy. To suppress the interference due to the complex backgrounds, Chen et al. ( 476 ) use a partial sum minimization of singular values strategy to estimate the background component. In addition, the l p l_{p} -norm regularization allows to extract the target. The MCTV regularization allows to model the noise component.
blocks.zh:
共计变化 Norm:传统Total Variation(TV)正规化方法只考虑单一帧的空间信息,其效率无法满足实时处理要求. 为了解决这一限制,Sun等人。 (452)设计出异同位素时空电视规范化,既使用单帧又使用相机间信息. 时空电视规范化和加权式IPT模型(STTV-WNIPT)可以将目标和背景分开. 对于低等背景成分,采用加权收发率核规范和时空电视规范来描述光滑. 对于零散的目标组件和噪音组件,l1 l_{1} -Norm和Frobenius规范术语分别被使用. 实验显示,STTV-WNIPT优于TopHat,IPI (332),WNRIPT和TV-PCP. 2023年,王等编. (465)采用3D总变异(3D-TV)使前地规范化,以考虑到目标在空间-时间上的连续性并抑制动态背景和目标运动在前地取出上造成的干扰. 溶解器允许他将非凸起空间-时态的拉诺低等相近算法(MNSTLA)最小化. 实验显示,NSTLA提供了大部分时间比NARM,RIPT,和WSNMSTIPT更好的结果. 2023年,赵和徐(466人)设计出一款"通索"一"一""一""一""一""一""一""一""一""一""一""一""一""一""一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一"一""""""""""""""""""""""" -通过T-QR(TLNMTQR)方法将噪音隔离,提高计算速度而不损害准确性。 通过采用非对称空间-时空总变异规范化方法(ASSTV)来提高处理时间序列数据的灵活性和效能. 实验显示,TLNMTQR的性能超过了PSTNN(159),MTFRA和MSLSTIPT(518). 2025年,Ge等人(482人)提议同时使用空间和时间信息. 一,多尺度能
运动相干图(MESM)用于目标运动特性. 这幅地图充当了稀有的前作并被收录入斯皮提奥-时态拉伸模型中,提供强大的分解指导,即使目标对比弱或与强边相重叠. 第二,设计了一种重新加权的结合运动特征的计划。
根据目标组成部分每次迭接后的最低时间预测,以压制背景杂乱和
加强目标分离。 第三,采用重叠组零星总变异(OGSTV)从2D到3D的正态. 实验显示,3D-OGSTV比ASTTV-NTLA(403),LogTFNN(458),ECA-STT(402)和IMNN-LWEC(461)更能区分平地区域的边缘. 2026年,陈等. (476)设计出一种结构化的规范化方法,取名为lp l_{p}-MCTV,将lp l_{p}-Norm和一分Min-max-Conge Total Variation(MCTV)规范化,以提高检测精度. 为了抑制由复杂背景引起的干扰,Chen等人(476人)使用将单数策略最小化的部分和数来估计背景成分. 此外, l p l_{p} - 规范化允许提取目标. MCTV规范化可以对噪声部分进行建模.

blocks.en:
Dynamic Backgrounds: To deal with dynamic backgrounds, Sun et al. ( 472 ) design an Adaptive Spatial-Temporal Infrared Tensor (ASTIT) and Weighted Tensor Average Rank Approximation (WPTAR) method. The ASTIT
construction method uses the structural similarity index measure (SSIM) to dynamically adjust the temporal step to obtain physically accurate representation of background changes and maintaining its low
rank property. Transpose errors are solved by using the weighted Schatten p p -norm and tensor average rank (WPTAR) norm to increase the
physical fidelity of the data representation. Sun et al. ( 472 ) approximate the l 0 l_{0} norm with the p p -norm reconstruction accuracy obtaining a more precise physical depiction of sparse targets. Experiments show that ASTIT-WPTAR outperforms RCTVW ( 355 ) , 4DST-BTMD, IMNN-LWEC ( 461 ) , ASTTV-NTLA ( 403 ) and ECASTT. In 2025, Luo et al. ( 473 ) propose a 5-D Spatial–Temporal Factor-based Completion model (5D-STFC). More specifically, a 5-D whitened spatial–temporal patch-tensor is built. Second, Luo et al. ( 473 ) employ a spatial–temporal factor-based low-rank background estimation norm and a Moreau envelope-derived sparsity estimation norm based on joint spatial–temporal knowledge. Experiments show that 5D-STFC provides better results than FAMSIS ( 234 ) , SSTTC ( 515 ) , 4D-TR ( 456 ) and AGPCNet ( 519 ) .
blocks.zh:
动态背景 : 为了应对动态背景,Sun等. (472) 设计一种可适应的空间-时红外振荡法(ASTIT)和加权振荡平分振荡法(WPTAR)。 援助
构造方法使用结构相似度指数度量(SSIM)来动态地调整时间步骤,以获得对背景变化的物理准确的表述并保持其低水平.
军衔财产。 通过使用加权的 Schatten p-norm (WPTAR) 和 radio 平均等分( WPTAR) 规范来增加
数据表示的物理可靠性。 Sun et al. (472 ) 与 p-norm 重建的精确度相近,获得了对稀有目标的更精确的物理描述. 实验显示,ASTIT-WPTAR的成绩超过了RCTVW(355),4DST-BTMD,IMNN-LWEC(461),ASTTV-NTLA(403)和ECASTT. 在2025年,Luo等人(473人)提出了基于5D空间-时间因素的完成模型(5D-STFC). 更具体地说,建造了5-D白化的空间-时段补丁-收分. 二,罗等. (473) 采用基于空间-时间因子的低等背景估计规范,并采用基于共同空间-时间知识的由Moreau信封衍生的伸缩性估计规范。 实验显示,5D-STFC比FAMSIS(234),STTC(515),4D-TR(456)和AGPCNet(519)提供更好的结果.

blocks.en:
Facet Model: In 2020, Dong et al. ( 436 ) combines a first-order directional derivative of facet model with structural tensor. Four directional derivatives of the
original infrared image are computed from the Facet model. Following the directional derivative feature of the target, the structure tensor eigenvalue matrix allows to enhance the target and to suppress the background clutter. Four salient maps are thus obtained and a final fusion map is obtained by multiplying the salient maps of all directions. Experiments show that Facet-LRSD outperforms Top-hat and LCM. In 2021, Pang et al. ( 437 ) combines a Facet Derivative-based Multidirectional Edge Awareness with Spatial–Temporal Tensor (FDMDEA-STT) The problem is formulated with the prior information of the target and
background in the spatial–temporal domain. Based on the Facet derivative, a multidirectional edge awareness mapping is employed. Pang et al. ( 437 ) fuse it into the model as sparse prior information. Experiments show that FDMDEA-STT provide better results than RIPT and ECA-SST.
blocks.zh:
Facet 模型 : 2020年,董等编. (436)将面相模型的一阶取向衍生物与结构拉伸结合. 四个方向衍生物
从Facet模型中计算出原始红外图像。 遵循目标的方向衍生特征,结构lator eigenvalt矩阵可以增强目标并压制背景的杂乱. 因此获得了四张显要地图,并通过将所有方向的显要地图相乘而获得最后的聚变地图. 实验显示,Facet-LRSD的表现优于Top-hat和LCM. 2021年,Pang等(437)将Facet衍生出多向边缘意识与空间-时空天线(FDMDEA-STT)结合. 问题是根据目标对象的事先信息来阐述的。
空间-时域的背景。 基于Facet衍生工具,采用了多向边缘意识映射. Pang等人(437人)将其装入模型中,作为稀有的先前信息。 实验显示,FDMDEA-STT比RIPT和ECA-SST提供更好的结果.

blocks.en:
Graph Laplacian Regularization: In a further work, Luo et al. ( 474 ) propose an Hypergraph Laplacian regularization and Asymmetric Penalty function-based Regularization (HGLAPR). More specifically, a hypergraph structure is built and a hypergraph Laplacian regularization is designed as well as a Laplace-based tensor nuclear norm for low-rank background estimation. Moreover, an asymmetric penalty function-based sparsity regularization is employed for more accurate target estimation. Experiments show that HGLAPR outperforms MSLSTIPT ( 518 ) , 4D-TR ( 456 ) , AGPCNet ( 519 ) and RPCANet ( 383 ) . In 2025, Liu et al. ( 475 ) use also use a Fast Graph Laplacian Regularization (FGLR) instead of nuclear norm to avoid singular value decomposition computation and to reduce computational complexity. In addition, Liu et al. ( 475 ) employ Minimax Concave Penalty (MCP) function instead of l 1 l_{1} -norm to constrains the sparsity of targets. Experiments show that FGLR-MCP provides better results than Top-hat, SMSL, IMNN-LWEC ( 461 ) and 4D-TR ( 456 ) . In 2026, Ge et al. ( 478 ) propose a spectral residual method and design it as a convex regularizer significantly reducing computational costs. In addition, a bimodal slice-based graph Laplacian regularization is employed. Graphs are constructed with slices as vertices in both temporal and spatial dimensions in order to
capture local geometric features while suppressing the complexity of pixel-level graph construction. In addition, Ge et al. ( 478 ) combine single-frame priors and low-cost multi-frame motion posterior information to improve target extraction accuracy. Experiments show that GC outperforms NFTDGSTV ( 520 ) , MSLSTIPT ( 518 ) , ASTTV-NTLA ( 461 ) , 4DST-BTMD ( 469 ) and FGLR-MCP.
blocks.zh:
图表 Laplacian 正规化: 在进一步的工作上,罗等. (474)提议采用超图Laplacian规范化和基于不对称惩罚功能的规范化(HGLAPRA)。 更具体地说,构建了高频图结构,设计了高频图Laplacian正规化,并为低级背景估计设计了以拉普拉斯为主的高压核规范. 此外,为了进行更准确的目标估计,还采用了基于非对称惩罚功能的伸缩调节。 实验表明,HGLAPRA的绩效超过了MSLSTIPT(518),4D-TR(456),AGPCNet(519)和RPCANet(383). 2025年,刘等(475人)也使用快图拉普拉斯规范化(FGLR)来代替核规范来避免单数分解计算并降低计算复杂性. 此外,Liu等人(475人)使用Minimax Concave Peace(MCP)功能,而不是l1 l_{1} - 用来约束目标的僵硬性 实验显示FGLR-MCP比Top-hat,SMSL,IMNN-LWEC(461)和4D-TR(456)提供更好的效果. 2026年,Ge等(478)提出了光谱残存方法并被设计为对流调节器,大幅降低了计算成本. 此外,还采用了双模式的Laplacian平面图。 在时间和空间两个方面用切片作为顶点来构建图,以便
抓取局部几何特征,同时抑制像素级图形构造的复杂性. 此外,Ge等人(478人)将单帧前传和低成本多帧后传运动信息结合起来,以提高目标提取精度. 实验显示GC的性能超过NFTDGSTV(520),MSLSTIPT(518),ASTTV-NTLA(461),4DST-BTMD(469)和FGLR-MCP.

blocks.en: Heterogeneous Backgrounds When facing highly heterogeneous backgrounds, they would not perform very well because of the existence of strong edges and other interfering components and ignoring the priors fully. In 2017, Dai and Wu al. ( 333 ) propose a Reweighted Infrared Patch-Tensor (RIPT) model with both non-local and local priors. More specifically, Sun et al. ( 333 ) design an entry-wise local structure-adaptive and sparsity enhancing weight to replace the globally constant weighting parameter. The decomposition is then achieved via the element-wise reweighted higher-order RPCA with an additional convergence condition according to the practical situation of target detection. Experiments show that RIPT outperforms IPI ( 332 ) , WIPI, NIPPS, IPT and WIPT. In 2018, Sun et al. ( 451 ) . In 2023, Zhang et al. ( 495 ) design a self-adaptive low-rank sparse tensor decomposition model. The entropy of image block is employed for fast matching of non-local similar blocks to obtain a better sparse tensor for small targets. The adaptive strategy of low-rank sparse tensor decomposition is employed for different background environments, which adaptively compute the weight coefficients. Experiments show that ANLPT outperforms RIPT, PSTNN ( 159 ) and NTFRA ( 458 ) .
blocks.zh: 不同背景 在面临高度多样化的背景时,由于存在强优势和其他干扰成分并完全忽视前科,它们的表现不会很好. 2017年,戴与吴 al. (333)提出与非本地和本地前身的再加权红外补丁-传感器模型. 更具体地说,孙等. (333)设计出一个入门的局部结构适应和斯帕力增强的重量来取代全球常数加权参数. 分解后再由元素感再加权的更高级的RPCA实现,并根据目标检测的实际情况,附加了收缩条件. 实验显示RIPT的性能超过了IPI(332),WIPI,NIPPS,IPT和WIPT. 2018年,孙等 (451). 2023年,张等(495人)设计出自适应型低平分级稀有喇叭分解模型. 图像块的 en被用于快速匹配非局部相类似的块来为小目标获得更稀少的收音机. 低等稀有拉伸分解的适应策略适用于不同的背景环境,适应性地计算出重量系数. 实验显示,ANLPT优于RIPT,PSTNN (159)和NTFRA (458).

blocks.en: Computation Time In 2025, Li ( 499 ) propose a four-dimensional infrared tensor using a Bidirectional Tensor Ring (BTR) decomposition to separate weak spatial correlations from strong temporal-patch correlations while simultaneously capturing interactions between these two components. This model is solved with a Proximal Alternating Minimization (PAM) framework. Experiments demonstrate that BTR-ISTD outperforms IPI ( 332 ) , PSTNN ( 159 ) , RIPTT, ECA-SST in terms of detection accuracy, dynamic backgrounds suppression capability, and computational speed.
blocks.zh: 计算时间 2025年,李克用(499人)提出使用双向天线环(BTR)分解来分解微弱的空间相通性与强烈的时标相通性,同时捕捉这两个元件之间的相互作用. 这个模型用一个近相替代最小化(PAM)框架来解决. 实验表明,BTR-ISTD在检测准确性、动态背景压制能力和计算速度方面都超过了IPI(332),PSTNN(159),RIPTT,ECA-SST.

blocks.en: 6.4.3 RTC Tensor based Decomposition
blocks.zh: 6.4.3 研究和技术合作 基于 Tensor 的分解

blocks.en: In 2020, Zhu et al. ( 512 ) design a low-rank tensor completion with Top-Hat regularization in order to take both the structural prior knowledge of the target and the self-correlation of the background into account. First, a tensor model for the high-dimensional structural characteristics of multiframe infrared images is constructed. Second, a method based on low-rank tensor completion with top-hat regularization is developed. Third, a closed solution to the optimization algorithm is given to solve the formulation problem. In a further work, Deng et al. ( 513 ) propose a generalized low-rank double-tensor nuclear norm completion framework. More specifically, this LRSD framework employ the double nuclear norm and ring-structural elements. Indeed, the double nuclear norm instead of the single nuclear norm as is employ in the relaxation of the rank function. It solves the problem that the suboptimal solution deviates from the original solution and better approaches the rank minimization. Moreover, weighted ring structural elements are used instead of traditional structural elements to make better use of the target information and its surrounding background. In 2026, Chen et al. ( 514 ) propose a Nonconvex Relaxed Low-Rank Tensor Completion (NRLTC) approximated by using a non convex function to the singular values of the tensor’s squared processing matrix. In addition, Chen et al. ( 514 ) develop a reweighted multidirectional structural prior which adaptively integrates multidirectional edge responses to enforce true target structures while eliminating strong background edges and discrete noise. Thus, the prior preserves target details and avoid overshrinkage during detection. Experiments show that NRLTC outperforms IPI and NARM.
blocks.zh: 2020年,朱等编著. (512)设计了低档的收音机完成Top-Hat规范化,以既考虑对目标的结构前知又考虑背景的自相通. 首先,构建了多帧红外图像高维结构特征的拉伸模型. 二,制定以低排名的拉伸式完成为主,并实行高帽规范化. 第三,给出一个最优化算法的封闭解决方案,以解决配制问题. 在更进一步的工作中,邓等. (513)提出通用低级双高分核规范完成框架. 更具体地说,这个LRSD框架采用了双核规范和环结构元素. 事实上,双重核规范而不是在放松军衔职能时采用的单一核规范。 它解决了一个问题,即不理想的解决方案偏离了最初的解决方案,而更好的方法就是降低排名。 此外,使用加权环结构元素而不是传统结构元素来更好地利用目标信息及其周围背景. 2026年,Chen等人(514人)提出Nonconvex relaxed Low-Rank Tensor Information(NRLTC),取而代之的是使用非对流函数来取自Lenor平方处理矩阵的单数. 此外,陈等. (514 )开发出重分量多向结构,在之前可适应性地整合多向边缘响应,以强制实施真正的目标结构,同时去除强烈的背景边缘和离散噪声. 因此,前作保存了目标细节并避免了被检测时的过度收缩. 实验显示NRLTC的性能超过了IPI和NARM.

blocks.en: 6.4.4 Multi-subspace Learning
blocks.zh: 6.4.4 多子空间学习

blocks.en: Previous robust subspace methods seek for one subspace presenting weaknesses to consider the complex and heterogeneous backgrounds in infrared images. In 2017, Wang et al. ( 521 ) propose a stable multi-subspace learning approach to deal with heterogeneous scene.
blocks.zh: 以往的强力子空间方法寻求一个存在弱点的子空间,以考虑红外图像中复杂而多样的背景. 2017年,王等(521人)提出了稳定的多子空间学习方法,以应对多相异景.

blocks.en: In 2021, Sun et al. ( 518 ) design a Multiple Subspace Learning and Spatial-Temporal Patch-Tensor (MSLSTIPT) framework. First, a tensor data structure is built to employ inner correlation in spatial and temporal domain. Second, MSLSTIPT promotes the multi-subspace property to tensor domain to separate the target and the background more accurately. Third, an optimization algorithm based on Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) allows to solve the corresponding minimization problem.
blocks.zh: 2021年,孙等. (518)设计多子空间学习和空间-临时补丁-传感器(MSLSTIPT)框架. 首先,构建了以使用空间和时间域的内在关联性为目的的等分数数据结构. 其次,MSLSTIPT将多子空间属性推广到收发域,以更准确地将目标和背景分开. 第三,一个基于倍数的换位方向法(ADMM)的优化算法可以解决相应的最小化问题.

blocks.en: 7 Resources and Codes
blocks.zh: 7 资源和守则

blocks.en: 7.1 Target Detection WebSite
blocks.zh: 7.1 目标探测网

blocks.en: This website contains a full list of 610 references in the field, links to 19 available datasets and to 161 codes. For each category, the list is regularly updated and classified following the mathematical, machine learning and signal processing models. An overview of the content of the Target Detection Website 22 22 22 https://sites.google.com/site/targetdetectionwebsite/ is given at the home page.
blocks.zh: 该网站载有一份实地610个参考文献的完整清单,19个现有数据集和161个代码的链接. 对于每个类别,列表都会按照数学,机器学习和信号处理模型定期更新并分类. 主页概述了目标探测网站22 22 22 https://sites.google.com/site/target detectionwebsite/的内容。

blocks.en: 7.2 Codes
blocks.zh: 7.2 编码

blocks.en: Several codes are available on GitHub and provided by the authors. Moreover, repositories groups a collection of SOTA algorithms and toolbox solutions are also available as follows: 1. Repositories: First, Tianfang Zhang groups approximatively 67 links to the codes released on GitHub, 107 links to papers in the field, 18 links to datasets and three recommended surveys papers at his Awesome Infrared Small Targets GitHub page 23 23 23 https://github.com/Tianfang-Zhang/awesome-infrared-small-targets . These codes are classified into the following categories: Background suppression-based methods (7 papers, 2 codes), human visual system-based methods (15 papers), optimization-based methods (30 papers, 18 codes), deep learning-based methods (51 papers, 42 codes), and deep unfolding-based methods (4 papers, 4 codes). Even if this repository is directly provided on GitHub and classified algorithms into categories, the Target Detection Website provides more links with 161 codes. 2. Toolbox Solutions: For the ICPR 24 24 24 2024 Competition on Resource-Limited Infrared Small Target Detection Challenge , a toolbox named Basited methods that can not be ucIRSTD was provided. More specifically, BasicIRSTD 25 25 25 https://github.com/XinyiYing/BasicIRSTD is a PyTorch-based open-source and easy-to-use toolbox for infrared small target detection. This toolbox provides a simple pipeline to train/test methods, and builds a benchmark to evaluate the performance of existing methods. The BasicIRSTD helps researchers to get access to infrared small target detection quickly, and facilitates the development of novel methods. In 2025, Wu et al. ( 63 ) provide the TensorISTD toolbox 26 26 26 https://github.com/fengyiwu98/TensorISTD ( 63 ) which is an open-source MATLAB toolbox designed for optimization-based ISTD research and evaluation. TensorISTD provides a unified, streamlined evaluation pipeline covering: Single-frame/Multi-frame detection, Matrix/ Tensor representations, and evaluation metrics (SCRG, BSF, CG, and 3D-ROC series). TensorISTD allows quick prototyping and verification of optimization-based detection methods. In summary, TensorISTD provides is a toolbox for LRSD methods while BasicIRSTD appears to be able to manage all the categories of methods.
