blocks.en: 8 Datasets
blocks.zh: 8个数据集

blocks.en: The various datasets can be classified into two main categories: visual datasets and datasets that includes both image and text modalities. They can be further sub-classified into small-scale datasets and large-scale datasets. In 2026, Zhang et al. ( 522 ) divided datasets into two categories: sparse-target datasets and dense-target datasets.
blocks.zh: 各种数据集可以分为两大类:视觉数据集和包含图像和文本模式的数据集. 它们可以被进一步细分为小型数据集和大型数据集. 2026年,张等(522年)将数据集分为"稀有目标数据集"和"稠密目标数据集"两类.

blocks.en: The first datasets have been designed for sparse-target scenarios, where each frame contains only a few isolated targets and the minimum inter-target distance is relatively large. These datasets are thus focus on sparse-target conditions and do not reflect scenarios where multiple small targets appear densely within a single frame. To address these limitations, researchers have increasingly shifted their attention toward dense infrared small target detection (dense ISTD) ( 522 ) .
blocks.zh: 第一个数据集是为零星的目标设想设计的,每个框架只包含几个孤立的目标,最小的目标间距离相对较大. 因此,这些数据集侧重于分散的目标条件,并不反映多个小目标在一个框架内出现密集的情景。 为了克服这些局限性,研究人员越来越将注意力转向密集的红外小目标探测(ense ISTD)(522).

blocks.en: 8.1 Visual Modality Datasets
blocks.zh: 8.1 视觉模式数据集

blocks.en: Visual modality datasets are the first datasets available in the field and they progressively move from sparse-target datasets/small-size datasets up to dense-target datasets/large scale datasets. These datasets can be categorized as follows.
blocks.zh: 可视模式数据集是外地最早可用的数据集,它们逐渐从零星的目标数据集/小尺寸数据集转移到密集的目标数据集/大尺度数据集. 这些数据集可分类如下.

blocks.en: 8.1.1 General Environments
blocks.zh: 8.1.1 一般环境

blocks.en: This section lists both small and large-scale datasets for sparse and dense target detections. The datasets can be listed as follows.
blocks.zh: 本节列出小型和大型数据集,用于稀疏和密集的目标探测. 数据集列表如下.

blocks.en: 8.1.2 Small-Scale Datasets
blocks.zh: 8.1.2 小规模数据集

blocks.en:
Small-scale datasets have been developed at the beginning of serious performance evaluation of infrared small target detection and they can be enumerated as follows: 1. SIRST Dataset (2019): This dataset provided by Wang et al. ( 523 ) includes 10000 training images and 100 test images. Neverthless, many targets do not meet the definition of Society of Photo-Optical Instrumentation Engineers (SPIE) and present synthesized traces with illogical annotations. These problems may lead to the inapplicability toward SIRST detection ( 148 ) . 2. NUST-SIRST Dataset (2019): The NUST-SIRST 27 27 27 https://github.com/wanghuanphd/MDvsFA_cGAN dataset introduced by Wang et al. ( 523 ) in 2019 contains approximately 10,000 training images and 100 test images, representing the first publicly available benchmark for deep learning based ISTD. However, targets are synthetically generated via Gaussian sampling, causing labeled masks to be systematically inflated beyond true target boundaries and violating the SPIE small-target definition. These annotation inconsistencies have led subsequent works to advise against its use as a primary benchmark ( 524 ) , though it remains a standard historical baseline for longitudinal comparison. 3. DAUB Dataset (2019): This dataset developed by Hui et al. ( 525 ) contains 21 image sequences, 30 trajectories and 16177 frames in relation to 16944 targets. Each target corresponds to a label location in the image, and each image sequence corresponds to a label file. 4. NUAA-SIRST Dataset (2021): The NUAA-SIRST dataset 28 28 28 https://github.com/YimianDai/sirst is provided by Dai et al. ( 526 ) with high-quality images and labels. However, the number of images is 427 (256 for training), which cannot well cover dramatic scene changes in infrared small target detection. Moreover, these real infrared data are all manually labeled with many inaccurately labeled pixels. 5. NUDT-SIRST Dataset (2021): Li et al. ( 148 ) developed the NUDT -SIRST dataset with numerous categories of target, various target sizes, diverse clutter backgrounds, and accurate annotations. The NUDT-SIRST dataset contains 5 main background scenes including city, field, highlight, sea, and cloud. Each image is synthesized from real background with various targets (e.g., point, spot, and extended) under various SCR and rich poses. Most of the background images are collected by Li et al. ( 148 ) and a few field-type background images come from Hui et al. ( 525 ) . 6. IRSTD-1K Dataset (2022): The IRSTD-1K dataset ( 527 ) contains a collection of 1,000 IR images obtained in real-world scenarios using an IR camera. These images have dimensions of 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels. The targets have been labeled at the pixel level. A variety of small targets are presents such as drones, persons, vehicles and boats. These targets have been captured at different locations, and the images are acquired from considerable imaging distances. The dataset offers a various environments such as natural, urban and maritime under different atmospheric conditions. The backgrounds show notable clutter and noise increasing the difficulty for the detection and recognition of targets. Thus, this dataset is suitable for comprehensive assessments and method benchmarking. 7. SISD Dataset (2022): This dataset 29 29 29 https://github.com/echo-sky/SISD proposed by Wu et al. ( 528 ) . 8. DenseSIRST Dataset (2024): The DenseSIRST Dataset 30 30 30 https://github.com/GrokCV/DenseSIRST released by Xiao et al. ( 529 ) addresses both the clustered target detection challenge and the background semantic modeling requirement. (a) Dense Target Scenarios: Transitioning from sparse to clustered target configurations that reflect real-world deployment conditions. (b) Background Semantic Annotations: Offering detailed per-pixel semantic segmentation of background regions, classified into sky and non-sky classes, thereby allowing background semantic modeling. 9. SIRST-V2 Dataset (2023): The SIRST-V2 31 31 31 https://github.com/YimianDai/open-sirst-v2 provided by Dai et al. ( 530 ) includes 515 real infrared images selected from thousands of infrared sequences. Nevertheless, its moderate size still constrains the training of large capacity models without additional augmentation, and the variable resolution images introduce inconsistencies in evaluation protocols across methods that assume a fixed input size ( 527 ) . These problems may lead to the inapplicability toward robust SIRST detection ( 66 ) . 10. NCHU-SIRST Dataset (2023): The NCHU-SIRST 32 32 32 https://github.com/PCwenyue/CAFF-Net-method-and-the-NCHU-SIRST-dataset released by Shi et al. ( 531 ) is a real-world infrared small target dataset captured using an infrared camera, comprising 590 manually selected images from 6,300 raw infrared photographs. It contains 273 training frames and 317 test frames, covering six background scene categories: architecture, cloudless sky, complex clouds, continuous clouds, sea, and trees. The dataset includes aircraft, birds, and ships as target types, with target sizes ranging from 3×3 to 9×9 pixels in strict conformance with the SPIE small-target definition, providing a reliable real-world evaluation reference for infrared small target detection methods. 11. MassMIND Dataset (2023) This dataset 33 33 33 https://github.com/uml-marine-robotics/MassMIND ( 532 ) of real-life Long Wave Infrared (LWIR) images consists of 2916 diverse LWIR images captured in and around the Boston Harbor in Massachusetts, USA over a span of 2 years. The images have been recorded in a busy marine area as well as in not so busy ocean waters during various seasons and times of the day creating seasonal and temporal diversity. Each image has been segmented with pixel level instance segmentation and labeled across 7 different classes. 12. MWIRSTD Dataset (2024): The MWIRSTD 34 34 34 https://github.com/avinres/MWIRSTD proposed by Kumar et al. ( 533 ) includes 1053 real Mid-Wave Infrared (MWIR) images drawn from 14 video sequences, annotated across three distinct classes of small objects captured using cooled MWIR imagers.
Its limited scale still constrains the training of large capacity models without additional augmentation, and the fixed resolution of 640 × 512 640\times 512 pixels, while consistent, restricts generalization to other sensor configurations and imaging conditions. These problems may lead to inapplicability toward robust SIRST detection in diverse real-world scenarios ( 533 ) . 13. TSIRMT Dataset (2024): The TSIRMT 35 35 35 https://github.com/lifier/LMAFormer dataset, introduced by Huang et al. ( 534 ) , is a multi-frame sequential infrared benchmark designed to evaluate spatiotemporal detectors under conditions where simultaneous target and platform motion produce strong coupling between target signatures and background clutter. 14. DenseSIRST Dataset (2024): This dataset 36 36 36 https://github.com/GrokCV/DenseSIRST is a rigorous annotated infrared image dataset filled with densely clustered small objects. It is realistic and challenging benchmark for algorithm training and evaluation. 15. DMIST dataset (2024): The DMIST dataset 37 37 37 https://github.com/UESTC-nnLab/DMIST proposed by Chen et al. ( 535 ) group two special dense moving target datasets (DMIST-60 and DMIST-100) on DAUB data. They both contain far more than 50 infrared small targets per frame. 16. DSISTD Dataset (2024): The DSISTD dataset 38 38 38 https://github.com/UESTC-nnLab/DMIST proposed by Chen et al. ( 535 ) is a drone swarm infrared small target dataset that integrates real drone targets into simulated infrared backgrounds. 17. SIRST-UAVB Dataset (2024): The SIRST-UAVB 39 39 39 https://ieee-dataport.org/documents/sirst-uavb-single-frame-infrared-small-target-dataset-uav-and-birds dataset, introduced by Yang et al. ( 536 ) , comprises 3,000 real single frame mid-wave infrared images captured using a cooled MWIR camera at a fixed resolution of 640 × \times 512 pixels and shooting distances ranging from 100 to 800 metres. Targets, consisting of UAVs and birds, account for 94.3% of the data and are presented against complex backgrounds. Nevertheless, the dataset exclusive focus on two target categories UAVs and birds, restricts its diversity relative to broader SIRST benchmarks. These factors may reduce its applicability toward comprehensive and robust SIRST detection across diverse operational conditions.
blocks.zh:
在对红外小目标探测进行认真的性能评价开始时就开发出小规模数据集,可以列举如下: 1. SIRST数据集(2019年): 本数据集由王等提供. (523)包括1000个训练图像和100个测试图像. Neverthless,许多目标不符合相片-取光仪表工程师学会(SPIE)的定义,并呈现出有不逻辑说明的合成痕迹. 这些问题可能导致SIRST检测(148)不适用。 2. NUST-SIRST数据集 (2019): NUST-SIRST 27 27 https://github.com/wanghuanphd/MDvsFA_cGAN Wang et al. (523)在2019年推出的数据集包含约一万个训练图像和100个测试图像,代表了第一个公开的基于深层学习的ISTD基准. 然而,目标是通过高斯取样合成生成的,导致被标注的口罩被系统性地膨胀到超出真正的目标界限,并违反了SPIE小目标定义. 这些注释不一致之处导致随后的工程建议不要将其用作主要基准(524),尽管它仍然是纵向比较的标准历史基线。 3. DAUB数据集(2019年): 本数据集由Hui等开发. (525 )包含与16944个目标相关的21个图像序列,30个轨迹和16177个帧. 每个目标对应图像中的标签位置,每个图像序列对应标签文件. 4. NUA-SIRST数据集(2021): NUAA-SIRST数据集28 28 28 https://github.com/YimianDai/sirst由戴等人(526人)提供高质量的图像和标签. 然而,图像数量为427(256作训练),无法很好地涵盖红外小目标探测的剧情变化. 此外,这些真正的红外数据都是手动标出许多不准确标出像素的. 5. NUDT-SIRST数据集(2021): Li等人(148人)开发了NUDT-SIRST数据集,包含多个目标类别,不同目标大小,不同的杂交背景,以及准确的说明. NUDT-SIRST数据集包含5个主要背景场景,包括城市,领域,亮点,海,和云. 每个图像都是从真实背景合成而成的,在各种SCR和丰富的外观下有各种目标(如点,点,并被扩展). 大部分背景图像由李等所采集(148),少数场型背景图像出自回等. (525) (中文(简体) ). 6. IRSTD-1K数据集(2022): IRSTD-1K数据集 (527 ) 收录了使用IR相机在现实世界情景中获取的1000个IR图像. 这些图像的尺寸为512×512 512\times 512像素. 目标被标为像素级. 各种各样的小目标,如无人机、人员、车辆和船只。 这些目标在不同地点被捕获,图像取自相当长的成像距离. 数据集在不同的大气条件下提供了自然、城市和海洋等各种环境。 其背景显示出明显的杂乱无章和噪音,增加了发现和识别目标的困难。 因此,该数据集适用于全面评估和方法基准。 7. SISD Dataset (2022):本数据集29 29 https://github.com/echo-sky/SISD. 由吴等提出 (528). 8. DenseSIRST数据集(2024年): DenseSIRST 数据集 30 30 https://github.com/GrokCV/DenseSIRST 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-02. 由萧等发布. (529)既解决了集群目标检测挑战,又解决了背景语义建模要求. (a) 密集目标设想:从稀少的目标配置过渡到反映现实世界部署条件的集群目标配置。 (b) 背景语义说明: 提供详细的每像素语义分解背景区域,分为天空类和非天空类,从而允许背景语义模型化. 9. SIRST-V2数据集 (2023年): SIRST-V2 31 31 https://github.com/YimianDai/open-sirst-v2 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-20. 由Dai等人提供。 (530 )包括从上千个红外序列中选择的515个真红外图像. 尽管如此,它的中度尺寸仍然制约了大容量模型的训练,而没有额外的增强,可变分辨率图像在假设固定输入大小(527个)的方法上引入了评价协议中的不一致之处. 这些问题可能导致无法进行强有力的SIRST检测(66)。 10. NCHU-SIRST数据集(2023年): NCHU-SIRST 32 32 32 https://github.com/PCwenyue/CAFF-Net-method-和-the-NCHU-SIRST-dataset由Shi等(531)发布,是使用红外相机捕获的一款真实世界红外小目标数据集,由6300张原始红外相机的590个人工选取的图像组成. 它包含273个训练框和317个测试框,包括了六个背景场景类别:建筑,无云天空,复杂的云层,连续云层,海,和树木. 数据集将飞机,鸟类,舰只作为目标类型,目标尺寸从3×3到9×9像素严格符合SPIE小目标定义,为红外小目标探测方法提供了可靠的真实世界评价参考. 11. MassMIND数据集(2023年) 本数据集33 33 33 https://github.com/uml-marine-robotics/MassMIND(532) 真实生命中长波红外线(LWIR)的图像由美国马萨诸塞州波士顿港内和周边2年中捕获的2916个不同的LWIR图像组成. 这些图像记录在一个繁忙的海洋地区,以及不同季节和不同时期不太繁忙的海水中,创造了季节性和时间性的多样性。 每个图像被分出像素级实例分出,并被标注在7个不同类别. 12. MIRSTD数据集(2024): https://github.com/avinres/MWIRSTD Kumar等人提出的(533)包括从14个视频序列中抽取的1053个真实的中华红外线(MWIR)图像,在使用冷却的MWIR图像器捕获的三种不同的小物体之间附加了说明。
它的有限规模仍然制约了大容量模型的训练而无需额外的增强,固定的分辨率为640×512 640\times 512像素,同时一致地将一般化限制在其他传感器配置和成像条件下. 这些问题可能导致无法在各种现实世界情景(533)下进行有力的SIRST检测。 13. TSIRMT数据集(2024年): TSIRMT 35 35 35 https://github.com/lifer/LMAFormer数据集由黄等(534)所引入,是一个多帧相继红外基准,旨在评价相位探测器,在同时进行的目标与站台运动产生目标签名与背景相接的强力耦合条件下. 14. DenseSIRST Dataset (2024):本数据集36 36 36 https://github.com/GrokCV/DenseSIRST是一个严格的附加说明的红外图像数据集,由密集集群的小物体所填充. 对于算法培训和评价来说,这是现实和具有挑战性的基准。 15. DMIST数据集(2024年): DMIST数据集 37 37 37 https://github.com/ULEC-nnLab/DMIST 由Chen等人(535人)在DAUB数据上提出的两个特殊的密集移动目标数据集(DMIST-60和DMIST-100). 它们都包含远超过每帧50个红外小目标. 16. DSISTD数据集(2024): DSISTD数据集 38 38 38 https://github.com/ULEC-nnLab/DMIST 由Chen等人(535年)提出,是一款将真正的无人机目标纳入模拟红外背景的无人机群红外小目标数据集. 17. SIRST-UAVB数据集(2024年): SIRST-UAVB 39 39 39 https://ieee-dataport.org/documents/sirst-uavb-single-frame-infrared- small-target-dataset-uav-and-birds数据集由杨等(536)所引入,由3000个真实的单帧中波红外图像组成,使用MWIR相机在固定分辨率为640×\tims 512像素和射击距离为100至800米. 由无人驾驶飞行器和鸟类组成的目标占数据的94.3%,是针对复杂背景提出的。 然而,数据集只侧重于两个目标类别:无人驾驶航空器和鸟类,相对于更广泛的SIRST基准,其多样性受到限制。 这些因素可能减少其在各种业务条件下对综合和有力的SIRST检测的适用性。

blocks.en: SIRST Dataset (2019): This dataset provided by Wang et al. ( 523 ) includes 10000 training images and 100 test images. Neverthless, many targets do not meet the definition of Society of Photo-Optical Instrumentation Engineers (SPIE) and present synthesized traces with illogical annotations. These problems may lead to the inapplicability toward SIRST detection ( 148 ) .
blocks.zh: SIRST 数据集(2019): 本数据集由王等提供. (523)包括1000个训练图像和100个测试图像. Neverthless,许多目标并不符合相片-相片仪表工程师学会(SPIE)的定义,并呈现有不逻辑说明的合成痕迹. 这些问题可能导致SIRST检测(148)不适用。

blocks.en: NUST-SIRST Dataset (2019): The NUST-SIRST 27 27 27 https://github.com/wanghuanphd/MDvsFA_cGAN dataset introduced by Wang et al. ( 523 ) in 2019 contains approximately 10,000 training images and 100 test images, representing the first publicly available benchmark for deep learning based ISTD. However, targets are synthetically generated via Gaussian sampling, causing labeled masks to be systematically inflated beyond true target boundaries and violating the SPIE small-target definition. These annotation inconsistencies have led subsequent works to advise against its use as a primary benchmark ( 524 ) , though it remains a standard historical baseline for longitudinal comparison.
blocks.zh: NUST-SIRST 数据集 (2019年): NUST-SIRST 27 27 https://github.com/wanghuanphd/MDvsFA_cGAN Wang et al. (523)在2019年推出的数据集包含约一万个训练图像和100个测试图像,代表了第一个公开的基于深层学习的ISTD基准. 然而,目标是通过高斯取样合成生成的,导致被标注的口罩被系统性地膨胀到超出真正的目标界限,并违反了SPIE小目标定义. 这些注释不一致之处导致随后的工程建议不要将其用作主要基准(524),尽管它仍然是纵向比较的标准历史基线。

blocks.en: DAUB Dataset (2019): This dataset developed by Hui et al. ( 525 ) contains 21 image sequences, 30 trajectories and 16177 frames in relation to 16944 targets. Each target corresponds to a label location in the image, and each image sequence corresponds to a label file.
blocks.zh: DAUB 数据集 (2019): 本数据集由Hui等开发. (525 )包含与16944个目标相关的21个图像序列,30个轨迹和16177个帧. 每个目标对应图像中的标签位置,每个图像序列对应标签文件.

blocks.en: NUAA-SIRST Dataset (2021): The NUAA-SIRST dataset 28 28 28 https://github.com/YimianDai/sirst is provided by Dai et al. ( 526 ) with high-quality images and labels. However, the number of images is 427 (256 for training), which cannot well cover dramatic scene changes in infrared small target detection. Moreover, these real infrared data are all manually labeled with many inaccurately labeled pixels.
blocks.zh: NUA-SIRST 数据集 (2021): NUAA-SIRST数据集28 28 28 https://github.com/YimianDai/sirst由戴等人(526人)提供高质量的图像和标签. 然而,图像数量为427(256作训练),无法很好地涵盖红外小目标探测的剧情变化. 此外,这些真正的红外数据都是手动标出许多不准确标出像素的.

blocks.en: NUDT-SIRST Dataset (2021): Li et al. ( 148 ) developed the NUDT -SIRST dataset with numerous categories of target, various target sizes, diverse clutter backgrounds, and accurate annotations. The NUDT-SIRST dataset contains 5 main background scenes including city, field, highlight, sea, and cloud. Each image is synthesized from real background with various targets (e.g., point, spot, and extended) under various SCR and rich poses. Most of the background images are collected by Li et al. ( 148 ) and a few field-type background images come from Hui et al. ( 525 ) .
blocks.zh: NUDT-SIRST 数据集 (2021): Li等人(148人)开发了NUDT-SIRST数据集,包含多个目标类别,不同目标大小,不同的杂交背景,以及准确的说明. NUDT-SIRST数据集包含5个主要背景场景,包括城市,领域,亮点,海,和云. 每个图像都是从真实背景合成而成的,在各种SCR和丰富的外观下有各种目标(如点,点,并被扩展). 大部分背景图像由李等所采集(148),少数场型背景图像出自回等. (525) (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: IRSTD-1K Dataset (2022): The IRSTD-1K dataset ( 527 ) contains a collection of 1,000 IR images obtained in real-world scenarios using an IR camera. These images have dimensions of 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels. The targets have been labeled at the pixel level. A variety of small targets are presents such as drones, persons, vehicles and boats. These targets have been captured at different locations, and the images are acquired from considerable imaging distances. The dataset offers a various environments such as natural, urban and maritime under different atmospheric conditions. The backgrounds show notable clutter and noise increasing the difficulty for the detection and recognition of targets. Thus, this dataset is suitable for comprehensive assessments and method benchmarking.
blocks.zh: IRSTD-1K 数据集 (2022): IRSTD-1K数据集 (527 ) 包含了使用IR相机在现实世界情景中获取的1000个IR图像的集合. 这些图像的尺寸为512×512 512\times 512像素. 目标被标为像素级. 各种各样的小目标,如无人机、人员、车辆和船只。 这些目标在不同地点被捕获,图像取自相当长的成像距离. 数据集在不同的大气条件下提供了自然、城市和海洋等各种环境。 其背景显示出明显的杂乱无章和噪音,增加了发现和识别目标的困难。 因此,该数据集适用于全面评估和方法基准。

blocks.en: SISD Dataset (2022): This dataset 29 29 29 https://github.com/echo-sky/SISD proposed by Wu et al. ( 528 ) .
blocks.zh: SISD 数据集 (2022): 本数据集 29 29 https://github.com/echo-sky/SISD 由吴等提出 (528).

blocks.en: DenseSIRST Dataset (2024): The DenseSIRST Dataset 30 30 30 https://github.com/GrokCV/DenseSIRST released by Xiao et al. ( 529 ) addresses both the clustered target detection challenge and the background semantic modeling requirement. (a) Dense Target Scenarios: Transitioning from sparse to clustered target configurations that reflect real-world deployment conditions. (b) Background Semantic Annotations: Offering detailed per-pixel semantic segmentation of background regions, classified into sky and non-sky classes, thereby allowing background semantic modeling.
blocks.zh: DenseSIRST 数据集(2024): DenseSIRST 数据集 30 30 https://github.com/GrokCV/DenseSIRST 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-02. 由萧等发布. (529)既解决了集群目标检测挑战,又解决了背景语义建模要求. (a) 密集目标设想:从稀少的目标配置过渡到反映现实世界部署条件的集群目标配置。 (b) 背景语义说明: 提供详细的每像素语义分解背景区域,分为天空类和非天空类,从而允许背景语义模型化.

blocks.en: Dense Target Scenarios: Transitioning from sparse to clustered target configurations that reflect real-world deployment conditions.
blocks.zh: 敏锐目标假想:从稀少的目标配置过渡到能反映现实世界部署条件的集群目标配置.

blocks.en: Background Semantic Annotations: Offering detailed per-pixel semantic segmentation of background regions, classified into sky and non-sky classes, thereby allowing background semantic modeling.
blocks.zh: 背景语义说明: 提供详细的每像素语义分解背景区域,分为天空类和非天空类,从而允许背景语义模型化.

blocks.en: SIRST-V2 Dataset (2023): The SIRST-V2 31 31 31 https://github.com/YimianDai/open-sirst-v2 provided by Dai et al. ( 530 ) includes 515 real infrared images selected from thousands of infrared sequences. Nevertheless, its moderate size still constrains the training of large capacity models without additional augmentation, and the variable resolution images introduce inconsistencies in evaluation protocols across methods that assume a fixed input size ( 527 ) . These problems may lead to the inapplicability toward robust SIRST detection ( 66 ) .
blocks.zh: SIRST-V2 Dataset (2023): The SIRST-V2 31 31 https://github.com/YimianDai/open-sirst-v2 (中文(简体) ). 由Dai等人提供。 (530 )包括从上千个红外序列中选择的515个真红外图像. 尽管如此,它的中度尺寸仍然制约了大容量模型的训练,而没有额外的增强,可变分辨率图像在假设固定输入大小(527个)的方法上引入了评价协议中的不一致之处. 这些问题可能导致无法进行强有力的SIRST检测(66)。

blocks.en: NCHU-SIRST Dataset (2023): The NCHU-SIRST 32 32 32 https://github.com/PCwenyue/CAFF-Net-method-and-the-NCHU-SIRST-dataset released by Shi et al. ( 531 ) is a real-world infrared small target dataset captured using an infrared camera, comprising 590 manually selected images from 6,300 raw infrared photographs. It contains 273 training frames and 317 test frames, covering six background scene categories: architecture, cloudless sky, complex clouds, continuous clouds, sea, and trees. The dataset includes aircraft, birds, and ships as target types, with target sizes ranging from 3×3 to 9×9 pixels in strict conformance with the SPIE small-target definition, providing a reliable real-world evaluation reference for infrared small target detection methods.
blocks.zh: NCHU-SIRST 数据集 (2023): NCHU-SIRST 32 32 32 https://github.com/PCwenyue/CAFF-Net-method-和-the-NCHU-SIRST-dataset由Shi等(531)发布,是使用红外相机捕获的一款真实世界红外小目标数据集,由6300张原始红外相机的590个人工选取的图像组成. 它包含273个训练框和317个测试框,包括了六个背景场景类别:建筑,无云天空,复杂的云层,连续云层,海,和树木. 数据集将飞机,鸟类,舰只作为目标类型,目标尺寸从3×3到9×9像素严格符合SPIE小目标定义,为红外小目标探测方法提供了可靠的真实世界评价参考.

blocks.en: MassMIND Dataset (2023) This dataset 33 33 33 https://github.com/uml-marine-robotics/MassMIND ( 532 ) of real-life Long Wave Infrared (LWIR) images consists of 2916 diverse LWIR images captured in and around the Boston Harbor in Massachusetts, USA over a span of 2 years. The images have been recorded in a busy marine area as well as in not so busy ocean waters during various seasons and times of the day creating seasonal and temporal diversity. Each image has been segmented with pixel level instance segmentation and labeled across 7 different classes.
blocks.zh: MassMIND Dataset (2023) 本数据集 33 33 33 https://github.com/uml-marine-robotics/MassMIND (532) 真实生活中的长波红外线(LWIR)图像由美国马萨诸塞州波士顿港及其周围所捕获的2916个不同的LWIR图像组成,历时2年. 这些图像记录在一个繁忙的海洋地区,以及不同季节和不同时期不太繁忙的海水中,创造了季节性和时间性的多样性。 每个图像被分出像素级实例分出,并被标注在7个不同类别.

blocks.en:
MWIRSTD Dataset (2024): The MWIRSTD 34 34 34 https://github.com/avinres/MWIRSTD proposed by Kumar et al. ( 533 ) includes 1053 real Mid-Wave Infrared (MWIR) images drawn from 14 video sequences, annotated across three distinct classes of small objects captured using cooled MWIR imagers.
Its limited scale still constrains the training of large capacity models without additional augmentation, and the fixed resolution of 640 × 512 640\times 512 pixels, while consistent, restricts generalization to other sensor configurations and imaging conditions. These problems may lead to inapplicability toward robust SIRST detection in diverse real-world scenarios ( 533 ) .
blocks.zh:
MWIRSTD 数据集 (2024): https://github.com/avinres/MWIRSTD Kumar等人(533人)提出,包括从14个视频序列中取出1 053个真实的中华红外线图像,在使用冷却的MWIR图像器捕获的三种不同的小物体中加注。
它的有限规模仍然制约了大容量模型的训练而无需额外的增强,固定的分辨率为640×512 640\times 512像素,同时一致地将一般化限制在其他传感器配置和成像条件下. 这些问题可能导致无法在各种现实世界情景(533)下进行有力的SIRST检测。

blocks.en: TSIRMT Dataset (2024): The TSIRMT 35 35 35 https://github.com/lifier/LMAFormer dataset, introduced by Huang et al. ( 534 ) , is a multi-frame sequential infrared benchmark designed to evaluate spatiotemporal detectors under conditions where simultaneous target and platform motion produce strong coupling between target signatures and background clutter.
blocks.zh: TSIRMT Dataset (2024):由黄等(534)推出的TSIRMT 35 35 https://github.com/lider/LMAFormer Dataset,是一个多帧相继红外基准,旨在评价相位探测器,在目标与平台同步运动产生目标签名与背景相接的强力耦合条件下.

blocks.en: DenseSIRST Dataset (2024): This dataset 36 36 36 https://github.com/GrokCV/DenseSIRST is a rigorous annotated infrared image dataset filled with densely clustered small objects. It is realistic and challenging benchmark for algorithm training and evaluation.
blocks.zh: DenseSIRST Dataset (2024):本数据集36 36 36 https://github.com/GrokCV/DenseSIRST是一个严格的附加说明的红外线图像数据集,由密集集群的小物体填充. 对于算法培训和评价来说,这是现实和具有挑战性的基准。

blocks.en: DMIST dataset (2024): The DMIST dataset 37 37 37 https://github.com/UESTC-nnLab/DMIST proposed by Chen et al. ( 535 ) group two special dense moving target datasets (DMIST-60 and DMIST-100) on DAUB data. They both contain far more than 50 infrared small targets per frame.
blocks.zh: DMIST 数据集 (2024) : DMIST数据集 37 37 37 https://github.com/ULEC-nnLab/DMIST 由Chen等人(535人)在DAUB数据上提出的两个特殊的密集移动目标数据集(DMIST-60和DMIST-100). 它们都包含远超过每帧50个红外小目标.

blocks.en: DSISTD Dataset (2024): The DSISTD dataset 38 38 38 https://github.com/UESTC-nnLab/DMIST proposed by Chen et al. ( 535 ) is a drone swarm infrared small target dataset that integrates real drone targets into simulated infrared backgrounds.
blocks.zh: DSISTD 数据集 (2024): DSISTD数据集 38 38 38 https://github.com/ULEC-nnLab/DMIST 由Chen等人(535年)提出,是一款将真正的无人机目标纳入模拟红外背景的无人机群红外小目标数据集.

blocks.en: SIRST-UAVB Dataset (2024): The SIRST-UAVB 39 39 39 https://ieee-dataport.org/documents/sirst-uavb-single-frame-infrared-small-target-dataset-uav-and-birds dataset, introduced by Yang et al. ( 536 ) , comprises 3,000 real single frame mid-wave infrared images captured using a cooled MWIR camera at a fixed resolution of 640 × \times 512 pixels and shooting distances ranging from 100 to 800 metres. Targets, consisting of UAVs and birds, account for 94.3% of the data and are presented against complex backgrounds. Nevertheless, the dataset exclusive focus on two target categories UAVs and birds, restricts its diversity relative to broader SIRST benchmarks. These factors may reduce its applicability toward comprehensive and robust SIRST detection across diverse operational conditions.
blocks.zh: SIRST-UAVB 数据集(2024): SIRST-UAVB 39 39 39 https://ieee-dataport.org/documents/sirst-uavb-single-frame-infrared- small-target-dataset-uav-and-birds数据集由杨等(536)所引入,由3000个真实的单帧中波红外图像组成,使用MWIR相机在固定分辨率为640×\tims 512像素和射击距离为100至800米. 由无人驾驶飞行器和鸟类组成的目标占数据的94.3%,是针对复杂背景提出的。 然而,数据集只侧重于两个目标类别:无人驾驶航空器和鸟类,相对于更广泛的SIRST基准,其多样性受到限制。 这些因素可能减少其在各种业务条件下对综合和有力的SIRST检测的适用性。

blocks.en: 8.1.3 Large-Scale Datasets
blocks.zh: 8.1.3 大型数据集

blocks.en: Large-scale datasets covers diverse scenarios in terms of environments, number of targets (sparse/dense) and number images/videos allowing training of data-based models.
blocks.zh: 大型数据集涵盖环境、目标数量(sparse/dense)和数字图像/视频等不同情况,以便培训基于数据的模型。

blocks.en:
1. IRDST Dataset (2023): The IRDST dataset ( 62 ) dataset contains 142,727 frames. It includes 40,650 real frames from 85 scenes and 102,077 simulated frames across 317 scenes. Each frame is annotated with three kinds of labels ranging from fine to coarse: pixel-level masks, bounding boxes, and central pixels. Pixel level masks are obtained by labeling each target pixel individually. Bounding box labels are obtained by placing the box two pixels away from the edges of the pixel-level masks. Central pixel labels are determined by identifying the centroid of the pixel-level mask. 2. WideIRSTD Dataset (2024): This dataset 40 40 40 https://github.com/XinyiYing/WideIRSTD-Dataset was delivered for the ICPR 2024 Resource-Limited Infrared Small Target Detection Challenge. It consists of seven public datasets: SIRST-V2, IRSTD-1K, IRDST, NUDT-SIRST, NUDT-SIRST-Sea, NUDT-MIRSDT, Anti-UAV, and a dataset developed by the team of National University of Defense Technology (NUDT) including simulated land-based and space-based data, and real manually annotated space-based data. The dataset contains images with various target shapes (e.g., point target, spotted target, extended target), wavelengths (e.g., near-infrared, shortwave infrared and thermal), image resolution (e.g., 256, 512, 1024, 3200, etc.), at varied imaging systems (e.g., land-based, aerial-based and space-based imaging systems). 3. IRSatVideo-LEO Dataset (2025): The IRSatVideo-LEO 41 41 41 https://github.com/XinyiYing/IRSatVideo released by Ying et al. ( 537 ) is a large-scale, semi-simulated dataset designed for multi-frame infrared small target (MIRST) detection in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite videos. It contains 200 image sequences, 91,021 frames, and 218,038 targets. The dataset includes synthesized satellite motion, target appearance, trajectory, and intensity, providing a standard toolbox for satellite video generation and a reliable evaluation platform. 4. IR-SatDense Dataset (2026): The IR-SatDense Dataset developed by Zhang et al. ( 522 ) reflects realistic on-orbit imaging conditions with complex backgrounds. It consists of a total of 2154 background images from public satellite infrared imagery sources. These images cover diverse Earth observation scenarios and represent various background characteristics. All background images were cropped
and preprocessed to a uniform resolution of 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels. According to background complexity, the dataset is categorized into four levels: easy, medium, complex, and extremely complex scenes. Compared to DMIST and DenseSIRST, IR-SatDense dataset provides higher target density and stronger realism. It is obtained with a Dense Single-Frame Target Dataset Generator (DSTDGen) based on real satellite infrared
backgrounds and is organized into multiple subsets corresponding to different density levels measured by the Average Minimum Inter-Target Distance (AMID).

blocks.en: IRDST Dataset (2023): The IRDST dataset ( 62 ) dataset contains 142,727 frames. It includes 40,650 real frames from 85 scenes and 102,077 simulated frames across 317 scenes. Each frame is annotated with three kinds of labels ranging from fine to coarse: pixel-level masks, bounding boxes, and central pixels. Pixel level masks are obtained by labeling each target pixel individually. Bounding box labels are obtained by placing the box two pixels away from the edges of the pixel-level masks. Central pixel labels are determined by identifying the centroid of the pixel-level mask.

The dataset contains images with various target shapes (e.g., point target, spotted target, extended target), wavelengths (e.g., near-infrared, shortwave infrared and thermal), image resolution (e.g., 256, 512, 1024, 3200, etc.), at varied imaging systems (e.g., land-based, aerial-based and space-based imaging systems).

blocks.en: The available datasets dedicated to air environments can be listed as follows: 1. BSIRST-v1 Dataset (2024): This dataset developed by Zhang et al. ( 538 ) is dedicated for testing algorithms in monitoring of birds in plateau lakes and wetlands. 2. BSIRST-v2 Dataset (2024): The BSIRST-v2 Dataset 42 42 42 https://github.com/miliner/FATCNet developed by Yang et al. ( 539 ) consists of 1000 authentic images with various target shapes, sizes, and cluttered backgrounds. The dataset includes rigorous pixel-level annotations. 3. MIST Dataset (2026): The MIST 43 43 43 https://github.com/GR-ray/MIST dataset developed by Gao et al. ( 540 ) contains airborne infrared detection scenarios. The dataset is obtained with a synthetic data engine that models variations in pose, size, and intensity of moving targets while seamlessly blending them into real backgrounds for physical, geometric, and visual realism. Targets present low signal-to-clutter ratios and complex motion.

blocks.en: The available datasets dedicated to maritime environements can be listed as follows: 1. The image size is 500 × 500 500\times 500 . ISSD consists of images taken by the Landsat8 satellite. There are 373 inshore scenes containing 924 instances and 911 offshore scenes containing 2137 instances. 2. NUDT-SIRST-Sea Dataset (2023): The NUDT-SIRST-sea Dataset 45 45 45 https://github.com/TianhaoWu16/Multi-level-TransUNet-for-Space-based-Infrared-Tiny-ship-Detection developed by Wu et al. ( 123 ) consists of images with multiple targets. It lacks wave clutter background images, with over 80 % 80\% featuring simple backgrounds or land near port ( 542 ) . 3. IRSDSS Dataset (2024): This dataset 46 46 46 https://github.com/greekinRoma/SMPISD-MTPNet proposed by Hu et al. ( 131 ) presents maritimes scenarios for infrared ship and contains 1491 images. It contains only about 10 % 10\% of wave clutter and complex cloud formation backgrounds ( 542 ) . 4. Maritime-SIRST Dataset (2024) This dataset 47 47 47 https://github.com/peerless66/Maritime-SIRST/blob/main/README.md developed by Guo et al. ( 542 ) exploits publicly available images from the near-infrared band of the Landsat-8 remote sensing satellite. Within the Landsat-8 remote sensing images, IR band images have been selected from various regions worldwide, including ports, canals, and open seas across Asia, Africa, and North America. The selected images span from 2013 to 2021, ensuring temporal diversity. Moreover, images with different months and varying cloud cover percentages have been chosen. Maritime-SIRST dataset comprises 1131 images with 2647 targets. Each image sized is of 256 × 256 256\times 256 pixels.

blocks.en: 8.2 Visual and Text Modalities Datasets
blocks.zh: 8.2 视觉和文字模式数据集

blocks.en:
Since 2025, visual and text modalities datasets have emerged according to the need of evaluation of large language models and vision-language models applied for infrared small target detection. These datasets can be listed as follows: 1. MIRSTD Dataset (2025): The MIRSTD dataset developed by Zhang et al. ( 543 ) consists of 427 and 1,000 real infrared images with one or more small targets, and 1,327 synthetic infrared images with small targets. All images are resized to 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 . The images are divided into three disjoint subsets: 50 % 50\% for training, 30 % 30\% for validation, and 20 % 20\% for testing. 2. IR-TXPair Dataset (2025): The IR-TXPair dataset developed by Zhang et al. ( 544 ) is obtained from the IRSTD-1k and NUAA-SIRST datasets and contains 1427 images. It contains various scenes like urban environments, landscapes with mountains, marine environments, and
desert environments, with backgrounds such as buildings, roads, vegetation, sea waves, and sandstorms. In addition, the dataset offers diverses infrared small targets (drones, vehicles, and ships). The dataset is provide with text descriptions for rich multimodal information. For each dataset, 50 % 50\% of the images are used as the training set and 30 % 30\% are employed for the validation set, and 20 % 20\% for the test set. 3. FZDT Dataset (2025): The FZDT dataset introduced by Huang et al. ( 545 ) consists of 2,755 infrared images of different scenarios with fuzzy semantic textual annotations. More specifically, iy consists of the three public image datasets NUAA-SIRST, NUDT-SIRST, IRSTD-1k, and corresponding fuzzy semantic text prompts. Each dataset is divided into training set, validation set and test set in the ratio of 6:2:2. 4. LangIR Dataset (2026): The LangIR dataset developed by Chib and Singh ( 546 ) contains two datasets, namely NUAA-SIRST and IRSTD-1k. The NUAA-SIRST subset of the LangIR dataset contains 427 text descriptions and the IRSTD-1k subset contains 1,001 text descriptions. These descriptions include textual information that localizes and describes the small target. In both the NUAA-SIRST and IRSTD-1k subsets, the most frequently occurring positional word is left, indicating that most small targets are located in the left most position of the image, followed by upper and then center.
blocks.zh:
自2025年以来,视觉和文字模式数据集根据对应用于红外小目标探测的大型语言模型和视觉语言模型进行评估的需要而出现. 这些数据集可以列出如下: 1. MIRSTD数据集(2025): 由张等开发的MIRSTD数据集. (543 )由427和1000个真红外图像组成,并有一个或一个以上的小目标,以及1,327个合成红外图像并有小目标. 所有图像的大小都调整为1024×1024 1024\times 1024. 图像被分为三个脱节子集:50%50QQ用于训练,30%30QQ用于验证,20%20QQ用于测试. 2. IR-TXPair数据集(2025): 由张等所开发的IR-TXPair数据集(544)取自IRSTD-1k和NUA-SIRST数据集并包含1427个图像. 它包含各种场景,如城市环境,有山地的地貌,海洋环境等.
沙漠环境,有建筑,道路,植被,海浪,沙暴等背景. 此外,数据集还提供各种红外小目标(德龙、车辆和船只)。 数据集载有丰富的多式联运信息的文字说明。 每个数据集,50%的相片被作为培训集使用,30%的相片用于验证集,20%的相片用于测试集。 3. FZDT数据集(2025): 由黄等介绍的FZDT数据集. (545 )由不同情景的2,755个红外图像组成,并带有模糊的语义文字说明. 更具体地说,iy包括了三个公共图像数据集NUA-SIRST,NUDT-SIRST,IRSTD-1k,以及相应的模糊语义文本提示. 每个数据集分为培训集,验证集和测试集,比例为6:2:2. 4. 兰吉尔数据集(2026): 由Chib和Singh所开发的LangIR数据集(546)包含两个数据集,即NUA-SIRST和IRSTD-1k. LangIR数据集的NUAA-SIRST子集包含427个文本描述,IRSTD-1k子集包含1,001个文本描述. 这些描述包括了本地化的文字信息并描述了小的目标. 在NUA-SIRST和IRSTD-1k子集中,最常出现的位置单词是左出,表示大多数小目标位于图像最左出的位置上,然后是上出和中出.

blocks.en: MIRSTD Dataset (2025): The MIRSTD dataset developed by Zhang et al. ( 543 ) consists of 427 and 1,000 real infrared images with one or more small targets, and 1,327 synthetic infrared images with small targets. All images are resized to 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 . The images are divided into three disjoint subsets: 50 % 50\% for training, 30 % 30\% for validation, and 20 % 20\% for testing.
blocks.zh: MIRSTD 数据集(2025): 由张等开发的MIRSTD数据集. (543 )由427和1000个真红外图像组成,并有一个或一个以上的小目标,以及1,327个合成红外图像并有小目标. 所有图像的大小都调整为1024×1024 1024\times 1024. 图像被分为三个脱节子集:50%50QQ用于训练,30%30QQ用于验证,20%20QQ用于测试.

blocks.en:
IR-TXPair Dataset (2025): The IR-TXPair dataset developed by Zhang et al. ( 544 ) is obtained from the IRSTD-1k and NUAA-SIRST datasets and contains 1427 images. It contains various scenes like urban environments, landscapes with mountains, marine environments, and
desert environments, with backgrounds such as buildings, roads, vegetation, sea waves, and sandstorms. In addition, the dataset offers diverses infrared small targets (drones, vehicles, and ships). The dataset is provide with text descriptions for rich multimodal information. For each dataset, 50 % 50\% of the images are used as the training set and 30 % 30\% are employed for the validation set, and 20 % 20\% for the test set.

blocks.en: FZDT Dataset (2025): The FZDT dataset introduced by Huang et al. ( 545 ) consists of 2,755 infrared images of different scenarios with fuzzy semantic textual annotations. More specifically, iy consists of the three public image datasets NUAA-SIRST, NUDT-SIRST, IRSTD-1k, and corresponding fuzzy semantic text prompts. Each dataset is divided into training set, validation set and test set in the ratio of 6:2:2.

blocks.en: LangIR Dataset (2026): The LangIR dataset developed by Chib and Singh ( 546 ) contains two datasets, namely NUAA-SIRST and IRSTD-1k. The NUAA-SIRST subset of the LangIR dataset contains 427 text descriptions and the IRSTD-1k subset contains 1,001 text descriptions. These descriptions include textual information that localizes and describes the small target. In both the NUAA-SIRST and IRSTD-1k subsets, the most frequently occurring positional word is left, indicating that most small targets are located in the left most position of the image, followed by upper and then center.

blocks.en: 9 Performance Evaluation
blocks.zh: 9 考绩

blocks.en: 9.1 Conventional Protocols
blocks.zh: 9.1 常规议定书

blocks.en: Conventional evaluation protocols have been established over several decades, originally within signal processing and subsequently adapted to the deep learning paradigm. They are characterized by their reliance on either pixel-level or block-level (target-level) computational primitives, reflecting the two dominant formulations of the detection problem: as a per-pixel binary segmentation task or as a target-instance localisation task, respectively.
blocks.zh: 常规评价协议已经建立几十年了,最初是在信号处理中,后来又适应了深层的学习范式. 它们具有依赖像素级或块级(目标级)计算原始的特征,反映了检测问题的两种主要配体:分别作为每像素二进制分出任务或作为靶向局部化任务.

blocks.en: 9.1.1 Pixel-Level Metrics
blocks.zh: 9.1.1 像素级计量仪

blocks.en:
Pixel-level metrics treat IRSTD as a dense binary segmentation problem, evaluating the agreement between the predicted mask and the ground truth at individual pixel resolution.Each metric derives from the four entries of the binary confusion matrix: TP \mathrm{TP} , FP \mathrm{FP} , TN \mathrm{TN} ,
and FN \mathrm{FN} ( 66 ) . From these quantities, a set of metrics can be derived as follows.
blocks.zh:
像素级的度量衡将IRSTD视为密集的二进制分解问题,在单个像素分辨率上评价了所预测的口罩和地真之间的一致. 每个分量来自二进制混淆矩阵的四个条目:TP\mathrm{TP},FP\mathrm{FP},TN\mathrm{TN},
和 FN\mathrm{FN} (66) (英语). 从这些数量中,可以得出一套度量衡如下.

blocks.en:
1. Intersection over Union( IoU \mathrm{IoU} ): The common pixel-level metric is the Intersection over Union (IoU). Also known as the Jaccard index, IoU \mathrm{IoU} measures the pixel wise overlap between the predicted and ground truth masks: IoU = TP TP + FP + FN . \mathrm{IoU}=\frac{\mathrm{TP}}{\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FP}+\mathrm{FN}}. (16) It is the primary segmentation metric across IRSTD
benchmarks. Its main limitation is a size
aggregation bias. Since statistics are pooled globally before computing the ratio, large or numerous targets dominate the score while small, sparse targets contribute
negligibly ( 66 ) . 2. Normalised IoU ( nIoU \mathrm{nIoU} ): To correct the aggregation bias of Equation ( 16 ),
the normalised IoU computes the ratio per sample before
averaging across the dataset: nIoU = 1 N ​ ∑ n = 1 N TP n TP n + FP n + FN n . \mathrm{nIoU}=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}\frac{\mathrm{TP}_{n}}{\mathrm{TP}_{n}+\mathrm{FP}_{n}+\mathrm{FN}_{n}}. (17) This formulation ensures equal contribution from all samples regardless of target size. 3. F1-Score / Dice ( F1 \mathrm{F1} ): The pixel-level F1-score is the harmonic mean of pixel-level precision and recall: F1 = 2 ​ TP 2 ​ TP + FP + FN . \mathrm{F1}=\frac{2\,\mathrm{TP}}{2\,\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FP}+\mathrm{FN}}. (18) While both IoU \mathrm{IoU} and F1 \mathrm{F1} mitigate foreground imbalance through relative area proportions, they remain limited to global pixel-wise analysis and cannot capture target level spatial localisation ( 66 ; 305 ) . 4. Pixel Accuracy (PA): PA = TP + TN N total . \mathrm{PA}=\frac{\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{TN}}{N_{\mathrm{total}}}. (19) PA is rarely used as a primary metric in IRSTD. Since target pixels account for less than 0.1 % 0.1\% of the image, a null predictor achieves PA > 99.9 % \mathrm{PA}>99.9\% , rendering
the metric uninformative under such extreme class
imbalance. 5. Mean Pixel Accuracy (MPA): MPA = 1 C ​ ∑ c = 1 C TP c TP c + FN c . \mathrm{MPA}=\frac{1}{C}\sum_{c=1}^{C}\frac{\mathrm{TP}_{c}}{\mathrm{TP}_{c}+\mathrm{FN}_{c}}. (20) By computing per-class recall and averaging across the target and background classes, MPA directly corrects the imbalance situation of PA ( 52 ) . 6. Pixel-level Precision and Recall: Precision and recall at the pixel level are defined as: Prec = TP TP + FP , \mathrm{Prec}=\frac{\mathrm{TP}}{\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FP}}, (21) Rec = TP TP + FN . \mathrm{Rec}=\frac{\mathrm{TP}}{\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FN}}. (22) Both are reported in the work of Ni et al. ( 548 ) . Notably, Rec \mathrm{Rec} is equivalent to the target level probability of detection P d P_{d} when evaluated at the pixel level. 7. PSNR and SSIM: Two additional m of background estimation and image reconstruction quality. The Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) quantifies the reconstruction fidelity of the background model in decibels: PSNR = 10 ​ log 10 ⁡ ( MAX 2 MSE ) [ dB ] , \mathrm{PSNR}=10\log_{10}\!\left(\frac{\mathrm{MAX}^{2}}{\mathrm{MSE}}\right)\quad[\mathrm{dB}], (23) where MAX \mathrm{MAX} is the maximum possible pixel intensity
and MSE \mathrm{MSE} is the mean squared error between the
estimated and reference background. Complementarily, the
Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) evaluates
perceptual fidelity by jointly assessing luminance, contrast,
and structural consistency between two images: SSIM ⁡ ( x , y ) = l ⁡ ( x , y ) ⋅ c ⁡ ( x , y ) ⋅ s ⁡ ( x , y ) . \mathrm{SSIM}(x,y)=l(x,y)\cdot c(x,y)\cdot s(x,y). (24) Both PSNR and SSIM are restricted to evaluating the fidelity of background suppression models and carry no direct interpretation as detection performance
measures.

blocks.en: 9.1.2 Target-Level Metrics
blocks.zh: 9.1.2 指标级计量

blocks.en:
The common target-level metrics are the Probability of detection (Pd) and the False-alarm rate (Fa). A set of block-level metrics can be derived as follows: 1. Probability of Detection ( P d P_{d} ): The most fundamental block-level metric is the probability of detection, which measures the fraction of ground truth targets successfully identified: P d = TP TP + FN . P_{d}=\frac{\mathrm{TP}}{\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FN}}. (25) P d P_{d} measures detection completeness but ignores false positives, potentially overestimating performance in noisy environments ( 66 ) . It is the primary operational metric across the entire IRSTD literature ( 52 ; 527 ; 148 ; 305 ) . 2. False Alarm Rate ( F a F_{a} ): Complementary to P d P_{d} , the false alarm rate quantifies
the spatial extent of false positive detections by
normalising their total area to the full image size: F a = | area ( FP | N pixels [ × 10 − 6 per pixel ] . F_{a}=\frac{|\mathrm{area}(\mathrm{FP}|}{N_{\mathrm{pixels}}}\quad[\times 10^{-6}\ \mathrm{per\ pixel}]. (26) While F a F_{a} captures the spatial footprint of false alarms, it may undercount small false positive instances while over penalising large ones. Additionally, F a F_{a} disregards
pixel-level errors within correctly matched
targets ( 52 ; 527 ; 148 ; 305 ) . 3. False Alarm Rate per Frame (FAPF): Rather than measuring the spatial area of false alarms,
FAPF counts the mean number of false detection events
per frame: FAPF = N FP N frames . \mathrm{FAPF}=\frac{N_{\mathrm{FP}}}{N_{\mathrm{frames}}}. (27) This count-based variant is particularly informative in sequential detection scenarios where tracker workload depends on the number of spurious instances rather than their area ( 52 ) . 4. Target-level Precision and F1: Analogously to their pixel-level counterparts, precision
and F1 can be formulated at the target instance level: P tgt = TP TP + FP , P_{\mathrm{tgt}}=\frac{\mathrm{TP}}{\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FP}}, (28) F1 = 2 ​ P tgt ⋅ P d P tgt + P d . \mathrm{F1}=\frac{2\,P_{\mathrm{tgt}}\cdot P_{d}}{P_{\mathrm{tgt}}+P_{d}}. (29) Notably, the recall in this context corresponds directly to the target-level P d P_{d} defined in
Equation ( 25 ) ( 66 ; 548 ) . 5. ROC Curve and AUC: The Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve plots P d P_{d} as a function of F a F_{a} across all detection thresholds, providing a threshold-independent view of the detection trade-off. The Area Under the Curve (AUC)
summarizes this trade-off in a single scalar: AUC = ∫ P d ​ ( t ) ​ d ​ [ F a ​ ( t ) ] . \mathrm{AUC}=\int P_{d}(t)\,\mathrm{d}[F_{a}(t)]. (30) The larger the AUC, the better the overall detection
performance. The ROC curve is the standard evaluation
tool for all filter-based and model-driven IRSTD
methods ( 52 ) . 6. Signal-to-Clutter Ratio (SCR): Before any processing, the inherent detectability of a target in a given scene is characterised by the
Signal-to-Clutter Ratio (SCR): SCR = μ t − μ bg σ bg , \mathrm{SCR}=\frac{\mu_{t}-\mu_{\mathrm{bg}}}{\sigma_{\mathrm{bg}}}, (31) where μ t \mu_{t} is the mean intensity of the target region
and μ bg \mu_{\mathrm{bg}} , σ bg \sigma_{\mathrm{bg}} are the
local background mean and standard deviation computed in
a surrounding window ( 63 ; 445 ; 188 ) . SCR is widely used for dataset difficulty characterisation and serves as
the baseline reference quantity against which the
enhancement capability of an algorithm is measured,
as detailed in the following metric. 7. Signal-to-Clutter Ratio Gain (SCRG): Building on the SCR definition in Equation ( 31 ),
the SCRG measures the degree to which an algorithm
amplifies the target signal relative to background
clutter: SCRG = SCR out SCR in . \mathrm{SCRG}=\frac{\mathrm{SCR}_{\mathrm{out}}}{\mathrm{SCR}_{\mathrm{in}}}. (32) Larger values indicate stronger target enhancement.
It is important to note, that a high SCRG
does not guarantee successful detection; a proper
thresholding strategy must follow ( 63 ) . 8. Background Suppression Factor (BSF): Complementary to SCRG, the BSF measures how effectively
the algorithm flattens background clutter texture,
independently of target enhancement: BSF = σ bg , in σ bg , out . \mathrm{BSF}=\frac{\sigma_{\mathrm{bg,in}}}{\sigma_{\mathrm{bg,out}}}. (33) SCRG and BSF are always reported jointly, as together
they distinguish between two complementary aspects of
background suppression: target contrast enhancement
and clutter flattening ( 63 ; 52 ; 549 ; 550 ) . 9. Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) A global variant of SCR, the Signal-to-Noise Ratio
replaces the local background window with image-wide
noise statistics: SNR = μ t − μ global σ global . \mathrm{SNR}=\frac{\mu_{t}-\mu_{\mathrm{global}}}{\sigma_{\mathrm{global}}}. (34) Although less precise than SCR in characterising
structured clutter, SNR is used in early IRSTD
literature and hardware-level system characterisation ( 52 ; 551 ) . 10. Local Contrast Measure (LCM): Motivated by the human visual system, the Local
Contrast Measure quantifies target saliency relative
to its immediate spatial neighborhood: LCM ⁡ ( x , y ) = I target μ neighborhood . \mathrm{LCM}(x,y)=\frac{I_{\mathrm{target}}}{\mu_{\mathrm{neighborhood}}}. (35) Multiple variants exist in the literature, including
the nonlinear NLCM and the revised RLCM, each
modifying the neighborhood weighting ( 52 ; 552 ; 291 ) . 11. Centroid Localisation Error (CLE): Rather than measuring overlap or signal quality, the
CLE directly quantifies the spatial accuracy of a
detection by computing the Euclidean distance between
the predicted and ground-truth target centroids: CLE = ( x ^ − x ) 2 + ( y ^ − y ) 2 [ pixels ] . \mathrm{CLE}=\sqrt{(\hat{x}-x)^{2}+(\hat{y}-y)^{2}}\quad[\mathrm{pixels}]. (36) Mean CLE is typically reported per sequence in
tracking evaluations, where sub-pixel
accuracy is the target ( 52 ; 548 ; 383 ) . 12. Bounding-Box IoU Variants: For anchor based detection architectures, several
extensions of the standard IoU have been adapted to
the IRSTD setting to improve bounding box regression
for small targets. The Generalised IoU (GIoU)
penalises non-overlapping boxes through an enclosing
box term. The Distance IoU
(DIoU) additionally penalises the centroid offset
between predicted and ground-truth boxes. The Complete
IoU (CIoU) further incorporates aspect ratio
consistency ( 52 ) . Finally, the Normalised
Gaussian Wasserstein Distance (NWD) replaces the
geometric overlap entirely by modeling each target
as a Gaussian distribution and measuring the
Wasserstein distance between them, which is more
suitable for targets with near-zero
overlap: NWD ⁡ ( 𝒩 p , 𝒩 g ) = exp ⁡ ( − W 2 2 ​ ( 𝒩 p , 𝒩 g ) C ) , \mathrm{NWD}(\mathcal{N}_{p},\mathcal{N}_{g})=\exp\!\left(-\frac{\sqrt{W_{2}^{2}(\mathcal{N}_{p},\mathcal{N}_{g})}}{C}\right), (37) where W 2 W_{2} is the Wasserstein-2 distance between
the two Gaussian representations and C C is a
normalisation constant. 13. Mean Average Precision (mAP): Adopted from the general object detection literature,
mAP summarises the area under the precision–recall
curve across IoU thresholds: mAP = 1 | 𝒯 | ​ ∑ τ ∈ 𝒯 ∫ 0 1 P ⁡ ( R , τ ) ​ 𝑑 R , \mathrm{mAP}=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{T}|}\sum_{\tau\in\mathcal{T}}\int_{0}^{1}P(R,\tau)\,\mathrm{d}R, (38) where 𝒯 \mathcal{T} is the set of IoU thresholds and P ⁡ ( R , τ ) P(R,\tau) is the precision at recall R R under
threshold τ \tau . mAP is used in anchor-based
YOLO-family and DETR-family IRSTD detectors and is
not applicable to segmentation-only
pipelines ( 52 ) .

blocks.en: 9.1.3 Complexity Metrics
blocks.zh: 9.1.3 复杂性计量

blocks.en: Floating-point operations (FLOPs) and parameters (Params) are metrics employed to assess the complexity of deep neural networks models. These metrics allows to understand the computational demands and scale of a model, thereby aiding in model selection, optimization, and deployment.
blocks.zh: 浮点操作(FLOPs)和参数(Params)是用来评估深神经网络模型复杂性的度量. 这些衡量标准能够理解模型的计算需要和规模,从而协助模型的选择、优化和部署。

blocks.en: 1. FLOPs indicates the number of floating-point operations a model employs per second. The magnitude of FLOPs reflects the complexity of a model. More the model has a higher number of FLOPs the more computationally complex the model is. 2. Params indicates the number of parameters the model needs to learn. The number of Params reflects the size of a model, and smaller models involve lower computational burdens.

blocks.en: 9.2 Common Ranking Protocols
blocks.zh: 9.2 共同排序议定书

blocks.en: The linear weighted summation of IoU and Pd is used for ranking in the ICPR 2024 Resource-Limited Infrared Small Target Detection Challenge. Even if this ranking protocol appears efficient to obtain one best method, it is proved that this kind of ranking is not suitable and does not reflect the real respective performance ( 553 ; 554 ; 555 ; 556 ) . Indeed, the performance of a method depend of its environmental application. In addition, a method does not need to be the best in each challenge to be suitable for one kind of application. Thus, alternative ranking protocols need to be designed to provide a fair recommendation to the engineers.
blocks.zh: IoU和Pd的线性加权总和被用于ICPR 2024资源限制红外小目标探测挑战赛的排名. 即使这种排名协议看起来很有效,以获得一种最佳方法,但事实证明这种排名是不合适的,并不反映各自的实际表现(553;554;555;556). 事实上,某种方法的性能取决于其环境应用。 此外,在每项挑战中,一种方法不一定是最适合一种应用的。 因此,需要设计替代排序协议,向工程师提供公平的建议。

blocks.en: 9.3 Disruptive Protocols
blocks.zh: 9.3 破坏性议定书

blocks.en: The conventional evaluation protocols present limitations. First, they rely on fragmented pixel-level and target-level specific metrics, which fails to provide a comprehensive view of model capabilities. Second, an excessive emphasis on overall performance scores do not allows error analysis, which is crucial to identify failure modes and to improved real-world system performance. Third, the field predominantly adopts dataset-specific training-testing paradigms, hindering the understanding of model robustness and generalization across diverse infrared scenarios. One way to change the protocol evaluation is to change the metrics. An other way is to change the ranking protocol itself.
blocks.zh: 传统的评价协议存在局限性。 首先,它们依靠零散的像素级和目标级的具体度量衡,无法提供模型能力的全景. 第二,过分强调总体性能分数不能允许错误分析,而错误分析对于识别失败模式和改善现实世界系统性能至关重要. 第三,实地主要采用针对数据集的培训测试范式,阻碍了对模型稳健性的理解和对不同红外情景的概括。 改变协议评价的方法之一是改变衡量标准。 另一种方法是改变排名协议本身.

blocks.en: 10 Prospective Research
blocks.zh: 10 展望研究

blocks.en: We first provide an analysis of the current methods and evaluation protocols. Second, we review the current solved and unsolved challenges. Third, we provide theoretical perspectives for each category of methods.
blocks.zh: 我们首先分析目前的方法和评价规程。 第二,我们回顾目前已经解决和尚未解决的挑战。 第三,我们为每一类方法提供理论观点。

blocks.en: 10.1 Analysis of Current Methods and Evaluation Protocols
blocks.zh: 10.1 对现行方法和评价议定书的分析

blocks.en:
Even if many progress have been made, there are still improvements to investigate according to the analysis of strengths and weaknesses of the current methods. Regarding the current methods, the following remarks can be made as described as follows: 1. Conventional Unsupervised Methods (Model-based): Filtering based approaches efficiently separate targets from the background
using prior knowledge but require manual tuning in complex scenes, limiting adaptability and potentially causing target loss when background noise varies. Visual-saliency-based methods improve the target contrast but struggle with complex backgrounds containing similar distractors, introducing noise that affects precise detection. All these methods are researcher-based methods using crisp, statistical or fuzzy concepts designed in the context of infrared small target detection. 2. Low-rank and Sparse Decomposition Unsupervised Models (Model-based): Sparse and low-rank representation methods model targets as sparse components and backgrounds as low-rank structures, leveraging image properties for robust detection. They integrate spatial–temporal information but are computationally intensive, posing challenges for high dimensional data. Each method has strengths and limitations, influencing its effectiveness in different environments. However, all the variants of the IPI method are researcher-based improvements that choose or design dedicated norms and miminization problems to handle specific challenges. 3. Evaluation Protocols: About the conventional evaluation protocols, several weaknesses appear to have a fair evaluation and comparison for ranking. First, they rely on fragmented pixel- and target-level specific metrics and thus they fail to provide a comprehensive view of model capabilities. Second, the emphasis on overall performance scores do not allow a precise error analysis required to identify failure modes and improve real-world system performance. Third, the employed dataset are dataset-specific training-testing paradigm and to no allow the understanding of model robustness and generalization across diverse infrared scenarios.
blocks.zh:
即使取得了许多进展,但根据对目前方法的优缺点的分析,调查仍有所改进。 关于现行方法,可作如下说明: 1. 常规无监督方法(模式): 高效地将目标与背景区分开来
使用先前的知识,但在复杂的场景中需要手动调和,限制适应性,并在背景噪音不同时可能造成目标损失. 以视觉-显著性为基础的方法改进了目标对比度,但与包含类似分心器的复杂背景相搏,引入了会影响精确检测的噪声. 所有这些方法都是利用在红外小目标探测中设计的简洁、统计或模糊概念的以研究人员为基础的方法。 2. 低等和Sparse分解无监督模型(模型): Sparse和低等代表方法模型的目标作为稀有组件和背景作为低等结构,利用图像属性来进行强力检测. 它们综合了时空信息,但在计算上是密集的,对高维度数据构成挑战。 每一种方法都有优点和局限性,影响其在不同环境中的有效性. 然而,IPI方法的所有变体都是基于研究人员的改进,这些改进选择或设计了专用规范并忽略了处理具体挑战的问题. 3. 评价议定书: 关于传统的评价协议,一些弱点似乎有公平的评价和排名比较。 首先,它们依靠分散的像素和目标级的具体度量衡,因此无法提供模型能力的全景. 其次,由于强调总体性能分数,因此无法进行准确的错误分析,以识别故障模式并改进现实世界的系统性能。 第三,使用的数据集是针对数据集的培训测试范式,不允许理解模型的稳健性和不同红外情景的通俗性。

blocks.en:
Conventional Unsupervised Methods (Model-based): Filtering based approaches efficiently separate targets from the background
using prior knowledge but require manual tuning in complex scenes, limiting adaptability and potentially causing target loss when background noise varies. Visual-saliency-based methods improve the target contrast but struggle with complex backgrounds containing similar distractors, introducing noise that affects precise detection. All these methods are researcher-based methods using crisp, statistical or fuzzy concepts designed in the context of infrared small target detection.

blocks.en: Low-rank and Sparse Decomposition Unsupervised Models (Model-based): Sparse and low-rank representation methods model targets as sparse components and backgrounds as low-rank structures, leveraging image properties for robust detection. They integrate spatial–temporal information but are computationally intensive, posing challenges for high dimensional data. Each method has strengths and limitations, influencing its effectiveness in different environments. However, all the variants of the IPI method are researcher-based improvements that choose or design dedicated norms and miminization problems to handle specific challenges.

blocks.en: Evaluation Protocols: About the conventional evaluation protocols, several weaknesses appear to have a fair evaluation and comparison for ranking. First, they rely on fragmented pixel- and target-level specific metrics and thus they fail to provide a comprehensive view of model capabilities. Second, the emphasis on overall performance scores do not allow a precise error analysis required to identify failure modes and improve real-world system performance. Third, the employed dataset are dataset-specific training-testing paradigm and to no allow the understanding of model robustness and generalization across diverse infrared scenarios.

blocks.en: 10.2 Solved and Unsolved Challenges
blocks.zh: 10.2 已解决和未解决的挑战

blocks.en:
Challenges can be investigated either according to single-frame/multi-frame detection and to sparse/dense targets detection as follows: 1. Challenges in Single-frame/Multi-frame Detection: Even if many progress have been made, there are still unsolved challenges both in single-frame and multi-frame detection. 2. Challenges in Sparse/Dense Target Detection: In 2026, existing methods present the following limitations as developed by Zhang et al ( 522 ) : (a) Local spatial saliency limitation: Most existing approaches employed local spatial saliency, improving targets by exploiting intensity contrast between a target and its surrounding background. When multiple adjacent targets are densely distributed in the same region, these methods struggle to separate subtle energy differences between targets and background, resulting in target adhesion, blurred responses, and incomplete
separation in the detection maps. (b) Density-aware semantic guidance deficiency: Even if deep neural networks models employ powerful backbones and transformer-based heads, the backbone feature extraction process is bottom-up and does not explicitly encode target density. Features at different spatial locations are processed in a homogeneous manner, regardless of whether they
belong to dense target clusters or mostly background. (c) Dense-target structural limitation: Existing sparse-target models do not explicitly model the structural hierarchy of densely distributed targets in the spatial domain. In multi target scenes with high spatial density, they generate ambiguous spatial structures and
mutual feature interference, which conducts to degraded localization accuracy and unstable detection performance. These three limitations show the current unsolved challenges in the case of dense scenes.
blocks.zh:
可根据单帧/多帧检测和稀有/密集目标检测,对挑战进行调查如下: 1. 单一框架/多框架探测的挑战: 即使取得了许多进展,在单一框架和多框架探测方面仍然存在尚未解决的挑战。 2. Sparse/Cense目标检测方面的挑战: 2026年,现有方法提出了由张等(522. (a) 当地空间优势限制: 大多数现有方法都采用当地空间优势,利用目标与其周围背景之间的强度对比来改进目标。 当多个相邻的目标在同一区域被密集地分布时,这些方法试图将目标和背景之间的细微能量差异区分开来,导致目标粘合,反应模糊,不完整.
分离在检测地图。 (b) 密度-意识语义指导缺陷: 即使深层神经网络模型采用了强大的骨干和以变压器为主头,骨干特征提取过程也是自下而上,没有明确编码目标密度. 不同空间地点的地物均以同质方式处理,不论它们是否
属于密集的目标集群或大多为背景. (c) 理智目标结构限制: 现有的稀有目标模型没有明确模拟空间领域密集分布目标的结构等级. 在空间密度高的多目标场景中,它们会产生模棱两可的空间结构和
相互特征干扰,使本地化精度下降,探测性能不稳定。 这三项限制显示了目前对于密集场景的尚未解决的挑战.

blocks.en: 10.3 Prospective Solutions
blocks.zh: 10.3 前瞻性解决办法

blocks.en: 10.3.1 Perspectives for Researcher Solutions
blocks.zh: 10.3.1 研究人员解决方案的前景

blocks.en: 1. Conventional Unsupervised Methods (Model-based): This category seems to have fully exploit its potential. Nevertheless, recent methods based on hyperbolic clustering have shown high performance without training data. In addition, Dempster-Schäfer theory have not be investigated in infrared small target detection. 2. Low-rank and Sparse Decomposition Unsupervised Models (Model-based): Outliers can be classified in the subspace where they are the more prominent as developed in Brahma et al. ( 558 ) : (a) Outliers in the original observation space (OS) (that are commonly addressed) are relatively visible due to their outlying values. They can be effectively handled by PCP. (b) Outliers in the orthogonal complement (OC) subspace (which is the space orthogonal to the primary principal component subspace) for which PCP may fail. OC outliers are observations that have arbitrarily large magnitude when projected onto the OC subspace. In literature, all the current works using LRSD for infrared small target detection only considered OS outliers. To address this issue, future works may concern a dedicated method for OC outliers or both OS and OC outliers in the low-rank component. Furthermore, outliers can affect both the low-rank and sparse components. Most of the works only considered outliers in the low-rank components. Future works may also concern dedicated methods for outliers in the sparse components or for the simultaneous presence of both sources of corruption.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 常规无监督方法(模式): 这一类别似乎已充分利用其潜力。 尽管如此,基于双曲分集的近期方法在没有培训数据的情况下显示出了高性能. 此外,德姆斯特-施克费尔理论还没有在红外小目标探测中被调查. 2. 低等和Sparse分解无监督模型(模型): 外出物可以被分类在被布拉马等(558)所开发的更突出的子空间中: (a)原观测空间外出物(通常处理的)因其外出值而相对可见. 它们可由五氯苯酚有效处理。 (b) 五氯苯酚可能失效的正对子空间(即正对子空间至主要组成部分子空间)外部物质。 OC外层是投射到OC子空间时任意地有较大规模的观测. 在文献中,所有使用LRSD进行红外小目标探测的当前作品都只考虑OS出局. 为了解决这一问题,未来的作品可能涉及OC出值或OS和OC出值在低级组件中的专用方法. 此外,外部因素既会影响低等级的组成部分,也会影响稀有的组成部分。 大部分作品只考虑低等构件的出局. 未来的工作还可能涉及针对稀少组成部分的外围分子或同时存在两种腐败来源的专门方法。

blocks.en: 10.3.2 Perspectives for AI-Assisted Research Solutions
blocks.zh: 10.3.2 AI-辅助研究解决方案的视角

blocks.en: Previous solutions are designed by researchers using mathematical tools, machine learning tools and signal processing tools. In this context, researchers attempt to develop methods using these modeling tools acting on their characteristics according to the challenges they wish to handle. Low-rank and sparse decomposition based methods differ from their decomposition, their minimization problems, their loss functions and their solvers. Deep neural networks methods differ from their conceptual model (CNNs, Transformers,…), their architecture, their optimization, their loss function and their training. In each case, researchers propose a designed combination of the corresponding characteristics of the chosen modeling tools. However, it is not sure that all the combinations have been investigated to obtain the most suitable combination for the infrared small target detection task. In this context, an AI-Assisted research tools addressing this issue would be helpful.
blocks.zh: 以前的解决办法由研究人员利用数学工具,机器学习工具和信号处理工具来设计. 在这方面,研究人员试图制定使用这些建模工具的方法,根据他们希望处理的挑战根据自己的特点行事。 基于分解的低等和稀有的方法与分解,最小化问题,损失功能和解子不同. 深神经网络方法不同于它们的概念模型(CNNs,变形器,.),它们的架构,优化,丢失功能和训练. 在每种情况下,研究者都提出设计结合所选模型工具的相应特征. 然而,尚不确定是否对所有组合进行了调查,以获得红外小目标探测任务最合适的组合. 在这方面,由大赦国际认可的研究工具解决这一问题将是有益的。

blocks.en: 10.4 Perspectives for Performance Evolution
blocks.zh: 10.4 业绩演变的前景

blocks.en: For performance evaluation and fair comparison, Pang et al. ( 66 ) proposs an hybrid-level metric incorporating pixel- and target-level performance. Thus, a systematic error analysis method is proposed emphasizing the importance of cross-dataset evaluation. An open-source toolkit is released to facilitate standardized benchmarking.
blocks.zh: 为了进行绩效评价和公平比较,Pang等人(66人)提议采用混合水平的衡量标准,将像素和目标水平的绩效纳入其中。 因此,建议采用系统的错误分析方法,强调跨数据集评价的重要性。 发布了一个开放源码工具包,以方便标准化的基准。

blocks.en: Moreover, performance evaluation has to be revisited in the context of high activities research and the diversity of deployment of infrared sensors. Indeed, the research of one top method is not relevant in the context because numerous methods can be more suitable depending the environments. In this context, recent works ( 553 ; 554 ; 555 ) on performance evaluation conducted in the close field of moving object detection can alleviate the biasis of the current evaluation protocols both for ranking according to the diversity of environments and also in unseen scenarios ( 556 ) .
blocks.zh: 此外,必须结合高活动研究和红外传感器部署的多样性,重新进行业绩评价。 事实上,对一种顶端方法的研究与背景无关,因为根据环境的不同,许多方法可能更合适。 在这方面,近期在移动物体探测的近距离领域进行的性能评价工作(553;554;555)可以减轻目前评价协议的偏差,既根据环境的多样性进行排名,也根据隐形情景(556)进行排名。

blocks.en: 11 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 11 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we have firstly presented a full review about infrared small target detection by covering 30 years of research. In this context, we categorized the existing methods in three main categories namely traditional unsupervised models, and low-rank and sparse decomposition unsupervised models. For each categories, the methods have been surveyed in a rationale and historical manner with the corresponding first works, the similar research, their variants/improvements and their last developments. Moreover, we have presented the different datasets, the metrics and the ranking protocols employed for performance evaluation. Finally, we provide theoretical perspectives as well as AI-assisted research solutions.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们首先对红外小目标探测作了全面的回顾,涵盖了30年的研究. 在这方面,我们把现有方法分为三大类,即传统无监督模型和低等和稀有分解无监督模型。 对于每个类别,方法都以理由和历史方式进行了调查,并有相应的第一批著作、类似的研究、其变异/改进及其最后的发展。 此外,我们介绍了用于业绩评价的不同数据集、衡量尺度和排名协议。 最后,我们提供了理论观点以及AI协助的研究解决方案.
